title: Uncertainty-Aware Simulation-Based Inference for Operations Research with Large Language Models
summary: Deploying large language models (LLMs) for operations research (OR) tasks remains challenging because correctness depends on a coherent modeling process, not merely a correct final answer. Standard autoregressive generation operates on a myopic policy, which sometimes fails to anticipate whether a partial formulation can be validly extended into a globally consistent optimization model. Consequently, locally plausible steps may propagate into catastrophic downstream formulation or solver code errors. To address this, we propose an uncertainty-aware, training-free inference framework for OR mathematical modeling. Without updating model parameters, our method evaluates intermediate candidate steps using short lookahead simulations to quantify downstream predictive uncertainty or probability concentration. Candidates that demonstrate a higher likelihood of yielding coherent mathematical formulations are then dynamically selected via importance resampling. Empirical evaluations across multiple OR benchmarks (including NL4OPT, MAMO, and IndustryOR) demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms both standard and low-temperature baselines, establishing an efficient, training-free paradigm for reliable OR formulation generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的不确定性感知推理框架，通过短视前瞻模拟和重要性重采样来评估中间候选步骤，从而提升大语言模型在运筹学数学建模任务中的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在运筹学任务中的部署面临挑战，因为正确性依赖于连贯的建模过程而非仅正确的最终答案。标准自回归生成基于短视策略，无法预判局部步骤能否有效扩展为全局一致的优化模型，导致局部看似合理的步骤可能引发灾难性的下游错误。
AI.method: 提出一种不确定性感知、免训练的推理框架。该方法在不更新模型参数的前提下，利用短前瞻模拟评估中间候选步骤，量化下游预测不确定性或概率集中度，并通过重要性重采样动态选择更可能产生连贯数学表述的候选方案。
AI.result: 在多个运筹学基准测试（包括NL4OPT、MAMO和IndustryOR）上的实验表明，该框架持续优于标准和低温基线，建立了一种高效且无需训练的可靠运筹学表述生成范式。
AI.conclusion: 该研究验证了通过不确定性感知的推理策略，可以在不进行模型训练的情况下显著提升LLM在运筹学数学建模方面的可靠性，为相关应用提供了一种高效的替代方案。

title: Learning Compositional Meta-Routing for Agentic Workflows: An Executable Benchmark
summary: Agentic systems must decide not only what answer to produce, but which reasoning and execution operations should precede it. A controller may answer directly, decompose a request, retrieve evidence, execute code, delegate to a specialist, or verify an intermediate result. Existing routing work largely selects model endpoints, retrieval depth, or tools in isolation. We introduce an executable benchmark and a budget-aware meta-router that composes heterogeneous operations from raw task text. The benchmark contains 216 training, 72 development, 108 held-out test, and 108 locked lexical-shift challenge tasks across data analysis, frozen-corpus research, and document processing. Outcomes are machine checked after operations execute. Independent regularized logistic heads predict operation probabilities from word and character features, are temperature-scaled on development data, and are greedily composed under route-cost and action-count budgets. On the held-out test, the learned policy achieves 100% success versus 93.5% for strong static and fixed workflows, with 43% lower cost than the static policy; a matched learned one-shot router reaches 56.5%. On the untouched challenge split, learned success falls to 75.9% and trails static routing at 93.5%, while remaining 49% cheaper and exceeding one-shot routing by 34.3 points. The gap identifies lexical generalization, rather than route execution, as the principal limitation. These results establish a reproducible testbed and a bounded proof of concept, not evidence of live-LLM performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个可执行的基准测试和一个预算感知的元路由器，用于从原始任务文本中组合异构操作（如检索、代码执行、委派等）。在保留测试集上，学习策略达到100%成功率，比静态策略成本低43%；但在词汇偏移的挑战集上，成功率降至75.9%，落后于静态路由的93.5%，表明词汇泛化是主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 智能体系统不仅要决定产生什么答案，还要决定在推理和执行之前应执行哪些操作。现有路由工作大多孤立地选择模型端点、检索深度或工具，缺乏能将异构操作从原始任务文本中组合起来的系统方法。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含216训练/72开发/108测试/108词汇偏移挑战任务的可执行基准，覆盖数据分析、冻结语料库研究和文档处理。采用独立的正则化逻辑回归头从词和字符特征预测操作概率，通过温度缩放校准，并在路由成本和动作数量预算下进行贪婪组合。
AI.result: 在保留测试集上，学习策略达到100%成功率（静态和固定工作流为93.5%），成本比静态策略低43%；匹配的一次性路由器仅达56.5%。在未触碰的挑战集上，学习策略降至75.9%，落后于静态路由的93.5%，但成本仍低49%，且超过一次性路由34.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 词汇泛化而非路由执行是主要限制因素。该工作建立了可复现的测试平台和有界的概念验证，不声称代表实时LLM的性能表现。

title: MetaRoute-Bench: Evaluating Meta-Decision Policies for Agentic Workflow Routing
summary: Agentic systems must repeatedly decide whether to answer directly, decompose a task, invoke a tool, execute code, delegate to a specialist, verify an intermediate result, or recover from failure. These meta-decisions affect not only task success but also operating cost and latency, yet they are often embedded inside an orchestration framework and evaluated only through aggregate task accuracy. We present MetaRoute-Bench, an open, inspectable framework for comparing meta-decision policies under a shared execution model. The initial benchmark contains 180 synthetic task profiles spanning data analysis, research, and document processing, eight routing policies, and 30 paired random seeds. Across 43,200 traces, a task-aware compositional policy achieves 79.4% success compared with 76.7% for a strong workload-specific static policy, 67.4% for one-shot task routing, and 52.9% for direct answering. Relative to the static policy, this is a 2.7 percentage-point improvement with paired 95% CI of plus or minus 2.0 points, at 4.7% higher mean cost and 6.4% higher latency. Ablations show the largest losses when route composition is restricted to one operation and when verification is removed. These results are generated by a seeded offline execution model rather than a live deployment; accordingly, the primary contribution is a reproducible evaluation method and an analysis of routing-policy tradeoffs, not evidence of production effectiveness. We release task generation, policies, traces, tests, and analysis artifacts to support live-system validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MetaRoute-Bench，一个开放可审查的基准框架，用于在共享执行模型下比较智能体系统的元决策（路由）策略。基准包含180个合成任务、8种路由策略和30组随机种子，通过43,200条轨迹评估，任务感知的组合策略达到79.4%的成功率，优于静态策略（76.7%）、一次性路由（67.4%）和直接回答（52.9%），但代价是更高的成本和延迟。
AI.motivation: 智能体系统需要反复做出元决策（直接回答、分解任务、调用工具、执行代码、委派专家、验证中间结果或从失败中恢复），这些决策影响任务成功率、成本和延迟，但通常被嵌入编排框架中，仅通过聚合任务准确率来评估，缺乏可复现的对比方法。
AI.method: 构建MetaRoute-Bench框架，包含180个合成任务配置（覆盖数据分析、研究和文档处理）、8种路由策略、30组配对随机种子，采用种子化的离线执行模型生成43,200条轨迹，并通过消融实验分析路由组合和验证操作的影响。
AI.result: 任务感知组合策略达到79.4%成功率，优于工作负载特定静态策略（76.7%）、一次性任务路由（67.4%）和直接回答（52.9%）。相对于静态策略提升2.7个百分点（95% CI ±2.0），但成本增加4.7%，延迟增加6.4%。消融实验中，限制路由组合为单一操作和移除验证时性能损失最大。
AI.conclusion: MetaRoute-Bench的贡献在于提供可复现的评估方法和路由策略权衡分析，而非生产环境有效性证明。作者发布了任务生成、策略、轨迹、测试和分析工件，以支持真实系统的验证。

title: Progressive$^2$: A Teacher-Student Progressive Co-Evolving Knowledge Distillation Method for Substantial Model Compression
comment: Manuscript under review at IEEE Transactions on Services Computing
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a widely utilized technique for transferring knowledge from a large model (the teacher) to a smaller model (the student). Owing to its flexibility and broad applicability, KD has been extensively applied in the compression of server-side models to meet the Quality of Service (QoS) requirements of client users. Despite significant advancements, the performance of distillation is substantially compromised when a large disparity exists between the capabilities of the server and the requirements of the client. To alleviate this problem, we propose a novel distillation approach, named Progressive$^2$, which operates through the combination of a progressively stronger teacher and a progressively smaller student. On the side of the teacher, rather than involving all layers simultaneously, we progressively select additional layers for distillation following a raw-to-rich semantic progression, establishing a systematic learning curriculum. Furthermore, we design a teacher-side multi-feature fusion adapter for the teacher to improve training stability, which is theoretically supported by the framework of Lipschitz continuity. On the side of the student, rather than directly training a tiny model, we gradually reduce the size of the network to facilitate an iterative co-evolution with the teacher. Progressive$^2$ serves as a flexible framework; the progressive strategy of the teacher can be deployed independently to achieve an optimal balance between accuracy and training efficiency, while the joint integration of the teacher and the student yields further improvements in overall performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Progressive²，一种渐进式知识蒸馏方法，通过"渐进增强的教师"和"渐进缩小的学生"相结合，解决大模型与小模型能力差距过大时蒸馏性能严重下降的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统知识蒸馏在教师模型能力与学生模型需求差距过大时，蒸馏性能会显著下降，这限制了KD在服务端模型压缩中的应用效果。
AI.method: Progressive²包含两个核心策略：(1) 教师侧：按从浅层原始特征到深层语义特征的顺序，逐步选择更多层参与蒸馏，形成系统化的学习课程，并设计基于Lipschitz连续性理论支持的多特征融合适配器以提升训练稳定性；(2) 学生侧：逐步缩小网络规模，与教师形成迭代协同进化。
AI.result: 教师侧的渐进策略可独立部署，在准确率与训练效率之间取得最优平衡；教师与学生的联合集成可进一步提升整体性能。
AI.conclusion: Progressive²是一个灵活的框架，通过渐进式教学与渐进式学习相结合的方式，有效缓解了知识蒸馏中师生能力差距过大导致的性能退化问题。

title: Cost-Effective Automated Judging of Natural-Language Mathematical Proofs
summary: Grading natural-language mathematical proofs is a recurring cost in evaluating math-reasoning systems, and frontier LLM judges are expensive. We ask whether cheap open-weight models can serve as reliable judges given a candidate proof, a ground-truth proof, and a human-grading rubric. On a 200-instance validation sample of IMO-GradingBench, three cheap judges (GPT-OSS 120B, DeepSeek-V4 Flash, Gemma-4 31B) agree with human pass/fail decisions at rates statistically indistinguishable from Claude Opus 4.7 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, at up to $100\times$ lower cost. We had expected a majority vote of the three to be the best budget option; it matched the frontier but did not improve on its strongest member. Extending to the full 1000-instance benchmark and exploring consensus rules, we found that requiring unanimous agreement (all-three-pass) reaches the highest pass-agreement and precision and, on four replicate runs, the smallest run-to-run spread. The headline finding is that cheap judges are competitive with the frontier at one to two orders of magnitude lower cost; as a deployable default we recommend all-three-pass, with the caveat that this rule was identified post-hoc and warrants independent replication.

AI.tldr: 本文探究廉价开源权重模型能否替代昂贵的顶尖大模型作为数学证明评分器。在200实例验证集上，三个廉价评判模型（GPT-OSS 120B、DeepSeek-V4 Flash、Gemma-4 31B）与人类评判的一致性在统计上与Claude Opus 4.7和Gemini 3.1 Pro无显著差异，且成本低至1-2个数量级。在全量1000实例基准上，"三模型一致通过"（all-three-pass）规则达到最高通过一致性和精确度，且运行间波动最小。推荐将该规则作为默认部署方案，但需注意该规则为事后识别，需独立复现验证。
AI.motivation: 自然语言数学证明的评分是评估数学推理系统的持续成本，而前沿大模型作为评判者价格昂贵。作者希望探究廉价开源权重模型能否在给定候选证明、标准答案和人工评分标准的情况下，作为可靠且经济的评分替代方案。
AI.method: 在IMO-GradingBench上选取200实例验证集，使用三个廉价评判模型（GPT-OSS 120B、DeepSeek-V4 Flash、Gemma-4 31B）与两个前沿模型（Claude Opus 4.7、Gemini 3.1 Pro）进行对比，统计与人类通过/未通过判定的一致性。随后扩展到1000实例全量基准，探索包括多数投票和全票一致（all-three-pass）等多种共识规则。
AI.result: 三个廉价模型与人类判定的一致性在统计上与前沿模型不可区分，成本降低达100倍。多数投票匹配前沿表现但未超过最优成员。全票一致规则（all-three-pass）达到最高的通过与精度，并在四次重复运行中表现出最小的运行间波动。
AI.conclusion: 廉价开源模型在数学证明评分任务上与前沿模型竞争力相当，成本优势显著。推荐使用all-three-pass共识规则作为默认部署，但该规则为事后识别，需要独立复现以验证其可靠性。

title: Revisiting Classic Thought Experiments to Measure Consciousness for Artificial Intelligence Safety
summary: This research note revisits Leibniz's mill, Turing's imitation game, and Searle's Chinese Room through the Conservation-Congruent Encoding (CCE) framework. It formalises a toy symbolic setting in which successful behaviour is measured by task performance ($W_{causal,T}$), while the efficiency with which preserved internal structure supports that behaviour is measured by operational consciousness ($κ_T$). Within this setup, an uncompressed lookup system and a compact generative system can in principle achieve comparable behavioural success, yet diverge sharply in $κ_T$: the former relies on an expanding standing store of unreused mappings, whereas the latter reuses compact internal structure. The note therefore reframes classic disputes about understanding by separating outward performance from the organisation that sustains it, and motivates why this distinction may matter for later AI-safety analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文通过守恒一致编码（CCE）框架重新审视莱布尼茨磨坊、图灵测试和塞尔中文房间等经典思想实验，提出用任务表现（W_causal,T）和操作意识（κ_T）分别度量行为成功与内部结构效率，并以无压缩查找系统与紧凑生成系统为例说明两者可在外在表现上相当但内部组织迥异，从而将"理解"问题拆解为外在表现与支撑它的内在组织两个维度。
AI.motivation: 经典的关于机器能否"理解"的争论（如图灵测试、中文房间）长期纠缠于外在行为表现，缺乏一个能同时考察行为成功与内部结构效率的正式框架。作者希望通过CCE框架将这两个维度分离，为AI安全性分析提供更清晰的概念基础。
AI.method: 提出CCE（Conservation-Congruent Encoding）框架，在玩具形式化设定中定义两个关键度量：W_causal,T用于衡量任务表现（因果层面行为成功），κ_T用于衡量操作意识（保留内部结构支撑行为的效率）。在该框架下对比两类系统：无压缩查找系统（依赖不断扩大的未复用映射存储）和紧凑生成系统（复用紧凑内部结构）。
AI.result: 在原理上，无压缩查找系统与紧凑生成系统可以达到相当的行为成功水平（W_causal,T可比），但两者在κ_T上差异显著——前者依赖不断膨胀且不复用的存储映射，后者通过复用紧凑内部结构实现高效率。这证明外在行为表现相同并不蕴含内部组织方式相同。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将关于"理解"的经典争论重新表述为外在行为表现与支撑行为的内部组织之间的区分，并指出这一区分可能对后续AI安全性分析具有重要意义。

title: Rethinking Pretraining for Specialized Design Data: Evidence from the JONES-19 Cultural Design Dataset
summary: Design and architectural archives encode expert human knowledge in graphical formats, providing a critical testbed for design-inspired Machine Learning (ML) challenges absent with typical computer vision benchmarks. Building on JONES-19, a small-size image dataset based on The Grammar of Ornament (London, 1857), we evaluate the discriminative performance of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in two model training strategies: (a) ImageNet pretraining for domain-general "visual common sense," and (b) learning from scratch on the design data in JONES-19. We find that while domain-general priors improve discriminative performance, learning from scratch augmented with repeated local sampling (multi-crop) effectively recovers these gains. For highly structured design data, local design-driven representations provide sufficient foundation for learning, challenging a reliance on massive general-purpose pretraining. These findings suggest that in specialized design domains, careful curation of smaller high-quality datasets that capture empirical and formal design principles may prove more effective and informative on the nature of a particular design domain than prioritizing large-scale data collection.

AI.tldr: 本文基于JONES-19设计图像数据集，比较了CNN的两种训练策略（ImageNet预训练与从零训练），发现局部多裁剪采样能够弥补预训练带来的性能优势，表明在专业设计领域中，精心策划的小型高质量数据集可能比大规模预训练更有效。
AI.motivation: 设计与建筑档案以图形格式编码了专家的人类知识，为设计驱动的机器学习挑战提供了关键测试平台。但现有典型的计算机视觉基准数据集无法体现这些设计领域的独特挑战，需要评估CNN在专业设计数据上的表现。
AI.method: 基于JONES-19数据集（源自1857年《装饰语法》），评估CNN在两种训练策略下的判别性能：(a) ImageNet预训练以获得领域通用的"视觉常识"；(b) 在JONES-19设计数据上从零训练，并采用重复局部采样（多裁剪）策略。
AI.result: 领域通用的预训练先验能提升判别性能，但从零训练结合多裁剪采样方法可以有效弥补这些性能差距。对于高度结构化的设计数据，局部设计驱动的表示足以提供学习基础。
AI.conclusion: 在专业设计领域，精心策划的小型高质量数据集（能够捕捉经验和形式设计原则）可能比大规模数据收集更有效且更能揭示特定设计领域的本质。

title: RubricReviewer: From Direct Critique to Objective and Comprehensive Rubric-Driven Peer Review
summary: Peer review at major venues is under unprecedented submission pressure, motivating the use of large language models (LLMs) as review assistants. Existing LLM-based reviewers, however, face two structural limitations. First, they map manuscripts directly to reviews, leaving the underlying rubric implicit and entangling its derivation with the judgement. Second, the prevailing paradigms each capture only half of a good review: training-free agents gather broad evidence but produce undirected critiques, while training-based reviewers inherit human discriminative judgement together with its noise and uneven coverage. We introduce RubricReviewer, a fully rubric-driven framework that addresses both limitations. It makes rubric generation an explicit intermediate step, so that both review generation and the final assessment are conditioned on paper-adaptive rubrics. It further combines a training-free agent (Scout) that gathers external evidence with a human-aligned trained model (Aligner) that consumes this evidence, fusing the strengths of both supervision sources. Experiments on real-world submissions show that RubricReviewer produces reviews that are markedly more comprehensive and more discriminative than prior systems, and exhibits the strongest robustness against adversarial prompt-injection attacks. Ablation studies further confirm the necessity of each component.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RubricReviewer，一种完全基于评分标准驱动的LLM评审框架，通过将评分标准生成作为显式中间步骤，并结合无训练代理（Scout）与有训练模型（Aligner）的优势，在真实投稿数据上生成了比现有系统更全面、更具判别力且更鲁棒的评审意见。
AI.motivation: 同行评审面临前所未有的投稿压力，促使使用LLM作为评审助手。但现有LLM评审器存在两个结构性局限：一是直接将稿件映射到评审意见，导致评分标准隐式化、其推导与判断纠缠不清；二是现有范式各只捕捉了优质评审的一半——无训练代理收集广泛证据但批评缺乏方向性，有训练模型继承人类判别判断但带有噪声和覆盖不均的问题。
AI.method: RubricReviewer是一个完全评分标准驱动的框架。其核心在于将评分标准生成作为显式中间步骤，使评审生成和最终评估都基于论文自适应的评分标准。框架结合了收集外部证据的无训练代理（Scout）和消费这些证据的人类对齐训练模型（Aligner），融合了两种监督来源的优势。
AI.result: 在真实世界投稿上的实验表明，RubricReviewer生成的评审比现有系统更加全面且更具判别力，并且对对抗性提示注入攻击表现出最强的鲁棒性。消融研究进一步证实了每个组件的必要性。
AI.conclusion: RubricReviewer通过显式的评分标准生成和双组件融合结构，有效解决了LLM评审中评分标准隐式和证据收集与判断分离两大问题，在评审质量、判别力和鲁棒性上均优于现有方法。

title: AutoFOAM: The Self-Refining Autonomous OpenFOAM Agent
summary: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) plays an important role in modern engineering, but using open-source solvers such as OpenFOAM requires considerable knowledge and skills, as well as time-consuming configuration file setup. To reduce this burden, we propose AutoFOAM - a self-evolving large language model (LLM) agent that creates, evaluates, runs, and evolves its own OpenFOAM simulations based solely on natural-language instructions. Our model is pre-trained on the Qwen-coder 2.5-14B, which is then fine-tuned on 252 text prompts targeting 7 OpenFOAM solvers, 13 parametrized mesh templates, and a y plus-aware numerical policy. The crucial element of the algorithm is a sophisticated evolution loop composed of 7 stages. To prevent model degeneration under repeated self-training, the agent employs three complementary anti-collapse streams: RAG-augmented retry context, surgical dictionary-level patching, and prompt-diversity paraphrasing. By bridging generative artificial intelligence with rigorous fluid simulations, AutoFOAM accelerates rapid prototyping and democratizes advanced CFD workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出了AutoFOAM——一个基于大语言模型的自进化智能体，能够根据自然语言指令自动创建、评估、运行和演化OpenFOAM仿真，通过七阶段进化循环和三种防崩溃机制，无需手动配置即可完成CFD仿真任务。
AI.motivation: 使用开源CFD求解器（如OpenFOAM）需要专业知识、技能和耗时的配置文件设置，这成为现代工程中CFD应用的主要瓶颈，因此需要一种降低使用门槛的自动化解决方案。
AI.method: 基于Qwen-coder 2.5-14B预训练模型，在252个文本提示上微调，覆盖7个OpenFOAM求解器、13个参数化网格模板和y plus感知数值策略。核心是包含7个阶段的进化循环，并采用三种互补的防退化机制：RAG增强重试上下文、词典级外科补丁和提示多样性改写。
AI.result: AutoFOAM能够根据自然语言指令自主完成OpenFOAM仿真全流程，加速快速原型开发，并在重复自训练下保持模型稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将生成式人工智能与严格的流体仿真相结合，AutoFOAM加速了快速原型开发并使高级CFD工作流程民主化，降低了CFD仿真的专业门槛。

title: Leak It: A Probabilistic Approach to Training-Data Extraction from Black-Box Language Models
summary: Membership inference (MIA) on language models is usually summarised by an aggregate ROC-AUC, but such evaluations are confounded: model-free blind baselines separate members from non-members from surface text alone. We study black-box, sampling-based training-data leakage through a probabilistic lens, treating N samples from p(.|x) as an estimate of the output distribution and casting leakage signals as functionals of it. We extend the blind-baseline critique into the sampling regime: on WikiMIA a blind bag-of-words classifier reaches AUC 0.97 (TPR 0.90 at 5% FPR) and sampling adds nothing, while on an IID Pile split (MIMIR) neither self-concentration nor gold-continuation recovery significantly beats a blind baseline (incremental AUC 95% CI includes zero). Aggregate metrics hide the real harm. The same sampling verbatim-extracts training data for a tail of documents no blind attack can reach. On Pythia-6.9B, 83 of 500 Pile documents bearing a real identifier (16.6%; 21.3% of those bearing an email address) have that exact identifier reproduced AND not reproduced under a mismatched-prefix control, so each leak is attributable to that document, not to a globally common string. This per-document disclosure is invisible to aggregate AUC and grows with capacity (5.6% to 16.6% from 410M to 6.9B). The risk is uneven: identifier leakage is ~3x stronger in code than prose, though prose stays clearly positive and also grows with capacity (4.0% to 12.1%), while recovery of arbitrary held-out continuations is confined to code (+0.44 member gap on GitHub vs at most +0.014 on prose). Temperature and nucleus sampling matter little, a 16-token prefix suffices, and we detect no reduction from corpus deduplication. Privacy audits should report per-document extraction, decomposed by domain, not a single AUC. We release leakit, a black-box extraction-audit tool.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了语言模型成员推断攻击（MIA）的聚合ROC-AUC指标存在严重混淆问题——盲基线（不考虑模型）仅凭表面文本就能达到极高AUC。作者提出基于采样的概率视角，将泄漏信号视为输出分布的函数，并通过逐文档提取审计发现真实风险：模型的"照抄"行为会在长尾文档中精确重现私人标识符（如邮箱），这种风险随模型容量增大而增强，在代码领域比散文强约3倍，且聚合并不能检测到。作者发布了leakit开源审计工具。
AI.motivation: 现有MIA评估用聚合ROC-AUC总结模型隐私风险，但这类指标被混淆：无模型盲基线仅凭表面文本特征就能区分成员与非成员。聚合指标掩盖了真实的逐文档泄漏危害，需要用概率视角和逐文档审计来揭示真正的隐私风险。
AI.method: 从概率视角将N次采样p(.|x)视为输出分布的估计，将泄漏信号建模为输出分布的函数。在采样场景下扩展盲基线批判：在WikiMIA上使用盲bow分类器，在IID Pile分割（MIMIR）上对比自浓度与gold-continuation恢复与盲基线的差异。同时引入逐文档提取审计：用不匹配前缀作为对照，检测模型对包含真实标识符文档的精确重现。
AI.result: 在WikiMIA上盲bow分类器达到AUC 0.97（5% FPR下TPR 0.90），采样不增加信息；MIMIR上自浓度和gold-continuation恢复的增量AUC 95%置信区间包含零。在Pythia-6.9B上，500个Pile文档中83个（16.6%）含真实标识符的文档被精确重构且在错配前缀对照下未重现，证明泄漏可归因于特定文档。标识符泄漏从410M的5.6%增长至6.9B的16.6%，代码比散文强3倍，任意held-out续写的恢复仅发生在代码域。各种采样参数（温度、nucleus、前缀长度、去重）影响甚微。
AI.conclusion: 隐私审计应报告按领域分解的逐文档提取情况，而非单一AUC值。聚合AUC掩盖了真实的风险分布——风险不均匀地集中在长尾文档和代码领域。作者发布leakit作为黑盒提取审计工具，呼吁采用逐文档披露作为更准确的隐私度量标准。

title: MemoryForge: Synthesize Lifelong Memory for Human-Like LLM Agents
summary: Equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with human-like personas is crucial for agentic applications, such as role-play and user simulation. Traditional prompt-based methods rely on descriptive conditioning by injecting static textual profiles, which often makes agents show generic behaviors due to a lack of realistic life memory. To fill this gap, we introduce memory-based conditioning, a paradigm inspired by the cognitive psychology, which replaces abstract profiles with an autobiographical memory base, enabling frozen LLMs to dynamically retrieve situation-relevant memory to guide their behaviors. We formalize its enabling task as customized lifelong memory synthesis and propose MemoryForge, a novel framework to synthesize such lifelong memory from brief target personas. MemoryForge has three key components: a context generator for socio-historical grounding, a life organizer for developmental coherence toward the target identity, and a multi-resolution simulator that balances broad temporal summaries with high-fidelity episodic experiences. Experiments on PersonaGym for role-play and SimulatorArena for user-simulation, show that the synthesized memory base by MemoryForge enables frozen LLMs to exhibit more human-like behaviors than strong descriptive conditioning baselines across multiple metrics and LLM backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemoryForge框架，通过合成自传式终身记忆替代静态文本描述，让冻结的LLM动态检索情境相关的记忆来引导角色扮演和用户模拟行为，在PersonaGym和SimulatorArena上超过传统描述性条件化基线。
AI.motivation: 传统基于提示的方法通过注入静态文本档案进行描述性条件化，由于缺乏真实的生活记忆，往往使智能体表现出泛化行为，无法体现真实人类角色的个性特征。
AI.method: MemoryForge包含三个核心组件：上下文生成器（用于社会历史基础）、生活组织器（用于目标身份的成长连贯性）、多分辨率模拟器（平衡宏观时间总结与高保真情景经验）。通过从简短的目标准入合成终身记忆，实现记忆化条件化。
AI.result: 在PersonaGym（角色扮演）和SimulatorArena（用户模拟）上的实验表明，MemoryForge合成的记忆库能使冻结LLM在多个指标和多种LLM骨干网络上展现出比强描述性条件化基线更接近人类的行为。
AI.conclusion: 记忆化条件化是替代传统描述性条件化的有效范式，自传式记忆能够为LLM的人设赋予更真实、更情境化的行为表现。

title: Enhancing LLMs with Context-Specific Knowledge for Mitigating Misinformation in SMEs: A RAG-based Modeling and Analysis
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs), a part of artificial intelligence (AI), are increasingly being adopted by Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) to enhance question-answering capabilities and support business decision-making processes. However, hallucinations in LLM-generated outputs can serve as a source of misinformation, reducing user confidence in their reliability and trustworthiness within SMEs. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising approach to address this challenge by incorporating external knowledge sources into the modeling process. In this paper, we present VectorRAG and GraphRAG modeling approaches to mitigate hallucinations and misinformation risks and evaluate their effectiveness in SME environments. Our experimental evaluation is conducted on multiple state-of-the-art LLMs, including LLaMA, Mistral, and Qwen, to assess performance in terms of useful response generation, risk of hallucination, contextual relevance, as well as human-interpretation. The results demonstrate that RAG-enhanced LLMs can significantly improve response quality by reducing hallucinations and misinformation, thereby supporting more reliable, trustworthy, and context-aware decision-making in SME environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VectorRAG和GraphRAG两种检索增强生成方法，用于减少大语言模型在中小企业场景中的幻觉和错误信息，并在LLaMA、Mistral和Qwen等多个LLM上进行了实验验证，结果表明RAG增强方法能显著提升响应质量、降低幻觉风险，支持更可靠和可信赖的决策。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型正被中小企业越来越多地用于问答和决策支持，但其生成内容中的幻觉问题会导致错误信息传播，降低用户信任度，因此需要有效的方法来缓解这一风险。
AI.method: 提出VectorRAG和GraphRAG两种建模方法，通过将外部知识源融入建模过程来增强LLM的生成能力，并在多个主流LLM（LLaMA、Mistral、Qwen）上评估其在有用响应生成、幻觉风险、上下文相关性和人工解读等维度的表现。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，RAG增强的LLM在降低幻觉和错误信息方面显著优于基线，响应质量得到明显提升，验证了该方法在中小企业环境中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: RAG增强方法能够有效缓解LLM幻觉问题，为中小企业提供更可靠、可信和上下文感知的决策支持，是提升LLM实用性和可信度的重要途径。

title: Response Magnitude as a Dominant Signal for Held-Out CRISPRi Perturbation Effect Prediction
summary: Predicting the magnitude of a CRISPRi perturbation's transcriptomic effect on held-out target genes is an important open problem in single-cell biology. Recent work has documented that simple baselines often match or exceed deep perturbation predictors on related protocols. We study this phenomenon on the Virtual Cell Challenge (VCC) benchmark under a strict held-out target-gene split, identify the specific low-dimensional signal that drives the gap, and characterize how it transfers across cell types. The target is the log Anderson-Darling distance from non-targeting controls, which is strongly predictable from four deterministic scalar functions of the 2,000-dimensional input. A deep MLP encoder with direct access to the full input collapses toward the marginal training mean, and standard remedies do not close the gap. A linear regression on the four magnitude scalars alone exceeds the strongest x-only classical model, while a Random Forest on the input plus the four scalars substantially outperforms our deep proof-of-concept encoder. Two pre-specified controls attribute the magnitude gain to per-row alignment rather than added dimensionality. Under zero-shot transfer to two external CRISPRi screens evaluated against a target-gene endpoint rebuilt from single-cell data, magnitude-only predictors transfer positively whereas expression-only predictors are negative or unresolved. Exposing magnitude to the deep encoder improves transfer over its expression-only counterpart, yet the encoder does not outperform a four-scalar linear regression on the same features. We also find that the Anderson-Darling column distributed with these screens measures transcriptome-wide response breadth rather than target-gene effect strength, so evaluating transfer against it scores a different outcome.

AI.tldr: 本文研究CRISPRi扰动转录组效应预测问题，在虚拟细胞挑战赛（VCC）基准上采用严格的留出目标基因划分，发现目标变量（log Anderson-Darling距离）可由输入的四个确定性标量函数高度预测。深度学习编码器退化为边际训练均值，而基于四个标量的线性回归和随机森林均大幅超越深度模型。跨细胞类型零样本迁移中，幅度预测器正迁移而表达预测器为负或无法解决。
AI.motivation: 在单细胞生物学中，预测CRISPRi扰动对留出目标基因的转录组效应是一个重要的开放问题。尽管深度学习模型被广泛使用，但近期研究表明简单基线方法在相关协议上往往与深度预测器相当甚至超越。本研究旨在系统性地理解这一现象背后的低维信号，并探索其跨细胞类型的迁移特性。
AI.method: 在VCC基准上采用严格的留出目标基因划分；识别出四个确定性标量函数作为关键低维信号；对比深度MLP编码器与线性回归、随机森林等模型；通过两个预先指定的对照组区分逐行对齐与维度增加的影响；在外部CRISPRi筛选数据上进行零样本迁移评估。
AI.result: 四个幅度标量的线性回归超过最强的x-only经典模型；随机森林在输入加四标量上大幅超越深度编码器；深度编码器在拥有完整输入时坍缩向边际训练均值且标准补救措施无效；幅度增益归因于逐行对齐而非维度增加；零样本迁移中幅度预测器正迁移而表达预测器为负；对深度编码器暴露幅度信号可提升迁移但未超过四标量线性回归。
AI.conclusion: CRISPRi扰动效应预测的核心可预测信号是低维的幅度标量而非高维表达谱本身。深度模型在本任务中存在固有的局限性，简单线性模型在此问题上更具竞争力。此外，Anderson-Darling列衡量的是转录组响应广度而非目标基因效应强度，这要求重新审视迁移评估的合理性。

title: AgentMemBench: A Systematic Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Term Memory Management Strategies in Conversational AI Agents
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures submitted on Neural Computing and Applications
summary: Long-term memory remains a critical bottleneck for conversational AI agents, whose finite context windows cannot support coherent recall across thousands of turns. We present AgentMemBench, a unified, reproducible benchmark evaluating five memory management strategies under identical conditions: in-context windowing (ICW), external key-value store (EKV), graph-based episodic memory (GEM), compression-based summarisation (CBS), and web-augmented memory (WAM). All are assessed across three public datasets covering long-term multi-session dialogue (LoCoMo), task-oriented document grounding (MultiDoc2Dial), and persona-grounded multi-session chat (MSC), using Recall@k, MRR, nDCG@k, Answer F1, an LLM-judge Faithfulness score, Memory Footprint, and Latency over 491 annotated question turns. Generation and judging both use Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (4-bit), with greedy decoding for determinism. Our results show that (1) EKV dominates on every quality axis (macro Recall@5 0.792, MRR 0.677, F1 0.156, Faithfulness 0.354); (2) long-range recall is decisive: on LoCoMo, where the gold turn lies many sessions back, ICW, WAM, GEM, and CBS retrieve almost nothing (Recall@5 <= 0.005) while EKV alone reaches 0.573, showing that recency windows, summaries, and entity graphs collapse at long horizons and only dense retrieval scales; (3) CBS is the runner-up on retrieval (0.556); (4) WAM equals ICW on in-corpus recall by construction, since external results carry no in-corpus provenance; and (5) EKV's recall advantage carries a footprint cost (~5,100 vs ~300 tokens for ICW/WAM), an explicit accuracy-efficiency trade-off. We additionally evaluate two published memory systems (MemGPT/Letta, HippoRAG) against the same harness, and release all code, environment, and result artefacts for full reproducibility.

AI.tldr: AgentMemBench提出了一个统一的、可复现的基准，评测五种对话智能体长期记忆管理策略（ICW、EKV、GEM、CBS、WAM），在三个公开数据集上对比其检索质量、回答质量、内存占用和延迟。结果显示外部键值存储（EKV）在质量维度上全面占优，尤其在长距离回忆场景下表现突出，但存在明显的内存占用代价。
AI.motivation: 长对话智能体的有限上下文窗口无法支撑跨数千轮的一致性回忆，长期记忆仍是关键瓶颈。但缺乏一个在相同条件下统一评估不同记忆管理策略的可复现基准。
AI.method: 构建AgentMemBench统一基准，在相同条件下评测五种记忆策略：上下文窗口（ICW）、外部键值存储（EKV）、图式情景记忆（GEM）、压缩摘要（CBS）和网络增强记忆（WAM）。使用三个公开数据集（LoCoMo、MultiDoc2Dial、MSC），共491个标注问题轮次，以Recall@k、MRR、nDCG@k、Answer F1、LLM-judge Faithfulness、内存占用和延迟为指标。生成与评判均使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct（4-bit）和贪心解码，并额外评估MemGPT/Letta和HippoRAG两个已发表系统。
AI.result: EKV在质量维度上全面领先（宏观Recall@5 0.792，MRR 0.677，F1 0.156，Faithfulness 0.354）；在LoCoMo长距离回忆场景中EKV达到Recall@5 0.573而其他方法几乎为零（≤0.005），表明密集检索是唯一能扩展到长时域的方法；CBS在检索上列第二（0.556）；WAM在语料内回忆上与ICW持平；EKV的内存占用约5,100 tokens，远高于ICW/WAM的约300 tokens。
AI.conclusion: 对话Agent的长期记忆存在明确的准确性-效率权衡：EKV证明了密集检索在长时域回忆中的不可替代性，但付出约17倍的内存足迹代价。工作总结、实体图和网络增强方法在长距离回忆上均失效。发布全部代码、环境和结果工件以保证完全可复现。

title: Energy Efficiency of Locally Deployed LLMs: A Preliminary Quantitative GPU Power Benchmark on Consumer Hardware
summary: The local deployment of large language models (LLMs) is gaining traction due to privacy concerns and the desire for on-premise inference. However, the energy costs on consumer hardware remain poorly characterized, as most benchmarks focus solely on accuracy. This paper presents a reproducible, hardware-level energy benchmark of nine open-source LLMs (1B to 7B parameters) executed on a single consumer GPU (RTX 4060Ti 16GB). Using the Ollama inference engine, GPU power draw was sampled at 2Hz via nvidia-smi across a fixed prompt set. We evaluate mean/peak power, total energy per prompt (J/prompt), energy per output token (J/token), and throughput (tok/s). Our findings suggest that factors beyond raw parameter count, including model architecture and quantization strategy, drive energy efficiency. Specifically, gemma3:1b and llama3.2:1b achieve the lowest energy cost (0.56 J/token and 0.65 J/token) and the highest throughput (>170 tok/s). In contrast, the 7B-Mistral model consumes up to 4.4x more energy per token than the most efficient model. Notably, qwen3.5:2b exhibits anomalously high per-prompt energy due to extended internal reasoning, highlighting the need to distinguish between token generation modes in efficiency metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文在消费级GPU（RTX 4060Ti 16GB）上对九个开源LLM（1B-7B参数）进行了硬件级能耗基准测试，发现模型架构和量化策略比参数量更能影响能效，其中gemma3:1b和llama3.2:1b能耗最低（0.56和0.65 J/token），吞吐量最高（>170 tok/s），而7B-Mistral每token能耗高出4.4倍。
AI.motivation: 尽管本地部署LLM因隐私和本地推理需求日益流行，但消费级硬件上的能耗成本缺乏充分研究，现有基准大多只关注准确性而忽视能耗指标。
AI.method: 在单张RTX 4060Ti 16GB GPU上，使用Ollama推理引擎运行九个开源LLM（1B-7B），通过nvidia-smi以2Hz采样GPU功率，在固定提示集上评估平均/峰值功率、每提示总能耗（J/prompt）、每输出token能耗（J/token）和吞吐量（tok/s）等指标。
AI.result: gemma3:1b和llama3.2:1b能耗最低（0.56和0.65 J/token）且吞吐最高（>170 tok/s）；7B-Mistral每token能耗比最高效模型高4.4倍；qwen3.5:2b因内部推理扩展导致每提示能耗异常偏高。
AI.conclusion: 模型架构和量化策略是驱动能耗效率的关键因素而非单纯参数量，效率指标需要区分token生成模式（如推理模式），以更准确评估LLM的能效表现。

title: Inference-Time Policy Alignment for Fair Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted at the Reinforcement Learning Conference (RLC) 2026. 13 pages main + appendix, 5 figures, 6 tables
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents achieve strong performance by optimizing scalar reward functions. However, once deployed, the policies of these RL agents are often rigid and costly to adapt to new performance criteria. For instance, an agent trained to maximize expected cumulative reward may not accommodate previously unknown stakeholder preferences. Existing approaches to achieve fairness, a type of preference, in RL typically assume that such preferences are known a priori and require complete retraining of the policy under a fairness-oriented metric. Inspired by inference-time alignment in large language models, we investigate the problem of steering a pretrained RL policy toward welfare-based fairness objectives at inference time without updating the base policy's parameters. We formalize inference-time fairness alignment as a policy shaping problem and propose a multiplicative policy shaping framework that adjusts action probabilities using action-dependent welfare scores, thus requiring no modification to the base policy. Our framework is general and compatible with any deep RL agent. Through extensive experiments across multiple domains, we demonstrate that inference-time policy shaping substantially improves welfare-based fairness objectives while preserving core task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种推理时策略塑形框架，通过乘性调整动作概率来引导预训练深度强化学习策略满足福利导向的公平性目标，无需更新基策略参数。
AI.motivation: 现有的强化学习公平性方法通常假设公平偏好预先已知，并需要基于公平导向指标完全重新训练策略，这导致策略部署后难以适应新的利益相关者偏好，适应性差且成本高昂。
AI.method: 受大语言模型推理时对齐的启发，将推理时公平性对齐形式化为策略塑形问题，提出乘性策略塑形框架，利用动作相关的福利分数调整动作概率，不修改基策略参数，且与任意深度强化学习智能体兼容。
AI.result: 在多个领域的广泛实验中，推理时策略塑形显著改善了基于福利的公平性目标，同时保持了核心任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为预训练强化学习策略提供了灵活的推理时公平性对齐手段，克服了传统方法需要完全重训的局限，兼顾了公平性与任务性能的平衡。

title: DLLM-TTS: Block Discrete Diffusion Language Model for Text-to-Speech Synthesis
summary: Current text-to-speech systems face a trade-off: autoregres- sive codec language models produce highly intelligible speech but require large-scale models and training data and decode tokens sequentially, while non-autoregressive approaches im- prove speed at the cost of linguistic accuracy. We present DLLM-TTS, a framework that formulates TTS as conditional block discrete diffusion over X-Codec2 neural audio codec to- kens. The model decomposes sequences into blocks and applies masked diffusion within each block while processing blocks se- quentially, learning both local acoustic coherence and global text-speech alignment. During inference, parallel token pre- diction within blocks enables efficient generation with a real- time factor (RTF) of 0.15. A 0.6B-parameter model trained on 20K hours achieves competitive performance on the Seed- TTS-eval benchmark, demonstrating that block discrete diffu- sion language models enable practical and data-efficient speech synthesis with parallel generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DLLM-TTS，一种将文本转语音（TTS）建模为基于X-Codec2神经音频编解码器令牌的条件块离散扩散框架。模型将序列分解为块，在每个块内应用掩码扩散，同时按顺序处理块，兼顾局部声学连贯性和全局文本-语音对齐。推理时块内并行令牌预测使实时因子（RTF）达到0.15，0.6B参数模型在20K小时数据上训练即在Seed-TTS-eval基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有TTS系统面临权衡：自回归编解码器语言模型生成语音可懂度高但需要大规模模型和训练数据且逐token顺序解码，而非自回归方法虽提升速度但牺牲语言准确性。作者旨在解决这一矛盾，实现兼具高质量和高效率的语音合成。
AI.method: 将TTS形式化为X-Codec2神经音频编解码器令牌上的条件块离散扩散。模型将序列分解为块，在块内采用掩码扩散，块间顺序处理，同时学习局部声学连贯性和全局文本-语音对齐。推理时块内实现并行令牌预测。
AI.result: 推理时实现0.15的实时因子（RTF），0.6B参数模型在20K小时训练数据上即在Seed-TTS-eval基准上取得具有竞争力的性能，表明该方法支持高效且数据效率高的语音合成。
AI.conclusion: 块离散扩散语言模型能够在保持并行生成效率的同时实现实用且数据高效的语音合成，克服了自回归与非自回归方法之间的固有权衡。

title: CoT-Core: Accelerating LLM Evaluation via CoT-Aware Coreset Selection
summary: Evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) incurs prohibitive computational overhead during continuous development processes. While coreset selection accelerates evaluation, existing methods either suffer from a severe ``cold start'' bottleneck requiring massive historical logs (e.g., Item Response Theory) or exhibit a surface lexical bias that misses the underlying reasoning manifold of tasks. We propose CoT-Core, a novel training-free core question selection framework. Recognizing that lexically disparate questions can share equivalent underlying logic, CoT-Core prompts LLMs to unroll zero-shot Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning trajectories. Projecting these paths into a latent space effectively clusters questions by intrinsic logical equivalence rather than superficial text similarity. Extensive experiments on GSM8K, MMLU, MMLU-Pro, and GPQA demonstrate that CoT-Core drastically reduces evaluation costs while maintaining high-fidelity score estimation, and delineate the boundary conditions of reasoning-aware pruning, revealing that its efficacy is intrinsically gated by task complexity.

AI.tldr: 提出CoT-Core框架，利用零样本思维链推理轨迹在潜空间中对问题按内在逻辑等价性聚类，实现无需历史日志的训练免费核心问题选择，在保持高保真度评估的同时大幅降低LLM评估成本。
AI.motivation: LLM评估在持续开发过程中计算开销巨大。现有的核心集选择方法存在两个问题：基于项目反应理论的方法面临严重的"冷启动"瓶颈（需要大量历史日志），而其他方法存在表面词汇偏差，忽略了任务背后的推理结构。
AI.method: CoT-Core框架的核心思想是：词面不同的问题可能共享相同的底层逻辑。具体做法是提示LLM展开零样本思维链推理轨迹，将这些推理路径投影到潜空间中，按问题内在的逻辑等价性而非表面文本相似性进行聚类，从而实现训练免费的核心问题选择。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、MMLU、MMLU-Pro和GPQA四个基准上的实验表明，CoT-Core能大幅降低评估成本同时保持高保真度的分数估计，并揭示了推理感知剪枝的边界条件——其有效性受任务复杂度的内在门控。
AI.conclusion: CoT-Core通过利用思维链推理轨迹捕捉问题的逻辑等价性，为LLM评估中的核心问题选择提供了无需训练且无需历史日志的高效解决方案，但该方法的效能取决于任务的复杂度水平。

title: AutoCause: A Python framework that automates expert decisions in environmental time-series causal discovery
comment: 33 pages, 10 figures. Submitted to Environmental Modelling & Software
summary: Environmental time-series causal discovery requires expert decisions about method choice, conditional-independence tests, lag horizons, sample-size adequacy, multiple-testing control, and evidence interpretation. Applied inconsistently across datasets, these choices yield graphs that cannot be compared, reproduced, or audited. We present AutoCause, an open-source Python workflow that records each decision, derives defaults from an extended causal-audit module, and admits domain-informed overrides. The workflow wraps four established causal-discovery methods from three families, adds non-causal reference models, and grades links by method-count support. On 145 datasets from DGP-Atlas, TimeGraph, and a topology-derived CausalRivers reference, the methods recover complementary parts of the reference graphs. Majority-supported links are more precise than single-method links on the synthetic benchmarks but not against river topology. AutoCause converts inconsistent expert practice into an auditable, repeatable analysis; causal interpretation remains with the analyst. Available at https://github.com/marcoruizrueda/autocause.

AI.tldr: AutoCause是一个开源Python工作流，用于环境时间序列因果发现，通过记录所有分析决策、自动生成默认参数并允许领域知识覆盖，将不一致的专家实践转化为可审计、可重复的分析流程。该工作流集成四种因果发现方法，在145个数据集上验证了多数方法支持的边具有更高精确率。
AI.motivation: 环境时间序列因果发现依赖于专家对不同方法、条件独立性检验、滞后窗口、样本量、多重检验控制等的主观决策，这些选择在不同数据集间不一致，导致生成的结果图无法比较、复现和审计。作者旨在解决这一可重复性问题。
AI.method: 开发了AutoCause开源Python工作流，核心特点包括：(1)记录每个分析决策；(2)从扩展的因果审计模块推导默认参数；(3)允许领域知情覆盖；(4)集成来自三个方法族的四种成熟因果发现方法；(5)加入非因果参考模型；(6)按方法计数支持度对连接（边）进行分级。实验使用了DGP-Atlas、TimeGraph和基于拓扑推导的CausalRivers参考共145个数据集。
AI.result: 各方法在参考图上恢复了互补的部分。在合成基准上，多数方法支持的边比单一方法得到的边更精确；但在河流拓扑参考数据上，这一优势不成立。代码已在GitHub开源。
AI.conclusion: AutoCause能够将不一致的专家实践转化为可审计、可重复的分析，但最终的因果解释仍由研究者负责，工具本身不替代因果判断。

title: Obshazard-bench: Benchmarking Multimodal Foundation Models for Real-Time Disaster Intelligence from Raw Earth Observation Streams
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to interpret Earth observation data, yet their capability to support real-world disaster emergency response remains insufficiently evaluated. Existing remote sensing benchmarks largely rely on static, post-hoc, and expert-processed products, such as gridded reanalysis data, which are difficult to align with operational disaster scenarios where hazards evolve rapidly and decisions must be made under strict time constraints. To bridge this gap, we introduce Obshazard-bench, a real-time, observation-driven benchmark for evaluating disaster intelligence in MLLMs. Unlike image-centric or post-event benchmarks, Obshazard-bench directly integrates raw, high-frequency satellite sounding streams from diverse satellite sensors with concurrent ground-station observations, historical disaster records, and socio-economic indicators, bypassing delayed expert-processing and physical-inversion pipelines. The benchmark covers 8 major disaster categories and 28 sub-categories across more than 60 countries, incorporating over 120 historically documented extreme-event cases and thousands of lifecycle-oriented VQA samples. Moreover, Obshazard-bench further defines a three-stage evaluation taxonomy aligned with the operational disaster workflow: Predictive Crisis Anticipation for pre-disaster risk detection and early forecasting, Active Evolution Reasoning for in-situ disaster tracking and termination prediction, and Multi-faceted Impact Quantification for post-disaster magnitude deduction, humanitarian burden estimation, and socio-economic impact assessment. Experiments on representative general-purpose and Earth-focused foundation models reveal substantial limitations in transforming raw multi-channel physical observations into temporally grounded and decision-relevant disaster reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Obshazard-bench，一个实时、观测驱动的多模态大语言模型(MLLM)灾害智能评估基准，直接整合高频卫星探测流、地面观测、历史灾害记录和社会经济指标，覆盖8大类28小类灾害、60多个国家、120多个历史极端事件案例，并定义三阶段评估体系（灾前预测、灾中推演、灾后量化）。实验表明现有模型在将原始多通道物理观测转化为时间感知和决策相关的灾害推理方面存在重大局限。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感基准大多依赖静态、事后、专家处理的产品（如网格化再分析数据），难以与快速演变、时间紧迫的实战灾害场景对齐，因此MLLMs在真实灾害应急响应中的能力缺乏充分评估。
AI.method: 构建Obshazard-bench基准：(1)直接整合多源卫星原始高频探测流、同步地面站观测、历史灾害记录和社会经济指标，绕开滞后的人工处理和物理反演流程；(2)覆盖8大类28小类灾害、60多个国家、120多个历史极端事件案例及数千个生命周期导向的VQA样本；(3)定义三阶段评估框架：预测性危机预判、主动演化推理、多维度影响量化。
AI.result: 在通用型和地球科学专用基础模型上的实验显示，现有模型在将原始多通道物理观测转化为时间上有根据的、决策相关的灾害推理方面存在显著不足。
AI.conclusion: Obshazard-bench填补了MLLM灾害智能评估与真实作战场景之间的空白，揭示了当前模型在实时观测驱动的灾害推理上的关键短板，为未来灾害应急智能系统的发展提供了评估基准和方向指引。

title: Optimization and Constraint Modeling using LLMs with a Retrieval Augmented Generation Process
summary: Both optimization modeling and constraint modeling are non-trivial problems requiring deep domain expertise and proficiency in modeling formalism languages. Despite their importance across logistics, healthcare, and supply chain management, current large language models regularly produce structurally inconsistent or incomplete optimization formulations, particularly in combinatorial settings. This paper evaluates whether a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline built on a curated synthetic dataset can meaningfully improve LLM optimization modeling performance. A total of 500 optimization problems were synthesized using seed descriptions from the Text2Zinc dataset and professional personas created using an LLM, specified in JSON and associated with validated Python solver scripts. These problems were encoded in a Chroma vector database. For each inference problem, semantically similar problems were retrieved and used as contextual guidance for a LangChain LLM agent. Three benchmark testbeds were used to evaluate the proposed pipeline under the Qwen 3 30B Instruct model. Accuracy rose from 40% to 72% on NL4OPT, 40% to 56% on MAMO Easy, and 32% to 56% on MAMO Complex. The use of semantically validated synthetic examples greatly improves both solution accuracy and structure. The combination of synthetic dataset generation with retrieval augmentation provides an effective alternative to fine-tuning, suggesting that domain-specific synthetic corpora paired with retrieval augmentation can serve as a practical pathway for deploying LLM-based optimization tools in real-world decision-support contexts without costly model retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）的管道，利用500个合成的优化问题构建向量数据库，在推理时检索语义相似的示例作为上下文指导，显著提升了LLM在优化建模任务上的准确性和结构一致性（准确率从40%提升至72%）。
AI.motivation: 优化建模和约束建模需要深厚的领域专业知识和建模语言熟练度，但现有大语言模型在组合优化场景中经常生成结构不一致或不完整的优化公式，需要一种无需昂贵微调的有效改进方法。
AI.method: 从Text2Zinc数据集提取种子描述，结合LLM创建的专业角色生成500个优化问题（以JSON格式表示），并关联经过验证的Python求解器脚本；将这些问题编码到Chroma向量数据库；推理时通过语义相似检索获取上下文指导，输入给LangChain LLM智能体（使用Qwen 3 30B Instruct模型）。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试集上：NL4OPT准确率从40%提升至72%，MAMO Easy从40%提升至56%，MAMO Complex从32%提升至56%。合成示例的语义验证显著改善了求解准确率和结构完整性。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据集生成与检索增强的组合为微调提供了一种有效替代方案，表明领域特定的合成语料库加上检索增强可以成为在真实决策支持场景中部署LLM优化工具的实际路径，且无需昂贵的模型重训练。

title: A Physics-Chemistry-Informed Neural Network (PCINN) for Real-Time Spatial-ALD Coverage Prediction and Reliable Kinetics Inversion
summary:
Spatial atomic layer deposition (SALD) is a leading atmospheric-pressure, high-throughput route to industrial ALD, but design and control are limited by the cost of predicting surface coverage: high-fidelity CFD is far too slow for operating-window scans, while analytic models miss transport modulation such as the gas curtain. We present a physics-chemistry-informed neural network (PCINN), a hybrid surrogate with CFD-level accuracy at real-time speed: a query returns coverage in about 7 ms, roughly 5x10^4 times faster than a CFD solve, reaching a test R^2_log = 0.998 (leave-one-out R^2_raw = 0.974) from only 30 training cases spanning four orders of magnitude in coverage.
  The architecture is not a black box: a small network learns only the operating-condition to near-wall concentration closure, while the known surface kinetics is a hard-coded, trainable chemistry layer integrated along the substrate trajectory. This single-scalar bottleneck keeps it accurate under sparse data, interpretable and invertible.
  We add a full identifiability analysis (Fisher information, profile likelihood). The adsorption energy E_ads and desorption rate k_des are robustly identifiable; k_ads is not separately identifiable at a single temperature (only k_ads*c_wall is). Across four temperatures the prefactor nu and E_ads bind along a weakly identifiable degeneracy valley of slope 0.065 eV/decade, derived analytically as k_B T_eff ln(10) and turned into a reliability diagnostic: a seven-chemistry mismatch matrix shows it is invariant under any single-Arrhenius mismatch and shifts only when a second thermally activated process appears, so a slope departure flags unmodelled site heterogeneity.
  Data come from simulation with known ground truth inverted by the same kinetic form, so the study verifies pipeline self-consistency and the identifiability boundary, not real parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种物理-化学信息神经网络（PCINN），作为空间原子层沉积（SALD）的混合代理模型，以约7毫秒的实时速度实现CFD级别的精度（比CFD快约5万倍），仅用30个训练案例即可达到R²_log=0.998。该架构通过单标量瓶颈将网络学习限制在操作条件到近壁浓度的映射，而表面动力学作为可训练的硬编码化学层，保证可解释性和可逆性。文章还进行了完整的可辨识性分析，发现E_ads和k_des稳健可辨识，而k_ads仅在单一温度下不可单独辨识。
AI.motivation: SALD作为工业规模ALD的主流大气压高通量路线，其设计和控制受限于表面覆盖率的预测成本：高保真CFD仿真太慢无法用于操作窗口扫描，而解析模型又无法捕捉气体幕等传输调制效应。需要一个兼具CFD精度和实时速度的替代模型。
AI.method: 提出PCINN混合代理模型：小规模神经网络仅学习操作条件到近壁浓度的映射（单标量瓶颈），已知表面动力学作为硬编码的可训练化学层沿基底轨迹积分。在此基础上采用Fisher信息和剖面似然进行完整可辨识性分析，并推导出Arrhenius参数退化谷的解析形式（k_B T_eff ln(10)）作为可靠性诊断工具。
AI.result: PCINN单次查询约7毫秒，比CFD快约5×10⁴倍，测试R²_log=0.998（留一法R²_raw=0.974），仅需30个训练案例覆盖四个数量级的覆盖率。可辨识性分析表明E_ads和k_des稳健可辨识；k_ads在单一温度下不可单独辨识（仅k_ads*c_wall可辨识）。跨四温度下，ν和E_ads沿斜率为0.065 eV/decade的弱可辨识退化谷排列，该斜率偏离可指示未建模的位点异质性。
AI.conclusion: PCINN实现了SALD覆盖率预测的实时CFD级精度，同时保持可解释性和可逆性；可辨识性框架为参数可靠性提供了严格诊断。由于数据来自已知真值的仿真（同一动力学形式反演），该研究验证的是管线自一致性和可辨识性边界，而非实际工艺参数。

title: What Transfers from Text to Vision? Capability Scaling Laws and Transfer Dynamics for VLMs
summary: Choosing the right large language model (LLM) backbone is the most consequential decision when building a vision-language model (VLM), yet it remains fundamentally unprincipled: compute-based scaling laws fail to generalize across model families, and no framework exists for directly predicting VLM performance before training begins. We propose the Capability-Driven Multimodal Scaling Law, the first cross-family framework that predicts VLM benchmark accuracy from directly observable textual capability. Given a low-dimensional capability score $S$ extracted from LLM textual benchmarks via PCA, we model VLM performance as a function of $S$, with a per-backbone transfer rate and an absorption rate that quantifies data-scaling efficiency. To fit and validate the framework, we train over 150 VLMs on 34 LLMs spanning 7 model families under a strictly controlled recipe. Evaluations on more than 200 textual and 50 multimodal benchmarks show that the law accurately extrapolates transfer rate from models up to 8B parameters to 72B-scale backbones, predicts full VLM training trajectories with high fidelity, and generalizes to entirely held-out model families. Beyond the scaling law, our analysis surfaces actionable insights: certain textual benchmarks negatively correlate with multimodal performance, exposing latent benchmark-gaming behavior; base LLMs outperform instruction-tuned counterparts as VLM backbones due to higher absorption rates and lower data-scaling decay; and different model families occupy distinct positions in the transfer--absorption space. The framework turns backbone selection from costly empirical sweeps into a principled, quantitative decision. Code and data are available at https://github.com/wangq-dev/CDMScaling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个跨模型家族的能力驱动多模态缩放定律（CDM Scaling Law），通过从LLM文本基准中提取低维能力分数S，预测VLM在下游基准上的表现。训练了150多个VLM、覆盖34个LLM和7个模型家族，验证了该定律在跨规模外推、训练轨迹预测和泛化到未知模型家族方面的有效性，并将骨干模型选择从昂贵的经验搜索转变为原则性的定量决策。
AI.motivation: 选择LLM骨干是构建VLM时最关键的决策，但现有方法缺乏原则性指导：基于计算量的缩放定律无法跨模型家族泛化，且缺乏在训练前直接预测VLM性能的框架。
AI.method: 提出能力驱动的多模态缩放定律（CDM Scaling Law）：通过PCA从LLM文本基准中提取低维能力分数S，将VLM性能建模为S的函数，引入每个骨干的迁移率（transfer rate）和量化数据缩放效率的吸收率（absorption rate）。在严格受控的训练方案下，训练150多个VLM，覆盖34个LLM、7个模型家族。
AI.result: 在200多个文本基准和50多个多模态基准上的评估表明：该定律能从8B参数模型外推迁移率至72B规模骨干；能高保真地预测完整VLM训练轨迹；能泛化到完全未见过的模型家族。此外发现若干可操作见解：某些文本基准与多模态性能负相关（暴露基准游戏行为）；基础LLM优于指令微调版本作为VLM骨干（吸收率更高、数据缩放衰减更低）；不同模型家族在迁移-吸收空间中占据不同位置。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将VLM骨干选择从昂贵的经验搜索转变为原则性的定量决策，为VLM架构设计提供了可预测、可解释的科学基础。

title: Memory Reward Inflation in Self-Improving LLM Agents
summary: Self-improving LLM agents increasingly learn from experience without updating any weights. Each episode is stored in an external memory, scored, and retrieved for similar future tasks to shape later behavior. Viewed through a reward lens, the stored score is a proxy reward for an implicit, non-parametric policy. Each retrieved episode then becomes a policy-improvement step whose reliability hinges on how that score is produced. In deployment, ground-truth labels are unavailable, so the stored reward is at best an LLM assessment. This substitution creates a failure mode, the *Echo Gap*, across the memory-based self-improving agents and model families studied. Incorrect episodes receive inflated rewards; thus, the agent preferentially reuses the very mistakes it has most confident in. Because the error compounds through memory rather than averaging out and the confirming judge's errors remain correlated with the original self-grading bias, so it cannot identify which memories are overvalued. The missing property is formalized as the *Error-Independence Assumption* (EIA), which we prove is a *necessary* condition for correcting the inflation, not merely a description of a good verifier: a usable signal must track truth *and* decorrelate its error from the memory bias, and the recoverable payoff is a closed-form function of exactly those two quantities. We further show the inflation compounds not only when retrieval ranks by the stored score but also under plain similarity retrieval which is the regime the deployed agent uses. Finally, the answer-free de-inflation algorithm LUCID delivers a consistent end-to-end gain on the BIRD text-to-SQL benchmark. It raises execution accuracy to $56.9\%$, above both a Memento-style self-graded agent ($54.0\%$, a $+2.9$-point mean gain across seeds) and a memory-less agent of identical architecture ($52.4\%$).

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于外部记忆的LLM智能体自我改进系统中存在的一个核心缺陷——"Echo Gap"现象。当存储的奖励分数由LLM自身评估而非真实标签时，错误样本会被高估，导致智能体优先复用其最自信的"错误记忆"。作者形式化定义了错误独立性假设（EIA），证明其是纠正奖励膨胀的必要条件，并提出无答案依赖的去膨胀算法LUCID，在BIRD文本转SQL基准上取得了优于基准方法的执行准确率。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体通过外部记忆从经验中学习（无需更新权重），但部署环境中无法获得真实标签，只能依赖LLM自身的评估作为代理奖励。这种替代会造成严重的奖励膨胀问题——智能体会优先复用其最自信的错误，且错误会通过记忆累积而非平均化，进一步加剧偏差。
AI.method: 作者首先形式化定义了"Echo Gap"失败模式，提出错误独立性假设（EIA）并证明其是纠正奖励膨胀的必要条件。EIA要求验证信号不仅要追踪真实质量，还必须使其错误与记忆偏差去相关。基于此理论，作者设计了LUCID算法——一种无答案依赖的去膨胀算法，用于校正存储记忆中的奖励通胀。
AI.result: LUCID算法在BIRD文本转SQL基准上实现了56.9%的执行准确率，超过Memento式自评分智能体（54.0%，平均提升+2.9个百分点）和无记忆的相同架构智能体（52.4%）。
AI.conclusion: 存储的评分必须同时满足正确性（追踪真实价值）和错误去相关（与记忆偏差独立）两个条件才能真正改善智能体行为。膨胀不仅发生在按存储评分排序的检索中，也发生在普通相似度检索下。LUCID算法验证了理论上可行的去膨胀策略可以带来一致的端到端性能提升。

title: Verifier-Induced Support Reshaping in On-Policy Optimization
summary: We show that on-policy reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can improve the current objective while making successful behaviors for later objectives too rare to sample and reinforce. We call this verifier-induced support reshaping and define effective rewardable support as successful trajectories reachable within a fixed rollout budget. Across two model families, we study this effect through repeated verifier-scored sampling and bidirectional training on mathematical reasoning and constrained instruction following, including sequential training with the opposite verifier. Math-RLVR raises average instruction-following success but reduces the number of prompts with any successful response under repeated sampling. On IFEval with Qwen3-8B-Base, pass@1 rises by 6.5 percentage points while best@32 falls by 9.8 percentage points, and the same divergence appears across both models and IF benchmarks. Conversely, IF-RLVR shifts math responses from step-by-step openings toward direct answers, lowers best@k across sampling budgets, and reduces reward variation for later Math-RLVR. Token-distribution analyses and controlled opening interventions show that these changes concentrate in the first few response tokens. RLVR mainly reranks openings already available in the base policy, and the selected opening causally affects math searchability. The tested reference-policy constraints, routing priors, and on-policy distillation preserve cross-task support only partially; MathIF and ReasonIF show that marginal gains translate only partly into responses that are both correct and constraint-following. Therefore, endpoint improvements do not guarantee future trainability or joint capability under on-policy optimization. Code is available at https://github.com/sylvain-wei/verifier-induced-support-reshaping

AI.tldr: 本文发现基于可验证奖励的在线强化学习（RLVR）在提升当前任务目标的同时，可能使后续目标的成功行为因采样稀少而难以被再次强化，这种现象被称为"验证器诱导的支持重塑"。研究表明RLVR主要重排基础策略中已有的响应开头，且所选开头会因果影响后续任务的可搜索性，端点改进并不能保证未来的可训练性或联合能力。
AI.motivation: 在线RLVR在提升当前目标时可能导致后续目标的成功行为过于稀少而无法采样和强化，这种"验证器诱导的支持重塑"效应可能损害模型的长期可训练性和多任务联合能力，但目前缺乏系统性研究。
AI.method: 跨两个模型家族，通过重复验证器评分采样和双向训练，在数学推理和约束指令跟随任务上进行研究，包括使用相反验证器的顺序训练。具体分析了Math-RLVR和IF-RLVR之间的相互影响，采用token分布分析和受控开头干预实验，并测试了参考策略约束、路由先验和在线蒸馏等缓解方法。
AI.result: Math-RLVR提高了平均指令跟随成功率但减少了多次采样下成功响应的提示数量；在IFEval上pass@1提升6.5个百分点而best@32下降9.8个百分点。IF-RLVR使数学响应从逐步解答转向直接答案，降低best@k和后续Math-RLVR的奖励变化。这些变化集中在响应开头几个token，验证器主要重排基础策略中已有的开头。参考策略约束等方法仅部分保留跨任务支持。
AI.conclusion: RLVR的端点改进不能保证未来的可训练性或联合能力，验证器诱导的支持重塑是在线优化中需要关注的重要现象，单独优化单一目标可能损害模型在多任务上的整体表现。

title: Role Steering of Language Models for Social Simulations
summary: Social simulations built from language-model agents need role-conditioned behavior that can be checked before agents are placed into a simulated population. We introduce an activation-steering screening workflow for role-conditioned agents: define a role profile, extract a role-specific direction, sweep four steering coefficients, evaluate role-profile alignment, and pass or flag each candidate configuration. On OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, we apply the workflow to a mixed 275-role inventory with 228 role-agnostic questions, GPT-4.1-mini prompted role references, and GPT-4.1-mini judges. Role-specific directions receive higher judged role-profile alignment than an assistant-axis directional control from prior persona-vector work, with mean overall scores of 63.2 versus 41.1 across the tested grid. They also preserve high lexical diversity, while the control drops sharply at larger coefficients. The role-level screen is the main practical output: most roles improve as steering increases, but 38 roles decline across all six measured dimensions, showing why simulation builders should choose coefficients per role rather than deploy a uniform high-strength setting. We make our code and evaluation artifacts available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/anonymous-research-code-5F03/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于激活方向引导（activation steering）的角色条件代理筛选工作流，先在语言模型代理进入仿真环境之前，对角色配置进行筛选验证，并在OLMo-3-7B-Instruct上对275个角色的混合库存进行了评估，结果表明角色特定方向比先前的persona-vector控制方法具有更高的角色画像对齐度，且能保留更高的词汇多样性。关键发现是大多数角色随引导强度提升而改善，但有38个角色在所有维度上退化，因此应根据角色个体选择引导系数，而非统一使用高强度设置。
AI.motivation: 社交仿真中由语言模型构建的代理需要具备角色条件的可验证行为，而现有方法缺乏在代理投入仿真种群之前对其进行系统性筛选的机制。作者希望引入一种能够在部署前检查角色条件行为的工作流，避免未经筛选的角色配置在仿真中产生不符合预期的表现。
AI.method: 提出激活引导筛选工作流，具体步骤包括：定义角色画像、提取角色特定方向、扫描四个引导系数、评估角色画像对齐度、对每个候选配置进行通过或标记。在OLMo-3-7B-Instruct模型上，使用275个角色的混合库存和228个角色无关问题，由GPT-4.1-mini生成角色参考并作为评判者，将角色特定方向与先前persona-vector研究中的助手轴方向控制进行对比。
AI.result: 角色特定方向在角色画像对齐度上显著优于控制方法（平均总分63.2对41.1），并在较大引导系数下保持较高的词汇多样性，而控制方法的词汇多样性急剧下降。角色层面的筛选是主要实用输出：大多数角色随引导强度增加而改善，但38个角色在所有六个测量维度上均出现退化，表明需要按角色选择引导系数。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了激活引导筛选工作流能够在部署前有效评估和筛选角色条件代理，并强调了按角色定制引导系数的重要性。研究提供代码和评估工件以供复现和进一步研究。

title: Request-Level Energy Attribution for Batched LLM Serving
summary: Batched LLM serving improves throughput but complicates energy accounting. GPU power telemetry is aggregate, whereas sustainability reporting, chargeback, and workload analysis often require request-level energy charges. Existing inference-energy benchmarks report model-, phase-, or token-level energy, and recent carbon-accounting work motivates Shapley fairness conceptually. Neither provides measured request-level ground truth, so how far the accounting rules used in practice deviate from a fair allocation has remained unknown. We present JouleShare, an attribution framework with two components. An offline harness establishes this ground truth by replaying request subsets under vLLM with a reproducible protocol, integrating GPU power telemetry, and computing exact Shapley energy for each request. A lightweight calibration model, JCalib, then learns to predict Shapley shares from cheap request features for use at serving time. Across 16 model/workload runs, token-proportional attribution differs from exact Shapley by 0.440 normalized L1 on average under static batching and by 0.458 under continuous batching, a gap that reproduces across three data-center GPUs. JCalib reduces this error to 0.116 under static batching and 0.177 under continuous batching, below even a standalone-measurement baseline that is unavailable online, while preserving exact batch-energy efficiency. Sampled Shapley extends the measured reference to larger group sizes, where the gap persists and a single offline calibration remains the most accurate deployable rule. The results show that token attribution is not a reliable proxy for marginal energy under batched execution, and that measured Shapley ground truth can calibrate low-cost request features toward fairer attribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JouleShare框架，通过离线精确Shapley能耗基准和轻量级校准模型JCalib，解决批量LLM推理服务中请求级能耗归因问题，发现token等比归因与精确Shapley平均偏差0.44-0.458，JCalib可将误差降至0.116-0.177。
AI.motivation: 批量LLM服务提升吞吐量但使能耗核算复杂化，GPU功率遥测是聚合的，而可持续性报告、计费和工作负载分析需要请求级能耗归因。现有研究和工具无法提供实测的请求级基准真值，导致实际使用的归因规则与公平分配的偏差程度未知。
AI.method: JouleShare包含两个组件：一是离线条带（offline harness），通过vLLM回放请求子集并结合GPU功率遥测计算精确Shapley能耗作为基准真值；二是轻量级校准模型JCalib，利用廉价请求特征在服务时预测Shapley份额。实验覆盖16个模型/工作负载组合，在三种数据中心GPU上进行静态批处理和连续批处理对比。
AI.result: token等比归因与精确Shapley在静态批处理下平均归一化L1偏差0.440，连续批处理下0.458。JCalib将误差降至静态0.116和连续0.177，优于在线不可用的独立测量基线，同时保持批处理能耗效率。采样Shapley扩展到更大组规模时偏差持续存在。
AI.conclusion: token归因不能作为批量执行下边际能耗的可靠代理，实测Shapley基准真值可以校准低成本的请求特征以实现更公平的能耗归因。

title: Similarity-Aware Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning removes the influence of user-specified training examples from a trained model, avoiding the need to retrain it from scratch. Localization-based methods improve unlearning efficiency by identifying a subset of influential model parameters. However, existing approaches select parameters based solely on forget-set importance, neglecting their role in retained dataset and often causing collateral damage to semantically similar retained examples. We address this limitation with a retain-aware localization method that considers parameter importance to both forgotten and retained data. We also introduce a retain-similar evaluation set, constructed using cosine similarity in the model embedding space, to directly measure collateral damage. Across eleven experimental settings on CIFAR-10 dataset and ResNet18 model, our method consistently reduces collateral damage while improving standard unlearning metrics, demonstrating the effectiveness of retain-aware localization for similarity-aware machine unlearning.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种保留感知的定位方法用于机器遗忘，该方法同时考虑参数对遗忘数据和保留数据的重要性，并引入保留相似评估集来直接衡量附带损伤，在CIFAR-10和ResNet18上的11种实验设置中显著减少附带损伤并提升遗忘指标。
AI.motivation: 现有基于定位的机器遗忘方法仅根据遗忘集的重要性选择参数子集，忽略了这些参数在保留数据集中的作用，常常对语义相似的保留样本造成附带损伤。
AI.method: 提出保留感知的定位方法，同时考虑参数对遗忘数据和保留数据的重要性；引入基于模型嵌入空间中余弦相似度构建的保留相似评估集，用于直接衡量附带损伤。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10数据集和ResNet18模型上的11种实验设置中，该方法一致地减少了附带损伤，同时改善了标准的机器遗忘指标。
AI.conclusion: 保留感知的定位方法对于相似性感知的机器遗忘是有效的，能够在提升遗忘效果的同时更好地保护语义相似的保留数据。

title: Exploring More to Solve More: Boosting Diversity in Text Diffusion Models via Entropy-Based Guidance
summary: Although diffusion models have revolutionized continuous domains like image synthesis through high quality generations and controllable guidance mechanisms, bringing this controllability to the discrete, sequential nature of text remains an open challenge. Meanwhile, current sampling strategies and guidance methods adjust token likelihoods without capturing the broader semantic landscape, leading to a suboptimal balance between fidelity and diversity. In this work, we introduce a novel training-free Semantic-Aware Kernel Entropy (SAKE) guidance method. Our method computes the order-2 Rényi entropy over a kernel Gram matrix that captures both cross-token semantic interactions and relative token positions. By linearizing this objective in the embedding space, we derive a tractable guidance signal that dynamically adjusts the sampling distribution, flattening it to encourage exploration during redundancy and sharpening it for fidelity when diverse. Empirical experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves a superior Pareto frontier between fidelity and diversity, and improves multi-sample performance on reasoning-intensive tasks, such as code and mathematics generation, compared to temperature scaling and discrete guidance baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SAKE（Semantic-Aware Kernel Entropy）的训练无关引导方法，通过计算核Gram矩阵上的二阶Rényi熵，在嵌入空间中线性化该目标，得到可处理的引导信号，动态调整采样分布以在保真度和多样性之间取得更好平衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在连续领域（如图像生成）取得了巨大成功，但将这种可控性迁移到离散的文本生成仍面临挑战。现有采样策略和引导方法仅调整词元似然，无法捕捉更广泛的语义景观，导致保真度与多样性之间的平衡不理想。
AI.method: 提出SAKE引导方法：1) 在核Gram矩阵上计算二阶Rényi熵，该矩阵同时捕捉跨词元语义交互和相对词元位置信息；2) 在嵌入空间中对目标函数进行线性化，推导出可计算的引导信号；3) 动态调整采样分布——在冗余时展平分布以鼓励探索，在多样化时锐化分布以保证保真度。
AI.result: 实验表明，SAKE方法在保真度和多样性之间取得了更优的Pareto前沿，并且在代码生成和数学生成等推理密集型任务的多样本性能上，优于温度缩放和离散引导基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SAKE作为一种无需训练的语义感知引导方法，有效解决了离散文本生成中引导控制与语义捕捉的难题，为文本扩散模型的采样质量提升提供了新思路。

title: Motif-Mamba: network motif improved mamba for long-range sequence modeling
comment: 9 pages of main text, 8 pages of appendix, 6 figures. Submitted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Efficient long-sequence modeling remains a central challenge for large language models, as self-attention scales quadratically with sequence length. Mamba offers a linear-time alternative through selective state space recurrence, but its predominantly diagonal state transitions restrict explicit interactions among state dimensions. We propose Motif-Mamba, a structured state space model that augments Mamba with a motif-constrained low-rank recurrent pathway. Inspired by the dynamics of three-node network motifs, the proposed pathway projects hidden states into a compact dynamical subspace, imposes motif-guided interactions, and maps the resulting dynamics back to the original state space. This design enhances cross-dimensional communication while preserving the linear-time recurrent structure of Mamba. Experiments on long-sequence extrapolation, language modeling benchmarks, and brain--computer interface decoding show consistent improvements over Mamba backbones, suggesting that motif-guided low-rank dynamics provide an effective structural prior for long-range sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Motif-Mamba，一种在Mamba基础上引入模体约束低秩循环通路的结构化状态空间模型。该方法通过将隐藏状态投影到紧凑动态子空间、施加模体引导的交互并映射回原始状态空间，增强了跨维度通信，同时保持Mamba的线性时间循环结构。实验在长序列外推、语言建模和脑机接口解码任务中均优于Mamba基线。
AI.motivation: Mamba虽然通过选择性的状态空间循环实现了线性时间复杂度的长序列建模，但其状态转移矩阵主要呈对角结构，限制了状态维度之间的显式交互，从而制约了模型的表达能力。作者希望通过引入一种结构化的低秩循环路径来弥补这一缺陷。
AI.method: Motif-Mamba的核心设计是增广Mamba架构，加入一个模体约束的低秩循环通路。具体地，该方法受三节点网络模体动力学启发，将隐藏状态投影到一个紧凑的动态子空间，在该子空间中施加模体引导的交互运算，然后将动力学结果映射回原始状态空间。这一设计在增强跨维度通信的同时，保留了Mamba的线性时间循环结构。
AI.result: 在长序列外推、语言建模基准测试以及脑机接口解码等实验任务上，Motif-Mamba均比Mamba骨干模型表现出一致的性能提升，验证了模体引导的低秩动力学作为长序列建模的有效结构先验。
AI.conclusion: 模体引导的低秩循环通路为Mamba类模型提供了一种有效的结构先验，能够在不牺牲线性时间复杂度的前提下增强状态维度间的显式交互，推动长序列建模性能的提升。

title: Stabilized Best-of-$K$ Training for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Leader Reward modifies POMO training to emphasize the best trajectory produced by repeated inference. We test a narrow extension: replace its binary leader/non-leader distinction with a stabilized rank signal indexed by a sampling budget $K$. With the POMO architecture, 3,050-epoch schedule, and TSP-100 test set held fixed, the Leader Reward reimplementation obtains $7.7662$ under 100-start, 8-augmentation greedy decoding, matching the reported $7.766$ at its displayed precision. Under independent sampling, the stabilized $K=8$ recipe lowers realized Best-of-8 cost in all three paired training seeds: $7.7944$ versus $7.8136$. This observation is estimation-only and decoder-specific: three seeds are below the six-seed testing floor, Leader Reward is better at sampled $K=1$, and it remains slightly better under its original augmented-greedy protocol. We make no unbiased-estimator, universal superiority, or state-of-the-art claim.

AI.tldr: 本文测试了Leader Reward的一种窄扩展：用基于采样预算K的稳定秩信号替代原有的二元领导者/非领导者区分。在固定POMO架构、3050轮训练计划和TSP-100测试集下，稳定化K=8方案在三个配对训练种子上均降低了Best-of-8成本（7.7944 vs 7.8136），但作者明确声明这只是估计性观察，不作普遍优越性或SOTA声明。
AI.motivation: 探索Leader Reward训练方法的窄扩展——将二元领导/非领导区分替换为基于采样预算K的稳定秩信号，以检验该变体是否能带来性能提升。
AI.method: 在POMO架构上，用稳定化秩信号（按采样预算K索引）替代Leader Reward的二元区分，采用3050轮训练计划和TSP-100测试集，分别在100-start、8-augmentation贪心解码和独立采样两种协议下进行评估。
AI.result: Leader Reward复现结果7.7662与报告值7.766匹配；稳定化K=8方案在三个配对训练种子上均优于基线（7.7944 vs 7.8136 Best-of-8成本），但优势仅在独立采样、K=8的解码协议下成立，且种子数低于六种子测试下限。
AI.conclusion: 该改进是估计性、解码器特定的观察结果：在采样K=1时Leader Reward更好，在其原始增强贪心协议下也略优。作者明确声明不作无偏估计量、普遍优越性或SOTA声明。

title: SLMs as Multi-Agent Routers: A Progressive SFT and Reinforcement Learning Approach
summary: Specialised retrieval agents typically surface higher quality results than general-purpose search, but selecting the optimal agent for a given query remains an open problem. Current approaches route queries based on inferred topic or intent, however intent-based selection is fundamentally limited: it does not incorporate signal from retrieved content, and cannot detect when a topically aligned agent produces low-relevance results. We address this by training a small language model via supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning to jointly perform agent selection and structured parameter generation for downstream tool calls, using a hierarchical reward function grounded in retrieval relevance along with query-agent topic alignment. This enables the model to learn task-dependent agent suitability from retrieval performance: which agents reliably yield high-relevance results for which query distributions, and when to redirect queries away from specialised agents despite surface-level topical overlap. On a targeted subset of such agent-query mismatches, the trained model achieves an NDCG@10 of 0.918 compared to 0.539 and 0.490 for two LLM baselines (Amazon Nova Lite and Claude Haiku 4.5) that route on intent alone. Overall, it achieves a mean NDCG@10 of 0.771 (+0.177 over Nova Lite, +0.219 over Haiku) with a mean selection latency of 120.1ms, an 82.4% reduction over Nova Lite.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过小语言模型进行智能体选择与工具调用的方法，利用监督微调加强化学习，结合基于检索相关性和查询-智能体主题对齐的分层奖励函数，克服了传统基于意图路由的局限，在NDCG@10和延迟上均显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于意图或主题的智能体路由方法存在根本性局限：无法利用检索内容的信号，也无法检测到主题对齐的智能体产生低相关性结果的问题，导致路由决策不准确。
AI.method: 训练一个小语言模型，先进行监督微调，再通过强化学习，联合执行智能体选择和下游工具调用的结构化参数生成。使用基于检索相关性和查询-智能体主题对齐的分层奖励函数，使模型从检索性能中学习任务相关的智能体适配性。
AI.result: 在智能体-查询不匹配的目标子集中，NDCG@10达到0.918（对比Amazon Nova Lite的0.539和Claude Haiku 4.5的0.490）；整体平均NDCG@10为0.771（较Nova Lite提升+0.177，较Haiku提升+0.219），平均选择延迟120.1ms，较Nova Lite降低82.4%。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明，通过将检索反馈纳入智能体选择决策，小语言模型能够在准确性和延迟上大幅超越基于意图路由的大语言模型基线，验证了以检索性能驱动的智能体选择范式的有效性。

title: Nova: An End-to-End MLIR Compiler for Deep Learning
summary: The performance of deep learning models at scale relies heavily on how effectively high-level mathematical operations are mapped to underlying physical hardware. While high-level tensor frameworks provide flexible abstractions for model design, their eager execution models inherently lack the whole-graph visibility and granular control over hardware and memory required to maximize physical hardware utilization natively. To bridge this gap, we designed Nova, an automated end-to-end JIT compiler whose defining purpose is to achieve absolute control over this hardware mapping: fusing operations across operation boundaries, optimizing complex memory hierarchies, and tuning execution down to the register level. By capturing eager executions and unifying forward and backward passes into a single value-semantic dialect, Nova unlocks aggressive whole-graph optimizations. It then utilizes an Analytic Configurator to deterministically derive optimal execution schedules based on arithmetic intensity, dropping search time to zero. Backed by a structural hashing runtime, Nova synthesizes fine-grained kernels directly from the computation's structure. In our evaluations on an RTX 3060, Nova matches or modestly exceeds cuBLAS and XLA on TF32 matmuls on most shapes, maintaining a stringent < 5e-4 relative error. At the model level, Nova achieves up to 10.6% greater throughput than PyTorch and 4.4% greater than XLA on a 42-million parameter model, without compromising on numerical fidelity. Crucially, by reducing the memory footprint by up to 29% relative to PyTorch, Nova successfully trains a 144-million parameter model at 17,900 tokens/s where PyTorch encounters Out-Of-Memory (OOM) failures on the same 12 GB consumer GPU.

AI.tldr: Nova是一个端到端JIT编译器，通过将前向和反向传播统一为单一值语义方言、使用解析配置器零搜索确定最优执行调度、以及基于结构哈希运行时合成细粒度内核，实现了对硬件映射的绝对控制。在RTX 3060上，Nova在TF32矩阵乘法上匹配或略超cuBLAS和XLA，模型吞吐量相比PyTorch提升最高10.6%，内存占用降低29%，并能在12GB消费级GPU上训练PyTorch因OOM而失败的1.44亿参数模型。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型规模扩大时，高性能张量框架的急切执行模式缺乏全局图可视性和对硬件/内存的细粒度控制，无法原生最大化物理硬件利用率，导致高层数学运算到底层硬件的映射效率不高。
AI.method: Nova采用三条核心策略：(1) 捕获急切执行并将前向和反向传播统一到单一值语义方言，解锁全局优化；(2) 利用解析配置器（Analytic Configurator）基于算术强度确定性地推导最优执行调度，将搜索时间降至零；(3) 使用结构哈希运行时根据计算结构直接合成细粒度内核。
AI.result: 在RTX 3060上，Nova在大多数形状的TF32矩阵乘法上匹配或略超cuBLAS和XLA（相对误差<5e-4）；在4200万参数模型上，吞吐量比PyTorch高10.6%、比XLA高4.4%；内存占用相比PyTorch减少高达29%，能以17,900 tokens/s训练1.44亿参数模型，而PyTorch在相同12GB GPU上遭遇OOM。
AI.conclusion: Nova通过自动化端到端JIT编译实现了对硬件映射的绝对控制，在不牺牲数值精度的前提下同时提升吞吐量和内存效率，验证了基于解析推导而非搜索的编译优化路径在消费级GPU上的可行性和有效性。

title: Abstention as an Action Can Kill Both the Reward Gradient and the KL Anchor: Collapse Law and Repair for Error-Penalized Reinforcement Learning
summary: Error-penalized scoring rules ($+1$ for a correct answer, $-λ$ for a wrong one, $0$ for abstaining) are increasingly prescribed against hallucination: a rational agent facing such a rule answers exactly when its correctness probability exceeds Chow's threshold $t^\ast=λ/(1+λ)$. We prove that a KL-anchored gradient learner can do the opposite. When abstention is a discrete action, the reward gradient and the anchor's restoring force are throttled by the same gate-saturation factor and die together: under explicit conditions (among them, blanket answering loses score in expectation and prompts share a bounded readout) the model drifts toward refusing everything, its mean training reward rising to zero like $1/t$ in training time $t$, so the curve reads as improvement while coverage collapses. The advantage estimator compounds the failure: in its sparse-answer regime, group normalization silently replaces every designed penalty with an effective penalty of one, moving the learned threshold from $t^\ast$ to $1/2$. The repair is structural: train a mandatory confidence report with a strictly proper score plus a correctness reward, and abstain only at deployment by thresholding the report. The always-emitted report has no gate to saturate, so no shared factor can kill its reward gradient and its anchor together, and its calibrated optimum is attracting. Simulations confirm every prediction, and experiments on language models at two scales confirm the mechanism live: the rule silences questions the models demonstrably still solve within ten optimizer steps, an ablation isolates the cause, and report-level training raises coverage, accuracy, and calibration together.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了基于KL锚定的梯度学习者在面对错误惩罚评分规则时，可能产生与预期相反的行为——模型会趋向于拒绝回答所有问题，即使训练奖励表面上在提升（趋近于零），实际覆盖率却崩溃。作者提出结构性修复方案：训练时强制输出置信度报告（使用严格适当评分加正确性奖励），仅在部署时通过阈值化报告来实现弃权。
AI.motivation: 错误惩罚评分规则（答对+1，答错-λ，弃权0）被广泛用于抑制幻觉，其理论保证是理性主体会在正确概率超过Chow阈值时回答。然而，作者想探究在实际的梯度学习场景下，这种规则是否真的能达到预期效果——特别是在离散弃权动作与门饱和效应相互作用的情况下。
AI.method: (1) 理论上证明了KL锚定梯度学习者在离散弃权动作下，奖励梯度和锚定恢复力会被相同的门饱和因子压制并同时消失，导致模型在显式条件下漂移向全拒绝状态；(2) 分析了优势估计器（advantage estimator）的稀疏回答机制，发现组归一化会把设计惩罚替换为有效惩罚1，将学习阈值从t*移动到1/2；(3) 提出结构性修复：训练强制置信度报告（严格适当评分+正确性奖励），部署时才阈值化弃权；(4) 通过模拟和两种规模的语言模型实验验证。
AI.result: 模拟验证了所有理论预测；语言模型实验确认了机制在真实场景中的有效性：评分规则在十步优化内就压制了模型仍能解决的问题，消融实验隔离了原因，报告级训练同时提升了覆盖率、准确率和校准度。
AI.conclusion: 直接使用错误惩罚评分规则训练离散弃权的梯度学习者会出现反直觉的失败模式（奖励上升但覆盖率崩溃），而将弃权从训练中剥离、改为部署期对强制置信度报告做阈值化，是结构性正确的修复方案，能同时改善覆盖率、准确率与校准。

title: XL-DocBench: Benchmarking Evidence-Grounded Extra-Long Document Understanding
summary: Real-world document tasks often ask professionals to answer questions from annual reports, regulations, clinical guidelines, and technical manuals that span hundreds or thousands of pages. Some questions also require comparing related reports. Reliable long-document understanding is therefore a prerequisite for using LLMs in compliance, clinical, financial, and engineering workflows, where decisions must be traceable to specific evidence pages and the cost of an unsupported answer is high -- yet most existing benchmarks still measure short-context or single-page QA. We introduce XL-DocBench, a fully human-verified benchmark for extra-long document understanding, with 1,519 retained questions from six professional domains and contexts up to 2,303 pages. XL-DocBench goes beyond page-level lookup. 1,103 examples (72.6\%) use multiple evidence pages. The final set also includes 556 questions (36.6\%) that use tables, charts, or figures, and 165 questions (10.9\%) that require evidence from multiple documents. Each question has one of twelve reasoning labels, expert-annotated evidence pages, a typed verification rule, and an answer format, including 218 None-answer cases. We build the benchmark with a tree-guided synthesis pipeline followed by artifact filters and full verification by 194 human experts. By coupling extra-long professional contexts with page-level evidence and typed rules, XL-DocBench fills a gap left by prior single-page, short multi-page, or text-only long-context benchmarks, and lets future work attribute system failures to retrieval, evidence use, or rule following rather than to a single leaderboard score. The results show that current systems still struggle with long contexts, multi-page evidence, and structured reasoning over professional documents.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了XL-DocBench，一个全新的人类全面验证的超长文档理解基准，包含来自六个专业领域的1,519个问题，上下文最长可达2,303页。该基准强调多证据页面（72.6%）、结构化数据使用（36.6%）和多文档推理（10.9%），并配有专家标注的证据页面、类型化验证规则和12种推理标签，弥补了现有基准在超长专业文档理解评估上的空白。
AI.motivation: 现实中的专业文档任务（如年报、法规、临床指南和技术手册）往往跨越数百或数千页，且部分问题需要跨文档比较，决策必须可追溯到特定证据页面。然而现有基准大多只衡量短上下文或单页问答，难以满足合规、临床、金融和工程等高风险场景对长文档理解能力评估的需求。
AI.method: 构建XL-DocBench采用树引导的合成流程（tree-guided synthesis pipeline），配合工件过滤器和194位人类专家的全面验证。基准包含12种推理标签、专家标注的证据页面、类型化验证规则和答案格式（含218个None-answer案例）。评估维度包括检索、证据使用和规则遵循，而非单一的排行榜分数。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，当前系统在长上下文、多页面证据以及结构化推理方面仍然表现不佳。该基准通过将超长专业上下文与页面级证据和类型化规则相结合，能够将系统失败归因于检索、证据使用或规则遵循等具体环节。
AI.conclusion: XL-DocBench填补了此前单页、短多页或纯文本长上下文基准留下的空白，为未来研究提供了更细粒度的失败归因能力，可用于改进LLM在专业文档理解任务中的可靠性和可追溯性。

title: SIRIN: A Unified Toolkit for Detecting Contextual Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented and Memory-Grounded LLM Systems
summary:
SIRIN (Semantic Inconsistency Recognition and Inspection Nexus) is a unified toolkit and interactive web UI for detecting contextual hallucinations (fluent, plausible responses unsupported by the provided evidence) in retrieval-augmented, agentic, and memory-grounded LLM systems. SIRIN unifies three detector paradigms (representation probing, uncertainty estimation, and judge-style verification) and the complementary task of pre-generation query answerability under one interface, configuration system, and evaluation pipeline, supporting response- and span-level inspection in both white-box and black-box settings. The web UI enables live analysis of user-supplied context-query-answer triples through hallucination scores, unsupported-span highlighting, and side-by-side detector comparison, with a lightweight plug-in design for adding new detectors. We demonstrate SIRIN on hallucination detection, query answerability, and as a faithfulness gate within long-term memory systems.
  The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/sb-ai-lab/SIRIN.

AI.tldr: SIRIN是一个统一的工具包和交互式Web界面，用于检测检索增强、代理型和记忆驱动的LLM系统中的上下文幻觉（即流畅但缺乏证据支持的响应）。它统一了三种检测器范式（表征探测、不确定性估计和裁判式验证），并支持生成前查询可回答性评估，适用于白盒和黑盒场景，提供响应级和跨度级检查功能。
AI.motivation: 检索增强、代理型和记忆驱动的LLM系统容易产生上下文幻觉——即流畅但缺乏证据支持的响应。现有工具往往分散、异构且缺乏统一接口，难以系统性地检测和评估此类幻觉问题，需要一个统一的工具包来整合多种检测范式并进行评估。
AI.method: SIRIN将三种检测器范式（表征探测、不确定性估计和裁判式验证）以及生成前查询可回答性任务统一到一个接口、配置系统和评估流水线下。提供响应级和跨度级检查，支持白盒和黑盒设置，并配备交互式Web UI用于实时分析上下文-查询-答案三元组，包括幻觉分数、未支持跨度高亮和并排检测器对比，采用轻量级插件设计以便添加新检测器。
AI.result: SIRIN在幻觉检测、查询可回答性评估以及作为长期记忆系统中的忠实性门控机制方面得到了展示验证。源代码已在GitHub上公开。
AI.conclusion: SIRIN提供了一个统一、可扩展且交互式的幻觉检测框架，能够在多种LLM系统架构下实现上下文幻觉的系统性检测，并支持未来的检测器扩展。

title: Agentic Bayesian Optimization through Surrogate-Augmented Autoresearch
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) has become the standard tool for sample-efficient optimization and owes its efficiency to uncertainty-aware search driven by generic statistical priors. Richer domain priors can improve BO in principle, but encoding them through tailored kernels or problem structure is difficult and rarely done in practice. LLMs can help sidestep this difficulty by making informal priors from natural language, code, and documentation directly available to the optimizer.
