However, existing LLM-based BO methods either insert the LLM into a fixed role (surrogate, acquisition proxy, or configuration interface) or hand it broad control, sacrificing the systematic exploration that makes BO reliable. We introduce agentic Bayesian optimization: a paradigm in which an LLM agent is the central decision maker in the BO loop while a Bayesian backend provides the uncertainty-aware optimization substrate. The agent configures the problem, queries the backend, selects and commits evaluations, and can revise the optimization strategy during the run by tightening bounds, switching acquisition functions, proposing targeted evaluations, or even reframing the problem following new instructions or observed evidence. We instantiate this idea in Sara, a surrogate-augmented autoresearch agent, and lenz, a modular BoTorch-based backend that the agent can inspect and modify through a structured interface. Across synthetic and real-world benchmarks, Sara preserves the reliability of state-of-the-art BO without prior knowledge, outperforms LLM-based baselines, and uses natural-language priors to improve beyond standard BO. We further demonstrate the practical value of agentic BO in dynamic settings, where Sara reconfigures the full optimization problem on the fly as requirements change, a capability not previously available in standard BO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"智能体贝叶斯优化"（agentic Bayesian optimization）范式，将LLM作为BO循环中的核心决策者，同时用贝叶斯后端提供不确定性感知的优化基底。作者实现了Sara（代理增强的自动研究代理）和lenz（模块化BoTorch后端），实验表明该方法在保持标准BO可靠性的同时，能利用自然语言先验超越现有方法，并支持动态问题重配置。
AI.motivation: 传统BO依赖通用统计先验，难以编码丰富的领域先验知识；虽然LLM可以获取非正式先验，但现有LLM-BO方法要么将LLM固定在特定角色（如替代模型、采集函数代理或配置接口），要么赋予其过度控制权而牺牲BO的系统性探索优势。需要一个既能利用LLM灵活先验知识，又能保持BO可靠性的方法。
AI.method: 提出agentic BO范式：LLM智能体作为BO循环的核心决策者，负责配置问题、查询贝叶斯后端、选择并提交评估、在运行过程中动态修改优化策略（收紧边界、切换采集函数、提出定向评估、重新定义问题等）。具体实现了两个组件：Sara（智能体）和lenz（基于BoTorch的模块化后端，可通过结构化接口被智能体检查和修改）。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界基准测试中，Sara无需先验知识即可保持SOTA BO的可靠性，优于基于LLM的基线方法，并利用自然语言先验超越标准BO。在动态设置中，Sara能在需求变化时实时重新配置完整优化问题，展现了标准BO不具备的能力。
AI.conclusion: Agentic BO范式成功融合了LLM的灵活推理能力与贝叶斯优化的系统性探索优势，不仅提升了优化性能，还赋予了优化器动态适应问题变化的新能力，为BO的实用化提供了新的方向。

title: Trustworthiness Costs of Domain Adaptation in Small Language Models:A Cross-Architecture Empirical Study
comment: 13 pages, 7 tables, 2 appendices (Reproducibility Checklist; Software and Data Availability). Code, model checkpoints, and datasets publicly available at https://github.com/rbpdlf/slm-trw
summary: Domain adaptation of small language models (SLMs) has emerged as a practical strategy for deploying capable NLP systems in resource-constrained, high-stakes environments including healthcare, legal services, and financial analysis. While performance gains from parameter-efficient fine-tuning are well characterised, the corresponding impact on trustworthiness (factual calibration and adversarial robustness) remains poorly understood. This paper presents the first systematic cross-domain, cross-architecture empirical study quantifying the trustworthiness cost of domain adaptation across three SLM architectures (TinyLlama 1B, Gemma-2 2B, Llama 3.2 1B), three domains (healthcare, legal, finance), two training-data conditions (benign and adversarially perturbed), and four fine-tuning strategies (baseline LoRA, Safety-DPO, Dark Experience Replay, and Task Arithmetic LoRA, TA-LoRA). Trustworthiness is evaluated through TruthfulQA MC2 (factual calibration) and HarmBench ASR (adversarial robustness) across all 216 experimental configurations with three random seeds. Three principal findings emerge. First, baseline QLoRA domain adaptation produces minimal TruthfulQA MC2 change across all model-domain combinations (mean |Delta TQA| < 0.02). Second, adversarially perturbed training data consistently improves domain adaptation quality (Delta loss approximately -0.040) without worsening trustworthiness benchmarks. Third, none of the three safety-preserving strategies reduced adversarial harm susceptibility: Safety-DPO was effectively neutral (mean Delta ASR < 0.001), while Dark ER and TA-LoRA increased mean HarmBench ASR by +0.171 and +0.155 respectively in safety-aligned models (Gemma-2 2B, Llama 3.2 1B), with individual configurations exceeding +0.45. These results challenge the assumption that replay-based and arithmetic-merge strategies transfer alignment to domain-adapted SLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地量化了小型语言模型（SLM）领域自适应中的可信度代价，涵盖3种架构、3个领域、2种训练数据条件和4种微调策略共216个实验配置。研究发现：基线QLoRA领域自适应对事实校准影响极小；对抗扰动数据反而提升适配质量且不损害可信度；三种安全保持策略均未能有效降低对抗性危害。
AI.motivation: 虽然参数高效微调（PEFT）在SLM领域自适应中的性能提升已被充分研究，但其对可信度（事实校准和对抗鲁棒性）的影响仍未被系统量化。在医疗、法律、金融等高危场景中部署SLM时，这一缺失令人担忧，亟需实证研究来揭示领域自适应的可信度成本。
AI.method: 作者设计了跨架构（TinyLlama 1B、Gemma-2 2B、Llama 3.2 1B）、跨领域（医疗、法律、金融）、跨训练数据条件（良性/对抗扰动）和跨微调策略（基线LoRA、Safety-DPO、Dark Experience Replay、TA-LoRA）的系统性实验，使用TruthfulQA MC2和HarmBench ASR分别评估事实校准与对抗鲁棒性，共216个配置×3个随机种子。
AI.result: 三个主要发现：(1) 基线QLoRA领域自适应对TruthfulQA MC2影响极小（平均|Delta TQA|<0.02）；(2) 对抗扰动数据使领域适配质量提升（Delta loss约-0.040）且不恶化可信度指标；(3) Safety-DPO几乎中性（Delta ASR<0.001），但Dark ER和TA-LoRA分别使安全对齐模型的HarmBench ASR平均增加+0.171和+0.155，个别配置超过+0.45。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果挑战了「重放式」和「算术合并式」策略能够将对齐能力迁移到领域自适应SLM的假设。安全保持策略在领域自适应场景下不仅未能降低对抗危害敏感性，反而可能显著增加风险，这对于部署关键领域SLM的实际选择具有重要意义。

title: Linguistic Context Recodes Visual Representations in Vision-Language Models
summary: Goal-directed visual processing is a hallmark of human visual intelligence, resulting in representations that support downstream tasks such as categorization or search. Though vision-language models (VLMs) are often faced with these same tasks, their ability to recode visual representations when presented with goal-directed language remains poorly characterized. Indeed, prior work largely treats visual representations in VLMs as static repositories of visual information that are manipulated by language representations. In the present work, we provide evidence for two concrete instances of language-induced recoding of visual representations. First, we identify an abstract reference representation that denotes which objects are goal-relevant under a natural language prompt. We extract contrastive steering vectors corresponding to this reference representation and demonstrate that they are causally implicated in model predictions. These reference representations are abstract in that they generalize to different objects, different task contexts, and even from synthetic to naturalistic images. Second, we demonstrate language-induced attribute modulation: later layers selectively amplify goal-relevant attributes in visual representations of objects. We demonstrate this phenomenon across a range of different prompts. Finally, we provide a causal intervention that demonstrates that attribute modulation mediates a VLM's response distribution. Together, our results support a more dynamic account of cross-modality processing in VLMs -- rather than vision tokens serving as static repositories of information, they are modulated to support queries articulated in language.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了视觉语言模型（VLMs）中语言如何动态重编码视觉表征的问题，发现两种具体的语言诱导重编码现象：一是存在抽象参考表征用于标记目标相关对象，可通过对比转向向量进行因果干预；二是后期层会选择性放大视觉表征中的目标相关属性。两项因果干预实验表明这些重编码机制确实介导了模型预测。
AI.motivation: 以往研究将VLM中的视觉表征视为静态信息仓库，由语言表征进行操作，但缺乏对语言如何动态重编码视觉表征的系统性刻画。理解这一机制对于揭示VLM跨模态处理原理至关重要。
AI.method: 提取与抽象参考表征对应的对比转向向量，验证其对模型预测的因果作用；通过分析后期层的表征变化，检测语言诱导的属性调制现象；最后通过因果干预实验确认属性调制介导VLM响应分布。
AI.result: 发现参考表征具有抽象性，能泛化到不同对象、不同任务情境，甚至从合成图像泛化到自然图像。属性调制现象在多种提示条件下均稳定存在，且因果干预证实其确实介导模型响应。
AI.conclusion: VLMs中的视觉表征并非静态信息仓库，而是被动态调制以支持自然语言查询。这一发现支持跨模态处理的动态模型，对理解VLM工作机制具有重要意义。

title: Neural operator learning for collision-aware trajectory planning of spacecraft swarms
comment: 27 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to Nature Machine Intelligence. Video abstract included as ancillary file
summary: Autonomous spacecraft swarms must plan fuel-efficient, collision-free maneuvers in increasingly congested orbits, yet classical trajectory optimization scales poorly as pairwise safety constraints multiply with swarm size, and learning-based planners rarely transfer across swarm sizes or debris densities. Here we introduce a permutation-equivariant neural operator that maps distributions of spacecraft, targets and debris to collision-aware trajectories for an entire swarm in a single forward pass, paired with a batched Gauss-Newton finish that enforces exact orbital dynamics. The operator is trained without optimal-trajectory labels, combining self-supervised physics objectives with adversarial threats generated against its own rollouts. Trained on ten spacecraft, it generalizes zero-shot to swarms of 1,000 amid more than 11,000 catalogued objects, matching a per-agent optimal-control solver's accuracy, evading worst-case threats that a debris-blind baseline cannot, and reducing proximity within the swarm several-fold. Physics-grounded operator learning thus offers a fast, scalable alternative to optimal control for crowded orbits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种置换等变神经算子，可将航天器、目标和碎片的分布映射为整个星群的避碰轨迹，并通过批量高斯-牛顿收尾确保轨道动力学精确性。该算子无需最优轨迹标签，结合自监督物理目标与对抗威胁训练，从10颗航天器零样本泛化到1000颗航天器及11000多个编目物体，匹配最优控制求解器精度，优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 经典轨迹优化方法在星群规模增大时，由于成对安全性约束数量激增而难以扩展；学习型规划器又难以在不同星群规模和碎片密度间迁移。这促使作者寻求一种既能高效规划、又可扩展且具良好泛化性的新方法。
AI.method: 提出置换等变神经算子，将航天器、目标与碎片的分布直接映射为整个星群的避碰轨迹（单次前向传播完成）；配合批量高斯-牛顿收尾以强制执行精确的轨道动力学；训练采用自监督物理目标加上对自身轨迹生成的对抗威胁，无需最优轨迹标签。
AI.result: 在10颗航天器上训练后，可零样本泛化至1000颗航天器及11000余个编目物体场景；匹配单智能体最优控制求解器的精度，能规避碎屑盲基线无法应对的最坏情况威胁，并将星群内部邻近距离降低数倍。
AI.conclusion: 基于物理的算子学习为拥挤轨道环境下的最优控制提供了一种快速、可扩展的替代方案，在效率、精度与泛化能力上均具有显著优势。

title: Predicting Startup Exit from Textual Descriptors - A Computational Linguistics Framework
summary: This study shows that textual descriptors alone can predict early-stage startup success, defined as Exit, without relying on contextual, financial, or human capital variables. Using venture capital-curated datasets covering 7,419 startups over 20 years, the research isolates text-based framing variables and engineers 850 features through startup narrative mapping. Data subsets and vector embeddings are evaluated for statistical significance, followed by supervised machine learning experiments across six models. LightGBM achieved the highest predictive performance (F1 = 0.48), while textual descriptors alone achieved F1 = 0.30, confirming the standalone predictive value of founder narratives. Feature analysis shows that optimized densities of hyping markers, including adjectives, jargon, and buzzwords, are associated with higher Exit probability, whereas excessive statement or name length reduces it. The study also introduces a quantifiable Hyping Score for venture capital applications, demonstrating that startup framing provides measurable signals for predicting Exit under conditions of high information asymmetry.

AI.tldr: 本研究证明仅凭文本描述即可预测早期初创企业成功（退出），利用风险投资数据集中的7,419家初创公司，构建850个文本特征，LightGBM达到F1=0.48，纯文本描述达到F1=0.30，并引入可量化的"炒作评分"（Hyping Score）用于风险投资应用。
AI.motivation: 在高度信息不对称的早期投资环境中，传统依赖财务和人力资本变量的预测方法存在局限，研究者希望探索创始人叙事文本本身是否蕴含可预测初创企业成功（退出）的独立信号。
AI.method: 使用风投精选数据集覆盖7,419家初创公司（20年跨度），通过初创企业叙事映射工程技术构建850个文本特征，对数据子集和向量嵌入进行统计显著性评估，采用六种监督机器学习模型进行实验，其中LightGBM表现最佳，并进行特征重要性分析。
AI.result: LightGBM实现最高预测性能（F1=0.48），纯文本描述符独立达到F1=0.30，验证了创始人叙事的独立预测价值。特征分析显示，适度密度的炒作标记（形容词、行话、流行词）与更高退出概率相关，而过长的陈述或名称长度则产生负面影响。
AI.conclusion: 创业者的文本框架本身提供了在信息不对称条件下预测退出的可测量信号，研究引入的Hyping Score可作为风险投资领域的实用工具，填补了纯文本分析在早期创业成功预测中的空白。

title: RAG-TESTER: Automated End-to-End Testing of Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to use external and domain-specific knowledge, but its reliability depends on the interaction between the generative model, embedding model, retrieval mechanism, and prompt construction strategy. We present RagTester, an automated end-to-end testing approach for RAG systems. RagTester generates retrieval documents, test inputs, and expected outputs; executes the tests; and evaluates the resulting answers using an LLM as a judge. Its test-generation strategy targets complex passages, unsupported queries, and document-coverage criteria. We evaluate RagTester using eight LLMs and six embedding models, yielding 24 compatible configurations, and compare it with a baseline test-input generator. Across 72,000 test executions, RagTester detected 21,633 failures, 6.6% more than the baseline, and outperformed it in 20 of the 24 configurations. The detected failures include inaccurate retrieval, unsupported answers, incomplete use of retrieved context, and difficulties interpreting complex passages. These results show that coverage-oriented test generation can effectively expose failures caused by the interaction between retrieval and generation components and support the assessment of RAG configurations before deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RagTester，一种面向RAG系统的自动化端到端测试方法，通过生成检索文档、测试输入和预期输出，并利用LLM作为评判器来评估RAG系统的可靠性。在24种配置、72,000次测试执行中，RagTester检测出21,633个故障，比基线方法多6.6%，并在20/24种配置中表现优于基线。
AI.motivation: RAG系统的可靠性取决于生成模型、嵌入模型、检索机制和提示词构建策略之间的交互，但目前缺乏端到端的自动化测试方法来系统性地暴露这些组件交互导致的故障。
AI.method: RagTester采用四阶段流程：生成检索文档、测试输入和预期输出，执行测试，并使用LLM作为评判器评估答案。其测试生成策略针对复杂段落、无依据查询和文档覆盖准则三类场景。
AI.result: 在8个LLM和6个嵌入模型组成的24种配置上，通过72,000次测试执行，RagTester检测出21,633个故障（比基线多6.6%），在20/24配置中优于基线。检测到的故障包括不准确的检索、无依据的回答、检索上下文使用不完整以及复杂段落解释困难等。
AI.conclusion: 面向覆盖的测试生成方法能有效暴露检索与生成组件交互导致的故障，支持RAG配置部署前的评估与选择。

title: Ensemble of Unsupervised Deep Learning for Clustering Imbalanced Tabular Data
summary: Data imbalance poses a major challenge in supervised classification, where the majority-class bias contributes to false negatives and overestimates classification accuracy. Unsupervised deep clustering can be immune to class imbalance because representation learning for clustering is performed without class labels. Deep clustering has been proposed for images, languages, and graphs, while its application to tabular data has only emerged recently. This paper is among the first to examine the performance of state-of-the-art deep clustering methods under varying levels of data imbalance. We introduce two novel cluster ensemble approaches: one aggregates deep clustering assignments across different embedding dimensions, and the other applies majority voting to the best-performing clustering algorithms. Experiments on 16 binary tabular datasets with varying and artificially induced levels of imbalance reveal distinct strengths of different deep clustering methods. On average, our ensemble methods outperform individual clustering methods in ACC, NMI, and ARI scores, offering greater resilience to data imbalance when identifying ground-truth classes without supervision. Therefore, in an imbalanced data scenario, deep clustering can serve as a strong alternative to supervised classification.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究了深度聚类方法在数据不平衡场景下的表现，提出了两种新颖的聚类集成方法（跨嵌入维度聚合和多数投票），在16个二分类表格数据集上验证了集成方法在ACC、NMI和ARI指标上优于单个聚类方法，表明深度聚类可成为不平衡数据下监督分类的强有力替代方案。
AI.motivation: 监督分类在数据不平衡时存在多数类偏置问题，导致假阴性和准确率高估。深度聚类因无需类标签进行表示学习，理论上对类别不平衡具有免疫性，但其在不平衡数据下的表现尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 提出两种聚类集成方法：(1)跨不同嵌入维度聚合深度聚类分配结果；(2)对表现最佳的聚类算法应用多数投票。在16个具有人工诱导不平衡级别的二分类表格数据集上进行实验。
AI.result: 实验显示不同深度聚类方法在不同不平衡水平下各具优势。集成方法在ACC、NMI和ARI指标上平均优于单个聚类方法，对数据不平衡具有更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 深度聚类在不平衡数据场景下可作为监督分类的有力替代方案，集成策略能进一步提升无监督方式识别真实类别的能力。

title: Neural Circuit Function Inference with LLMs
summary: The success of connectome mapping now shifts the challenge of understanding the nervous system to the interpretation of neural circuits. Here, we devise a new automated method, LLantia (LLM automated neural circuit inference and analysis), to systematically infer neural circuit function and the role of its component neural cell types. Our approach distills descriptions of cell type function from the literature and, in combination with the connectome, then infers the function for all other cell types, which serves as a basis for subsequent neural circuit function inference. Results are structured hierarchically, with different possible circuit functions organised under multiple possible behavioural and physiological contexts, and each circuit function composed of subcircuit descriptions alongside relevant cell types to facilitate both backtracking to known, published information and support further experimental research. We illustrate our method by inferring cell type function for all cell types of the adult fruit fly brain and for select broader circuits within, and validate our findings, including by cross-checking with literature published after the release date of our analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为LLantia的全自动方法，结合脑连接组数据和文献中已发表的细胞类型功能描述，系统地推断神经回路功能及其组成细胞类型的功能。该方法在果蝇成体大脑上进行了验证，结果具有层次结构，可回溯到已知文献信息。
AI.motivation: 连接组图谱绘制已成功完成，但神经回路的功能解读成为新的挑战。需要一种自动化方法系统性地推断神经回路功能及其中各细胞类型的作用，以弥合连接组结构和功能之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: LLantia方法从文献中提取细胞类型功能描述作为先验知识，结合连接组数据推断所有其他细胞类型的功能，进而基于此推断神经回路的功能。结果以层次化结构组织，涵盖多个行为与生理学背景，每个回路功能由子回路描述及相关细胞类型组成。
AI.result: 该方法成功推断出果蝇成体大脑所有细胞类型的功能，并对其中的多个广泛回路进行了功能推断。验证结果显示，分析与发表后文献的交叉对照结果一致，证明方法的正确性。
AI.conclusion: LLantia提供了一种可扩展的自动化神经回路功能推断框架，既支持向已有文献的回溯验证，也为未来实验研究提供了基础支撑，有助于加速从连接组到功能理解的转化。

title: H+ Embedding: Harmonizing Global and Token-Level Retrieval with Context-Dependent Phrases
summary: Terminology-intensive retrieval, especially in medical settings, depends on preserving multi-word entities, abbreviations, numerical constraints, and compositional concepts. However, existing representations lie at two extremes: single-vector retrievers often over-compress local relevance signals, while token-level late interaction retains every tokenizer subword at substantial indexing, storage, and scoring cost. This mismatch raises a natural question: can context-dependent phrases provide a useful retrieval unit between global vectors and tokens? We introduce H+ Embedding, a unified multi-granularity retriever that predicts variable-length phrase partitions, preserves uncovered tokens as singletons, and applies importance-guided unit selection with weighted MaxSim interaction. Across 16 scientific, medical, and bilingual tasks, its phrase retrieval branch exceeds the global retrieval branch by 6.91 macro nDCG@10. It also nearly matches Token while using 13.7% fewer document vectors and outperforms content-independent grouping rules under moderate vector budgets. Context-dependent phrase interaction therefore provides an intermediate quality-cost point between global compression and token-level interaction for practical retrieval systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了H+ Embedding，一种统一的多粒度检索器，通过预测可变长度短语分区、将未覆盖词元保留为单例，并采用重要性引导的单元选择和加权MaxSim交互，在全局向量与词元级交互之间提供了中间质量-成本平衡点。
AI.motivation: 术语密集型检索（尤其是医疗场景）需要保留多词实体、缩写、数值约束和组合概念，但现有表示处于两个极端：单向量检索器过度压缩局部相关性信号，而词元级晚期交互保留了每个分词子词，导致索引、存储和评分成本过高。作者希望探索上下文相关短语能否作为全局向量与词元之间的有用检索单元。
AI.method: H+ Embedding采用统一的多粒度检索框架：预测可变长度的短语分区，未覆盖的词元保留为单例单元，并应用重要性引导的单元选择机制，配合加权MaxSim交互进行评分。
AI.result: 在16个科学、医学和双语任务上，短语检索分支相比全局检索分支在macro nDCG@10上提升了6.91；同时仅使用13.7%更少的文档向量即可接近Token方法的性能，并在中等向量预算下优于基于内容无关的分组规则。
AI.conclusion: 上下文相关的短语交互为实际检索系统提供了介于全局压缩与词元级交互之间的中间质量-成本解决方案，在保证检索质量的同时显著降低了存储和计算开销。

title: Modeling Unknown Nonlocal PDE Systems via Flow Map Learning
summary: Nonlocal partial differential equations arise in many applications but are often difficult to model and learn because of the presence of nonlocal operators. We present a flow-map learning (FML) framework for modeling unknown nonlocal PDEs directly from solution data. Rather than learning or approximating the underlying nonlocal operators, the proposed approach learns the finite-time evolution operator in either modal or nodal space. Two complementary formulations are developed for spectral and grid-based solution representations. Numerical experiments on one- and two-dimensional fractional diffusion and wave equations demonstrate accurate and stable long-time prediction using only short observation windows. The proposed approach provides an effective data-driven framework for learning unknown nonlocal dynamics without explicit evaluation of nonlocal operators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种流图学习（FML）框架，直接从解数据中学习未知的非局部偏微分方程（PDE），通过学习有限时间演化算子而非非局部算子本身，在模态空间或节点空间中实现长期稳定预测。
AI.motivation: 非局部偏微分方程在众多应用中广泛出现，但由于非局部算子的存在，这类方程的建模和学习非常困难，需要一种不显式评估非局部算子的数据驱动学习方法。
AI.method: 提出流图学习（FML）框架，直接学习有限时间演化算子而非底层非局部算子；针对谱表示和网格表示分别开发了两种互补的公式化方法（模态空间与节点空间）。
AI.result: 在一维和二维分数阶扩散方程及波动方程的数值实验中，仅使用短观测窗口即可实现准确且稳定的长期预测。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法为学习未知非局部动力学提供了一种有效的数据驱动框架，无需显式评估非局部算子。

title: LLM-OSDA: An Optimal-Stopping Dynamic Auction for Native Advertising in Multi-Turn LLM Conversations
comment: 14 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to the 41st AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI 2027)
summary: LLM-native advertising embeds sponsored content directly into model-generated responses, shifting the unit of sale from a fixed slot to a moment within an evolving conversation. Existing LLM ad-auction mechanisms primarily operate within a single response, settling the winner but not the timing. The extension is nontrivial: with one native insertion opportunity per session, the stopping time depends on bids, coupling timing with allocation, so static truthfulness arguments no longer apply. We propose the LLM-based Optimal Stopping Dynamic Auction (LLM-OSDA), a dynamic cost-per-click auction that integrates Bellman optimal stopping, winner allocation, and envelope pricing. A bid-independent LLM layer estimates contextual click quality and seamlessly renders the winning ad, while bids enter only the committed auction mechanism. Under an exact Bellman oracle, the expected discounted-click allocation is monotone in each advertiser's bid, and the corresponding envelope payment makes truthful bidding weakly dominant in expectation. For practical deployment, a learned StopNet approximates the Bellman action values. We show that its decisions differ from the optimal policy only near the stopping boundary and bound the resulting incentive loss in terms of its approximation error. Experiments on a simulated conversational advertising corpus show that LLM-OSDA improves net revenue by 11 percent over the strongest fixed-timing baseline while maintaining comparable user retention. Code is at https://github.com/2025Fang2025/llm-osda.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LLM-OSDA，一种将最优停止理论融入LLM原生广告拍卖的动态点击付费机制，将广告投放从单次响应中的固定槽位扩展到对话过程中动态时刻的选择，实现时序与分配联合优化，并通过信封定价保证激励兼容性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM广告拍卖机制仅在一单次响应内分配广告位，忽略了"何时插入广告"这一时序问题。因为每次会话仅有一次原生插入机会，停止时间取决于出价，从而与分配耦合，静态真实性论证不再适用，需要新的动态机制设计。
AI.method: 提出LLM-OSDA：1) 将Bellman最优停止与赢家分配及信封定价整合为动态CPC拍卖机制；2) 使用与出价无关的LLM层估计上下文点击质量并渲染广告，出价仅进入承诺机制；3) 在实际部署中使用StopNet近似Bellman动作价值函数。
AI.result: 理论层面证明在精确Bellman预言下，期望折扣点击分配对每个广告主出价单调，信封支付使诚实出价在期望意义下弱占优；近似层面证明StopNet仅在停止边界附近与最优策略有差异，并以近似误差界定了激励损失上界。实验表明相比最强固定时序基线，净收入提升11%且用户留存相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过将最优停止理论引入LLM广告拍卖，该工作为对话式广告的时序优化提供了理论基础和可部署方案，在激励兼容与收益提升之间取得了良好平衡。

title: Agentic Coding in the Wild: Characterizing GitHub Copilot Traces at Production Scale
summary:
AI coding agents like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Codex interleave multi-step LLM inference with tool execution, creating a workload different from chatbots. We present the first production-scale characterization of this workload using sampled GitHub Copilot traces from June 2026, comprising 3.2M users, 13M sessions, 761M LLM calls, and 95T tokens.
  Our analysis reveals distinctive workload properties with important systems implications. For example, agentic coding sessions consist of sparse user-initiated turns, each unfolding into an autonomous agent loop of LLM calls almost always coupled with tool execution. This structure yields KV cache hit rates averaging 90% within a turn, but falling to 55\% across turn boundaries and drastically invalidated after events like model switches or context compaction. Diverse workflows and user behaviors are observed with variable and long-tailed token consumption, time span, and tool calls. We highlight the difference between quick agentic turnaround times and the minutes-long user idle periods at turn boundaries, and design a lightweight idle-time predictor that captures 86-90\% of total idle time, enabling proactive decisions for efficient resource orchestration. These findings challenge assumptions underlying current LLM-serving systems and provide an empirical foundation for agent-native infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对AI编码代理工作负载进行了生产规模的系统表征研究，基于2026年6月GitHub Copilot的采样数据（320万用户、1300万会话、7.61亿次LLM调用、95万亿token），揭示了代理式编码会话与聊天机器人工作负载的本质差异，包括会话结构、KV缓存命中率模式、长尾的token消耗分布等，并提出轻量级空闲时间预测器以支持资源调度优化。
AI.motivation: AI编码代理（如GitHub Copilot、Claude Code和Codex）将多步LLM推理与工具执行交织在一起，形成了与聊天机器人截然不同的工作负载。然而，现有LLM服务系统大多基于聊天机器人的工作负载假设设计，缺乏对代理式编码工作负载的大规模实证表征，无法为代理原生基础设施的设计提供依据。
AI.method: 基于2026年6月的GitHub Copilot生产环境采样数据展开分析，覆盖320万用户、1300万会话、7.61亿次LLM调用和95万亿token，对工作负载的会话结构、KV缓存命中模式、token消耗分布、时间特性等方面进行系统性表征分析，并设计了一个轻量级的空闲时间预测器。
AI.result: 发现代理式编码会话具有稀疏的用户发起轮次，每轮展开为自主代理循环（LLM调用几乎总是伴随工具执行）。KV缓存命中率在轮内平均达90%，但跨轮边界降至55%，在模型切换或上下文压缩等事件后大幅失效。工作负载表现出多样化和长尾的token消耗、时间跨度及工具调用分布，并发现代理快速周转时间与分钟级用户空闲期之间的显著差异；设计的空闲时间预测器可捕获86-90%的总空闲时间。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现挑战了当前LLM服务系统的核心假设，为代理原生（agent-native）基础设施的设计提供了经验基础，特别在资源编排、缓存管理和调度策略方面具有重要指导意义。

title: DSETA: A Dual-Stage Continual Learning Framework for Travel Time Prediction in Dynamic Traffic Environments
summary: Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) prediction is a core component of intelligent transportation systems. As traffic congestion patterns become increasingly dynamic in large cities, maintaining high prediction accuracy poses a major challenge for ride-hailing platforms. Existing methods either fail to adapt to irregular traffic patterns and sudden congestion, or suffer from new distributions without disentangling long-term trends from short-term fluctuations, thereby degrading model performance in real-world scenarios. To address this challenge, we propose DSETA, an incrementally updated Dual-Stage ETA prediction framework. Specifically, the continual learning process is divided into \textit{inter-day} and \textit{intra-day} stages. We first design the \textit{intra-day} learning stage, which relies entirely on real-time data to enable dynamic adaptation to short-term traffic patterns caused by events like holidays or accidents. Next, we develop the \textit{inter-day} learning stage, which leverages aggregated historical data from a short time window to capture knowledge of long-term distribution shifts, such as seasonal trends and traffic network evolution. Subsequently, to prevent catastrophic forgetting and preserve knowledge of regular patterns, we explore a \textit{Historical Traffic Knowledge Consolidation} module. Finally, we validate DSETA's effectiveness and robustness through extensive offline and online experiments conducted on real-world datasets from DiDi's platform. Online A/B tests across three major cities including Beijing, Wuhan, and Xi'an consistently demonstrated performance gains, achieving MAE reductions of 6.62\%, 0.73\%, and 2.40\% respectively. This framework has been successfully deployed in DiDi's production environment, processing hundreds of millions of daily requests and validating its strong performance in industrial applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DSETA，一个双阶段的ETA（预计到达时间）预测框架，通过将持续学习分为日内和日间两个阶段来分别处理短期交通波动和长期分布变化，并引入历史交通知识整合模块防止灾难性遗忘，已在滴滴平台大规模部署并验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有ETA预测方法难以适应大城市中日益动态的交通拥堵模式，要么无法应对不规则交通模式和突发拥堵，要么无法将长期趋势与短期波动解耦，导致模型在真实场景中性能退化。
AI.method: 提出DSETA双阶段ETA预测框架：(1)日内学习阶段，完全依赖实时数据进行动态适应短期交通模式（如节假日、事故）；(2)日间学习阶段，利用短期时间窗口的聚合历史数据捕捉长期分布变化（如季节趋势、交通网络演变）；(3)引入历史交通知识整合模块以防止灾难性遗忘并保留常规模式知识。
AI.result: 在滴滴平台三个主要城市（北京、武汉、西安）的在线A/B测试中，MAE分别降低6.62%、0.73%和2.40%。该框架已在滴滴生产环境成功部署，每天处理数亿次请求。
AI.conclusion: DSETA通过双阶段增量学习框架有效解决了ETA预测中的动态交通适应问题，在离线实验和在线A/B测试中均展现出良好的有效性和鲁棒性，且具备工业级大规模部署的可行性。

title: DiffusionGemma Technical Report
summary: We introduce DiffusionGemma, an experimental open-weight language model that uses discrete diffusion to generate text at exceptionally high speed. Rather than decoding one token at a time, DiffusionGemma iteratively refines blocks of 256 tokens in parallel, avoiding the sequential decoding bottleneck of conventional autoregressive (AR) large language models. Instead of training from scratch, we obtain DiffusionGemma by fine-tuning the mixture-of-experts Gemma 4 model with 3.8B activated and 25.2B total parameters. Our compute-efficient two-stage training pipeline uses fewer than 10% of the starting AR model's total training token budget. The first stage uses supervised fine-tuning to teach bidirectional denoising, while the second stage combines reinforcement learning with sampler distillation to jointly improve generation quality and inference efficiency. DiffusionGemma establishes a new Pareto frontier for the trade-off between generation speed and model capability. Averaged across our full evaluation suite, it generates around 20 tokens per forward pass and achieves roughly 1,500 output tokens per second on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU, which is substantially faster than AR models even with state-of-the-art speculative decoding. DiffusionGemma also retains the starting model's support for thinking mode, multimodal inputs, and long contexts. Despite diffusion fine-tuning, it remains capable of AR generation with only minor performance degradation, suggesting a path toward hybrid diffusion-AR decoding.

AI.tldr: DiffusionGemma是一个实验性的开源权重语言模型，利用离散扩散技术并行生成256个token的文本块，而非逐token顺序解码。通过微调Gemma 4混合专家模型获得，其两阶段训练流程只需不到原始模型10%的训练token预算，在单个NVIDIA H100 GPU上实现每秒约1500个输出token的速度，同时保持思考模式、多模态输入和长上下文支持。
AI.motivation: 传统自回归(AR)大语言模型存在顺序解码瓶颈，生成速度受限。本文旨在通过离散扩散机制替代逐token解码，以并行方式同时生成多个token，从而大幅提升文本生成的推理速度。
AI.method: 采用计算高效的两阶段训练流程：第一阶段使用监督微调(SFT)教授双向去噪能力；第二阶段结合强化学习(RL)与采样器蒸馏，同时优化生成质量和推理效率。模型通过在Gemma 4 (3.8B激活/25.2B总参数)上微调获得，利用少于10%的原始训练token预算。
AI.result: DiffusionGemma在生成速度与模型能力之间建立了新的帕累托前沿。平均每次前向传播生成约20个token，在单张NVIDIA H100 GPU上达到每秒约1500个输出token，显著快于即使采用最先进投机解码的AR模型。同时保留了思考模式、多模态输入和长上下文支持，且仍具备AR生成能力，仅有轻微性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 离散扩散微调是构建高速文本生成模型的有效途径，开辟了生成速度与能力的新平衡点。模型能够同时支持扩散解码和AR解码，暗示了混合扩散-AR解码的可能路径，为未来高效语言模型的设计提供了新方向。

title: Can LLM Agents Price Competitively? A Dynamic Multi-Attribute Auction Benchmark for Agentic Commerce
summary: Agentic commerce is moving from concept to deployed infrastructure: payment networks, retailers, and AI platforms are setting the stage for agents to transact on behalf of merchants and consumers. Yet whether the LLMs behind these agents can price competently in real markets, where customer preferences are hidden, competitors adapt in real time, and demand can shift without warning, has not been systematically tested. We introduce Bazaar, a dynamic sealed-bid benchmark for multi-attribute auction under these conditions. Despite its dynamics, the benchmark is grounded in closed-form customer utilities, enabling exact evaluation. Across 11 frontier LLMs from four providers, the leading agents on customer acquisition (e.g. Gemini 3.1 Pro) are often not the leading agents on profit (e.g. Opus 4.6). The ranking shifts again under demand shocks: agents that learned fastest pre-shock are typically the slowest to revise their beliefs afterwards, while Gemini 3.1 Pro recovers fastest despite not leading on profit. However, even the strongest agent captures less than a third of hindsight-optimal profit, suggesting current LLMs are progressing in agentic commerce but leave substantial headroom.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Bazaar，一个面向多属性拍卖的动态密封竞价基准测试，用于系统评估LLM驱动的智能体在真实市场条件下的定价能力。实验发现，前沿LLM在客户获取和利润表现上排名不一致，需求冲击后表现各异，但即使最强智能体也只能达到事后最优利润的三分之一以下。
AI.motivation: Agentic commerce正在从概念走向实际部署，但LLM智能体是否能在客户偏好隐藏、竞争者实时适应、需求突变等真实市场条件下进行有效定价，尚未被系统性测试。现有基准缺乏对这些动态复杂性的考量。
AI.method: 构建Bazaar动态密封竞价基准，模拟多属性拍卖环境，包含隐藏客户偏好、实时竞争对手适应和需求冲击等动态因素。基准基于闭式客户效用函数，支持精确评估。对来自4个提供商的11个前沿LLM进行系统测试。
AI.result: 客户获取领先的智能体（如Gemini 3.1 Pro）并非利润领先者（如Opus 4.6）；需求冲击后排名再次变化，学习最快的智能体通常在事后修订信念最慢，而Gemini 3.1 Pro恢复最快；即使最强智能体也仅捕获不到事后最优利润的三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在agentic commerce领域已有进展但仍有显著提升空间，不同智能体在不同维度（客户获取、利润、需求冲击恢复）上各有优劣，尚需进一步突破才能实现接近最优的定价能力。

title: Unleashing the Potential of Large Language Models: A Blueprint for Real-Time, Enterprise-Ready Deployments
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. Authors' accepted version of an article published in IEEE Computer. The version of record is available at the DOI below
summary: Large language models deployed in real-time, regulated settings face knowledge staleness, catastrophic forgetting, hallucination, and weak feedback loops. We present a unified, pattern-driven LLMOps architecture integrating real-time data ingestion, continual learning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and human-in-the-loop feedback into a single operational pipeline. Four contributions map to established software design patterns: an adaptive ingestion pattern orchestrator (AIPO) evaluated with FreshStreamBench; STAR+FAR continual learning with sparse temporal adapter routing and freshness-aware replay; SAGE, an SLO-aware adaptive retrieval policy predicting a per-query passage budget to meet tail-latency targets; and an automated feedback-driven convergence stage with RLHF triggers. The result reduces latency-cost-accuracy trade-offs while supporting auditability and rollback for high-risk sectors such as health care and finance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统一的、模式驱动的LLMOps架构，将实时数据摄入、持续学习、检索增强生成（RAG）和人在环反馈整合到单一运营管道中，以解决大语言模型在实时、受监管环境中面临的知识过时、灾难性遗忘、幻觉和反馈循环薄弱等问题。
AI.motivation: 大规模语言模型在实时受监管环境中部署时面临知识过时、灾难性遗忘、幻觉和反馈循环薄弱四大挑战，现有方案缺乏统一集成的运营架构。
AI.method: 提出四点贡献：(1) AIPO自适应摄入模式编排器（基于FreshStreamBench评估）；(2) STAR+FAR持续学习方法，采用稀疏时间适配器路由和新鲜度感知重放；(3) SAGE，一种SLO感知的自适应检索策略，预测每个查询的段落预算以满足尾部延迟目标；(4) 基于反馈的自动化收敛阶段，带有RLHF触发机制。
AI.result: 该架构在降低延迟-成本-准确性权衡方面取得了改善，并支持可审计性和回滚能力，适用于医疗和金融等高危行业。
AI.conclusion: 该统一LLMOps架构通过模式驱动设计实现了实时数据、持续学习和人机反馈的有机结合，在性能与可审计性之间取得平衡，适合受监管的高风险领域部署。

title: A Constitution-Grid Instrument for Data-Efficient RL Alignment (C-Guard)
summary: Conflicting objectives are general in RL alignment, and training on them data-efficiently is hard. Training a safety guard with RL means optimizing two objectives that conflict: catch real harm, and do not refuse benign prompts. Our finding is that over-refusal improves 22.4% to 12.8%, while under-refusal on adversarial attacks silently worsens 0.27 to 0.33. We present C-Guard, a constitution-grid instrument that generates the RL training data, and C-LIM, a per-cell learnability score that decides each cell's move: prune, densify, amend, expand. C-LIM flags the dead-weight data region before any training budget is spent: 187 untargeted rows had bought zero gain, and our method lifts the same region's learning impact 0.733 to 0.80. Code and the constitution are open-sourced.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了C-Guard和C-LIM两个工具来数据高效地训练RL对齐中的安全护栏，解决安全目标与不拒绝良性提示之间的冲突目标问题。
AI.motivation: RL对齐中普遍存在冲突目标，训练安全护栏需要在"捕捉真实危害"和"不拒绝良性提示"之间取得平衡，而现有方法在此类冲突目标上的数据高效训练很困难。过度拒绝与拒绝不足之间存在此消彼长的困境。
AI.method: 提出C-Guard（宪法网格工具）用于生成RL训练数据，以及C-LIM（单元可学习性评分）决定每个单元的操作为：剪枝、加密、修正或扩展。C-LIM在训练预算投入之前就标记出无效数据区域。
AI.result: 过度拒绝率从22.4%改善至12.8%；对抗性攻击下的拒绝不足从0.27恶化到0.33。C-LIM识别出187行未产生任何收益的无目标数据行，并将同一区域的学习影响力从0.733提升至0.80。
AI.conclusion: 通过C-Guard和C-LIM的组合，能够在训练前识别并消除无效数据区域，提升数据利用效率和模型学习效果，代码和宪法均已开源。

title: Shared Organizational Memory for Enterprise Coding Agents: System Design and Deployment Snapshot
summary: Enterprise coding agents rely on tools and retrieval, yet enterprise knowledge often remains outside public training data and formal documentation: internal DSLs, proprietary platforms, local conventions, recent fixes, and tacit workflows. Existing knowledge interfaces expose stored resources but still depend on agents recognizing and explicitly recording lessons worth reusing, disconnecting capture from the coding workflow and leaving development experience repeatedly rediscovered. We report an ongoing production deployment of a shared organizational memory system that makes capture a platform-level part of coding work: it collects task-adjacent experience with contributor approval, curates it into reusable question-answer memories, gates obvious security and privacy risks, and retrieves memories for future agents. This short paper describes the deployed lifecycle and an operational snapshot. Effects on retrieval and coding tasks remain under evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个企业级编码代理的组织记忆系统生产部署，该系统将知识捕获嵌入编码工作流的平台层面，自动收集任务相关的开发经验，经过贡献者审批后整理为可复用的问答记忆，并过滤安全隐私风险，供未来代理检索使用。
AI.motivation: 企业编码代理依赖于工具和检索，但企业知识（内部DSL、专有平台、本地约定、近期修复、隐性工作流）往往不在公开训练数据或正式文档中。现有知识接口依赖代理主动识别和记录经验，导致捕获与编码工作流脱节，开发经验被反复重新发现。
AI.method: 构建一个共享组织记忆系统，作为编码工作的平台级组成部分：1）在贡献者批准下收集任务相关的开发经验；2）将其整理为可复用的问答记忆；3）设置明显的安全与隐私风险过滤门控；4）为未来代理提供记忆检索能力。
AI.result: 论文报告了正在进行中的生产部署，描述了部署生命周期和运营快照。对检索和编码任务的实际效果仍在评估中。
AI.conclusion: 该系统通过在平台层实现经验捕获与编码工作流的深度融合，有望解决企业编码代理知识复用不足的问题，但有效性评估尚在进行中。

title: HP-JEPA: Hierarchical Partitioning for Multi-Resolution Graph Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning
summary: Graph self-supervised learning aims to learn transferable representations from large-scale unlabeled graph data. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) avoid explicit negative-pair construction and raw-input reconstruction by predicting masked targets directly in latent space. However, existing graph JEPAs typically rely on a single predefined graph partition, biasing the learned representations toward one structural granularity and limiting their ability to capture complementary patterns at different graph scales. To address this limitation, we propose HP-JEPA, a hierarchical partitioning framework for multi-resolution graph joint-embedding prediction. HP-JEPA organizes each graph into an ordered bank of coarse-to-fine partition resolutions and performs context-target latent prediction separately at each resolution using an online encoder, an exponential-moving-average target encoder, and a latent predictor. The resulting resolution-specific graph representations are subsequently integrated through concatenation or task-specific resolution weighting, allowing downstream models to combine complementary local, regional, and global structural information. Experiments on seven graph classification benchmarks and one graph regression benchmark show that HP-JEPA outperforms the fixed-resolution Graph-JEPA baseline on 6 of 8 tasks, improving upon Graph-JEPA on most evaluated benchmarks. Size-stratified analyses further show that HP-JEPA achieves higher accuracy than Graph-JEPA in most evaluated graph-size quartiles on three representative datasets. These results highlight the effectiveness of hierarchical multi-resolution partitioning for transferable graph representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HP-JEPA，一种用于图自监督学习的层次化多分辨率联合嵌入预测框架。通过将图组织为从粗到细的多层级划分，并在每个分辨率上独立进行上下文-目标潜在空间预测，再整合各分辨率的表示，HP-JEPA在6/8个基准任务上超越了固定分辨率基线Graph-JEPA。
AI.motivation: 现有图JEPAs依赖单一预定义的图划分，导致学习到的表示偏向某一种结构粒度，无法同时捕捉不同图尺度上的互补模式，限制了表示的可迁移性和表达能力。
AI.method: HP-JEPA将每个图组织为从粗到细的有序划分分辨率库，在每个分辨率上使用在线编码器、EMA目标编码器和潜在预测器进行上下文-目标潜在预测。各分辨率特定的图表示通过拼接或任务特定的分辨率加权进行整合，使下游模型能结合局部、区域和全局结构信息。
AI.result: 在7个图分类基准和1个图回归基准上，HP-JEPA在8个任务中的6个上超越了固定分辨率的Graph-JEPA基线。规模分层分析进一步表明，在三个代表性数据集的多数图大小四分位数上，HP-JEPA的准确率高于Graph-JEPA。
AI.conclusion: 层次化多分辨率划分为可迁移的图表示学习提供了一种有效方案，能够整合互补的局部、区域和全局结构信息，从而提升图自监督学习的性能。

title: Averaging Bias: Human Faithfulness Annotations are not Locally Faithful
summary: Evaluation of faithfulness of text summarization treats a model generated summary as faithful only if every of its sentences is supported by the source document: a strict conjunctive rule under which a single unsupported sentence makes the whole summary unfaithful. Yet most faithfulness benchmarks collect only one global human annotation label per summary. We ask whether such global human labels actually implement the conjunctive rule. We hypothesize that annotators may accept a summary as faithful when most sentences are faithful, not only when all are faithful. To test our hypothesis, we use five large language model (LLM) judges as per-sentence raters across four widely used faithfulness benchmarks. We find that global human labels correlate better with the average of per-sentence LLM judgments than with the implementation of the strict conjunctive rule. A manual review confirms that a substantial fraction of summaries labeled faithful by humans contain genuine local factual errors. We call this tendency Averaging Bias. Our results reveal that human labels on widely used faithfulness benchmarks contain measurable Averaging Bias, calling for carefully structured designs for trustworthy human annotations

AI.tldr: 本文发现广泛使用的文本摘要忠实度基准中的人类标注存在"平均偏差"——人类标注者倾向于在大多数句子忠实时就判定整个摘要为忠实，而非严格执行"所有句子都必须忠实"的合取规则。作者通过五个大语言模型裁判对四个基准进行逐句评估，证实全局人类标签与逐句判断的平均值相关性更高，而非严格的合取规则实现。
AI.motivation: 忠实度评估理论上应遵循严格的合取规则（每个句子都必须有源文档支持），但现有基准只收集每个摘要一个全局人类标注。作者质疑这些全局标注是否真的实现了合取规则，并假设人类标注者可能存在"平均偏差"——接受大部分句子忠实而非全部忠实的摘要。
AI.method: 使用五个大语言模型作为逐句评分器，在四个广泛使用的忠实度基准上评估摘要。将全局人类标签分别与逐句判断的平均值及严格合取规则实现进行相关性比较，并通过人工审查验证人类标记为忠实的摘要中是否包含真实的局部事实错误。
AI.result: 全局人类标签与逐句大语言模型判断的平均值相关性更好，而非与严格合取规则的实现相关。人工审查确认有相当比例被人类标记为忠实的摘要包含真实的局部事实错误，证实了平均偏差的存在。
AI.conclusion: 广泛使用的忠实度基准中的人类标注存在可测量的平均偏差，这呼吁需要精心设计的标注结构以获取可信赖的人工标注。该发现对基于这些基准训练的模型评估与开发具有重要警示意义。

title: AgentStream: How Well Do Self-Evolving LLM Agents Perform Under Streaming Tasks?
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can self-evolve by continually improving from their own accumulated experience. However, existing studies predominantly adopt independent evaluation. Consequently, the behavior of self-evolving agents in realistic streaming settings, where agents adapt to diverse and complex task streams, remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we introduce AgentStream, a unified framework that evaluates self-evolving agents spanning diverse evolution components by organizing agentic benchmarks into a configurable task stream and instantiating the \texttt{Isolated}, \texttt{Sequential}, and \texttt{Interleaved} streaming scenarios at test time, which progressively vary the scope and domain composition of the stream. Over these scenarios, we combinatorially evaluate five representative self-evolving methods across three frontier foundation models, disentangling how model capability, method architecture, and streaming scenario jointly shape self-evolution. Our results show that self-evolution reliability varies across streaming scenarios, the benefit of self-evolution is gated by model capability and non-monotonic in model strength, and no single method dominates across models and scenarios. These findings offer concrete guidance for selecting self-evolving methods across models and streaming scenarios. Overall, we advocate that self-evolving agents should be evaluated under realistic task streams rather than isolated single-task settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgentStream 框架，用于在真实的流式任务场景下评估自进化 LLM 智能体，通过配置可变的任务流并实例化三种流式场景（隔离、顺序、交错），系统性地组合评估五种自进化方法和三种前沿基础模型，揭示了自进化可靠性随流式场景变化、自进化收益受模型能力门控且呈非单调关系，以及没有单一方法在所有场景下占优等关键发现。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化智能体的研究主要采用独立评估方式，无法反映智能体在真实流式任务环境中的适应行为。为弥补这一空白，作者引入 AgentStream 统一框架来评估多样化流式场景下的自进化智能体。
AI.method: 将智能体基准测试组织为可配置的任务流，在测试时实例化 Isolated、Sequential 和 Interleaved 三种流式场景（逐步变化任务流的范围和领域组成），并对五种代表性自进化方法和三种前沿基础模型进行组合式评估，以解耦模型能力、方法架构和流式场景对自进化的联合影响。
AI.result: 结果显示：自进化可靠性因流式场景而异；自进化的收益受模型能力门控，且与模型强度呈非单调关系；没有任何单一方法在模型和场景组合中占优。
AI.conclusion: 自进化智能体应在真实任务流而非孤立单任务设置下进行评估，研究结果为在不同模型和流式场景下选择自进化方法提供了具体指导。

title: Agentic Graph Token Reasoning
summary: Graphs model relational data throughout science and industry, from citation networks to product co-purchase graphs. Because the nodes of many such graphs carry rich text, a growing line of work applies large language models (LLMs) to graph analysis. The most graph-native of these methods use graph tokens: a graph encoder compresses a graph view, such as a node, its k-hop neighbourhood, or a cluster, into a short block of continuous tokens that jointly encodes node attributes and topology and is read directly by the model. Existing methods, however, use graph tokens in a static single-shot manner: they encode one predefined graph view before the model has even seen the target and never revise it, leaving the model's step-by-step reasoning ability unused. We introduce agentic graph token reasoning, which recasts graph tokenization as part of the reasoning process itself. At each step, the model chooses which graph view to encode and at what granularity; a graph encoder is invoked on demand to materialise the corresponding graph tokens; and the resulting block is spliced into the running context. The model thus reasons step by step in the graph token space, and the tokens it reads are trajectory-dependent. We realise this with a three-stage training pipeline: (i) self-supervised tasks that teach the model to read heterogeneous graph tokens, (ii) a token-robust trajectory stage with a graph-token consistency regulariser, and (iii) preference optimisation that rewards trajectories in which the graph-token evidence and the node-text evidence agree. Across evaluations spanning seven graph domains, our models outperform a broad set of baselines by a large margin and transfer zero-shot to unseen domains without any per-target fine-tuning. More broadly, this work pushes LLM-based graph analysis from static graph-token encoders towards a graph-native agent paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"智能体图标记推理"方法，将图标记化（graph tokenization）重新定位为推理过程本身的一部分：模型在每个推理步骤中自主选择要编码的图视图和粒度，按需调用图编码器生成图标记并拼接进上下文，实现逐步推理。通过三阶段训练流程（自监督图标记阅读、图标记鲁棒轨迹、偏好优化），模型在七个图域上的评估中大幅超越基线，并能零样本迁移到未见过的领域。
AI.motivation: 现有的图标记方法采用静态一次性编码方式：在模型看到目标任务之前就预先编码一个固定图视图，且从不修改，没有利用模型逐步推理的能力，限制了LLM在图分析任务上的表现。
AI.method: 提出智能体图标记推理框架：每一步由模型自主选择编码哪个图视图（节点、k跳邻域或簇）及粒度，按需调用图编码器生成图标记并拼接进运行上下文。采用三阶段训练：①自监督任务教模型阅读异构图标记；②图标记鲁棒轨迹阶段（含图标记一致性正则化）；③偏好优化奖励图标记证据与节点文本证据一致的轨迹。
AI.result: 在七个图域的评估中，模型大幅超越广泛的基线方法，且无需针对目标进行微调即可零样本迁移到未见过的图域。
AI.conclusion: 本文推动LLM图分析从静态图标记编码器向图原生的智能体范式演进，证明了将图标记化融入推理过程能显著提升图分析性能。

title: Bridging the English-Arabic Medical Knowledge Gap: Targeted Low-Rank Adaptation via Causal Layer Selection
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform strongly in English medical tasks but degrade substantially in Arabic, a gap widely attributed to limited training data. We systematically investigate this assumption via tuned lens probing and causal activation patching, and find that Arabic medical knowledge is present in intermediate model representations but fails to surface at the output. This mechanistic insight motivates a targeted adaptation strategy: rather than fine-tuning the full network, we propose Targeted Low-Rank Adaptation (TLoRA), restricted to the layer window where cross-lingual representations diverge, upstream of the output layers where the failure manifests. We evaluate TLoRA on multiple-choice medical QA, where our approach outperforms full-network LoRA, zero-shot, and few-shot baselines. We further evaluate it on short-answer generation and multi-turn clinical dialogue, where it performs competitively without the need for task-specific finetuning. We additionally introduce AraClinicDialog, a clinician-constructed Arabic medical dialogue benchmark in MSA with validated variants across four Arabic dialects. Together, these contributions demonstrate that mechanistic diagnosis can serve as a practical guide for targeted adaptation in underrepresented-language medical LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过机制分析发现阿拉伯语医学知识存在于LLM中间层表示中，但无法在输出层浮现。基于此提出TLoRA，仅在跨语言表征分叉的层窗口进行针对性低秩适配，在医学问答、短文生成和临床对话任务上超越全网络LoRA及零样本/少样本基线。
AI.motivation: 现有假设认为LLM在阿拉伯语医学任务上表现不佳是因为训练数据不足，但作者通过机制分析方法系统质疑这一假设，发现问题的本质是知识在输出阶段无法被正确"提取"，而非知识缺失。
AI.method: 使用tuned lens probing和causal activation patching进行机制诊断，定位知识存在于中间层但无法在输出层涌现的层窗口；据此提出TLoRA（Targeted Low-Rank Adaptation），仅对表征分叉的层窗口进行参数适配；同时构建了AraClinicDialog基准数据集。
AI.result: TLoRA在多项选择医学问答任务上优于全网络LoRA、零样本和少样本基线；在短文生成和多轮临床对话任务上无需任务特定微调即表现竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 机制诊断可以作为低资源语言医学LLM定向适配的实用指南，证明了"知识存在但无法浮现"的机制洞察可直接指导更高效的适配策略。

title: TRACE-TS: Attribution-Grounded and Traceable Sensor-Language Reasoning for Human Activity Understanding
summary: Wearable sensors capture fine-grained motion patterns that support rich behavioral understanding, yet most existing methods reduce these signals to activity labels. Recent LM-based approaches generate natural-language explanations for sensor data, but their reasoning is weakly grounded in the underlying signal, leading to fluent yet unverifiable explanations. We introduce TRACE-TS (Traceable Reasoning with Attribution-Grounded Evidence), a framework for structured and signal-grounded reasoning over wearable time series. TRACE-TS uses attribution from an expert classifier to identify salient spatio-temporal sensor regions, uses them to construct DAG reasoning traces with explicit evidence provenance, and trains a compact language model to generate these traces through gated cross-attention over sensor memory tokens. At inference, the adapted model jointly outputs the activity prediction and its reasoning trace, without requiring attribution computation or teacher guidance. We introduce Semantic Node Match(SNM), an LLM-as-judge metric that diagnoses reasoning fidelity at the observation, inference, and synthesis levels, localizing hallucinated observations and broken evidence chains missed by standard NLG metrics. Across seven wearable benchmarks, TRACE-TS achieves the best average accuracy and F1 among all evaluated methods (84.43%/81.24%), and outperforms the best LLM-based baseline by 17.96% in F1. Our code is available at https://github.com/SparshRastogi/TRACE-TS.

AI.tldr: 提出了TRACE-TS框架，通过专家分类器的归因识别显著时空传感器区域，构建带证据来源的DAG推理轨迹，并训练紧凑语言模型生成这些轨迹，实现可验证的传感器时间序列推理。
AI.motivation: 现有基于语言模型的可穿戴传感器数据方法生成的解释流畅但缺乏对底层信号的充分依据，导致解释难以验证。作者旨在解决推理轨迹与传感器信号之间的grounding问题。
AI.method: 使用专家分类器归因识别显著时空传感器区域，构建DAG推理轨迹并显式标注证据来源；通过门控交叉注意力在传感器记忆token上训练紧凑语言模型生成这些轨迹；推理时联合输出活动预测与推理轨迹，无需归因计算或教师指导；提出SNM（语义节点匹配）LLM评判指标用于诊断推理保真度。
AI.result: 在七个可穿戴基准上，TRACE-TS取得最佳平均准确率84.43%和F1 81.24%，相比最好的基于LLM的基线在F1上提升17.96%。
AI.conclusion: TRACE-TS证明了通过显式证据溯源与结构化推理轨迹，可以有效提升可穿戴传感器时间序列推理的可验证性，同时保持甚至超过现有方法的预测性能。

title: Crushing the Evidence: A Dual-Penalty Evasion Framework for Fooling White-Box Explainable AI Auditors
summary: Post-hoc model explainers such as LIME, SHAP, and Integrated Gradients are widely deployed to audit models in high-stakes sensitive domains, including finance, healthcare, and social welfare. This ensures the model's transparency and acceptability. However, a few studies have examined potential attacks in the explainability pipeline. Adversaries can attempt to conceal algorithmic biases or backdoors using adversarial explanation attacks. These attacks have relied on scaffolding out-of-distribution (OOD) detectors that toggle predictions when queried by an explainer. Consequently, defenses have been developed to successfully neutralize these black-box attacks by identifying their anomalous perturbation footprints. In this paper, we demonstrate a critical vulnerability by introducing a more potent white-box, gradient-regularized evasion attack framework. By employing a continuous-embedding dual-penalty framework, we directly penalize trigger feature gradients during training on in-distribution data. Since our approach embeds the evasion logic natively into the model parameters, without relying on OOD scaffolding wrappers, it generates smooth, in-distribution predictions that leave no anomaly footprint. Empirical evaluations across four benchmark tabular datasets (COMPAS, German Credit, IEEE-CIS, and Communities & Crime) confirm that our method systematically crushes target feature attribution to near-zero (<0.02), maintains >90% Attack Success Rates, and fundamentally bypasses Conditional Anomaly Detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种更强大的白盒、梯度正则化对抗解释攻击框架，通过连续嵌入双惩罚机制在训练阶段直接惩罚触发特征梯度，将逃避逻辑原生嵌入模型参数中，无需依赖OOD包装器，从而在不留异常痕迹的情况下系统性摧毁目标特征归因。
AI.motivation: 现有的对抗解释攻击依赖于OOD检测器包装器，会产生异常扰动痕迹，容易被现有的防御机制识别和中和。作者旨在突破这一限制，展示一种更隐蔽、更强大的攻击方式，揭示解释性管线中存在的严重安全漏洞。
AI.method: 提出一种白盒、梯度正则化的规避攻击框架，采用连续嵌入双惩罚框架，在分布内数据的训练过程中直接惩罚触发特征梯度。该方法将逃避逻辑原生嵌入模型参数中，不依赖OOD脚手架包装器，从而生成平滑的分布内预测，不留下异常足迹。
AI.result: 在四个基准表格数据集（COMPAS、German Credit、IEEE-CIS、Communities & Crime）上的实验表明，该方法能将目标特征归因系统性压至接近零（<0.02），攻击成功率保持在90%以上，并从根本上绕过条件异常检测。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了现有对抗解释防御机制的严重局限性，表明仅依赖异常检测来防御攻击是不够的，需要开发更根本性的防御策略来保护模型可解释性管线的安全。

title: A Few Neurons Reveal When LLMs Misuse Tools: Sparse Detection and Selective Steering for Reliable Tool Use
summary: Agentic LLMs exhibit three consequential tool-use failures: invalid arguments (validity), unnecessary calls (over-calling), and omitted calls when tools are needed (missing). We find that a small, failure-specific set of MLP neurons could distinguish such failures with linearly separable decision boundaries. Building on this observation, we introduce PRISMS (Probing Representations In Support of Monitoring and Steering), a closed-loop framework that shares a failure-specific neuron basis between sparse detection and activation steering. PRISMS selects contribution-critical MLP neurons and fits an L1-regularized detector on their activations. Across six models from the Qwen3, Llama, and Gemma families, over-calling and missing are detected at the pre-generation prompt boundary with ROC-AUC 0.90-1.00, while validity is detected from the generated tool-call span with ROC-AUC 0.86-0.90. These results are achieved with highly sparse readouts: only 1-2 MLP neurons for missing, 2-16 for over-calling, and approximately 128 for validity. These sparse detectors match or outperform dense residual-stream baselines using 23-627 times fewer features. The shared neuron basis also supports bidirectional control over tool-calling behavior, suppressing unnecessary calls and eliciting omitted ones. PRISMS therefore gates intervention on predicted failure risk to mitigate the collateral effects of unconditional steering. Across all six models, PRISMS reduces pooled over-calling rate by 80% (from 0.131 to 0.026) while increasing tool-required accuracy by 14.2 percentage points (from 0.689 to 0.831). PRISMS thus provides lightweight failure detection and selective intervention across model families.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRISMS框架，利用MLP神经元激活实现工具调用失败（无效参数、过度调用、遗漏调用）的稀疏检测与激活引导，在六个模型上实现高ROC-AUC且仅需少量神经元，并通过条件干预大幅降低过度调用率、提升工具调用准确率。
AI.motivation: Agentic LLM在工具调用中存在三类关键失败模式：无效参数、不必要的过度调用和必需时的遗漏调用。现有方法缺乏轻量且通用的检测与干预机制，需要一种既能稀疏检测失败风险又能实施定向干预的框架。
AI.method: PRISMS通过三个步骤实现：(1) 识别对特定失败类型贡献关键的MLP神经元子集；(2) 在这些神经元激活上拟合L1正则化稀疏检测器；(3) 共享相同神经元基底进行激活引导（steering），并根据预测的失败风险门控干预，避免无条件引导带来的副作用。
AI.result: 在Qwen3、Llama和Gemma六个模型上，过度调用和遗漏检测在生成前提示边界达到ROC-AUC 0.90-1.00，无效参数检测在生成工具调用片段达ROC-AUC 0.86-0.90。检测仅需1-2个（遗漏）、2-16个（过度调用）和约128个（无效参数）MLP神经元。PRISMS将过度调用率从0.131降至0.026（降80%），工具需求准确率从0.689提升至0.831（+14.2个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: PRISMS证明了失败特定的稀疏MLP神经元基底可用于高效的失败检测与双向行为控制，且通过风险门控干预可有效减轻无条件引导的副作用，为跨模型家族的轻量级工具调用可靠性提升提供了可行方案。

title: Personalizing Large Language Model Agents with Small Policy Models
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can retrieve memory, call tools, ask clarifying questions, and vary response style, yet adapting these execution decisions to an individual user remains difficult. Fine-tuning a separate LLM is costly or impossible for proprietary systems, while prompts and memory primarily expose user information to the agent rather than adapt its execution decisions from feedback. We formulate personalization of a frozen agent as online learning of a per-user execution policy from scalar feedback observed only for the executed action. We propose FABLE (Factorized Adaptive Bandit Layer for Execution), a lightweight policy layer outside a potentially black-box host agent. FABLE factorizes memory, information-acquisition, and response decisions so feedback updates related choices; filters actions through an externally specified feasible set before exploration; and learns user-specific residual preferences relative to a fixed default-and-cost score via Bayesian contextual Thompson sampling. Under a linear residual-reward model, a calibrated variant inherits an expected-regret bound against the best feasible action. We also characterize preferences unidentifiable under persistent feasibility constraints and provide anytime-valid false-promotion control. Across personalized-reasoning, controlled-feedback, and executable tool-use evaluations, FABLE improves several preference-sensitive behaviors relative to rule-only control while remaining competitive on end-to-end task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FABLE（因子化自适应带状层），一种轻量级策略层，通过在线学习为冻结的大语言模型智能体实现个性化执行决策，无需微调模型即可从标量反馈中学习用户特定偏好。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体可以检索记忆、调用工具、提问和调整响应风格，但将这些执行决策适应到个体用户仍然困难。微调单独LLM成本高昂或对专有系统不可行，而提示和记忆主要向智能体暴露用户信息，而非从反馈中适应执行决策。
AI.method: FABLE将个性化问题形式化为从已执行动作的标量反馈中在线学习每用户执行策略。它将记忆、信息获取和响应决策因子化，使反馈更新相关选择；在探索前通过外部指定可行集过滤动作；并利用贝叶斯上下文汤普森采样学习用户特定残差偏好（相对于固定默认和成本分数的）。还提供校准变体（在线性残差奖励模型下有期望遗憾界）、偏好可识别性分析和即时有效的虚假提升控制。
AI.result: 在个性化推理、受控反馈和可执行工具使用评估中，FABLE相对于仅规则控制改善了几种偏好敏感行为，同时在端到端任务性能上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: FABLE证明了可以在不微调底层LLM的情况下，通过外部轻量级策略层实现有效的个性化执行决策学习，为黑盒或专有系统的个性化提供了一条可行路径。

title: Fairness Auditing: Lower Bounds on Company Manipulation
summary: Fairness audits are increasingly mandated in high-stakes applications such as hiring, lending, and automated decision-making. Recent work has established fundamental impossibility results for black-box fairness auditing, showing that sufficiently expressive models can evade any auditing strategy. We complement these results by quantifying the extent of unavoidable post-audit manipulation under finite audit resources. We formulate fairness auditing as a min-max optimization between a computationally unbounded company and a budget-constrained auditor. We study two auditing regimes: (i) a budgeted auditor that certifies fairness using a fixed-size audit set, and (ii) a budgeted α-tolerant auditor that additionally requires the audit set to estimate the fairness of the certified model within an α approximation. For both settings, we derive explicit lower bounds on the worst-case post-audit demographic parity deviation as functions of the audit budget, group imbalance, and fairness tolerance. Finally, we empirically illustrate these theoretical limits using simple audit-set construction heuristics with linear and neural network classifiers. Our results demonstrate that increasing audit resources reduces, but does not eliminate, the scope for post-audit manipulation, highlighting fundamental limitations of finite-budget fairness certification.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了有限审计资源下公平性审计的固有限制，通过最小-最大优化框架量化了审计后不可避免的操纵程度，并推导出最坏情况下人口统计平价偏差的下界。
AI.motivation: 现有研究已证明黑盒公平性审计存在根本性的不可能性结果，即足够复杂的模型可以规避任何审计策略。然而，在有限审计资源条件下，审计后操纵的具体程度尚未被量化，需要对此进行补充研究。
AI.method: 将公平性审计建模为计算能力无界公司与预算受限审计者之间的最小-最大优化问题，考察两种审计机制：(i) 使用固定规模审计集的预算审计者；(ii) 额外要求审计集在α近似内估计公平性的α容忍审计者。对两种情况推导出最坏情况下的后审计人口统计平价偏差下界，并通过线性与神经网络分类器的简单审计集构建启发式方法进行实证验证。
AI.result: 推导出了审计后人口统计平价偏差的显式下界，这些下界是审计预算、群体不平衡性和公平性容忍度的函数。实证结果展示了增加审计资源可以减少但不能消除后审计操纵空间。
AI.conclusion: 有限预算的公平性认证存在根本性局限，增加审计资源只能部分缓解操纵问题，无法完全消除，这凸显了诸如招聘、贷款等高风险场景中公平性认证方案的内在不足。

title: Cross-Task Dissociation in Frontier Vision-Language Model Theory of Mind
summary: Do frontier vision-language models present a coherent Theory-of-Mind (ToM) profile across tasks, matching the same human reference group, or does that profile fragment from one paradigm to the next? We evaluate a shared panel of nine frontier VLMs on two psychology-derived benchmarks: the Keysar Director Task (visual perspective-taking under egocentric interference) and the Frith-Happé animated triangles scored with the Castelli rubric (intention attribution from pure motion). On the Director Task, without chain-of-thought, the panel makes the egocentric error on 78\% of trials like children rather than adults; variation is substantial across models, and reasoning rescues several models. On the triangles, the panel under-attributes intention: its ToM profile sits more than three times closer to the high-functioning-autistic-adult (HF-ASD) mean than to the typical-development-adult (TD) mean, while Goal-Directed and Random stay near TD. No model is nearest TD on both tasks; the model that looks adult-like on the Director Task falls on the HF-ASD side on the triangles, and the most TD-like model on the triangles is child-like on the Director Task. We report group-level descriptions, not diagnostic labels for any model.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了九个前沿视觉语言模型在两项心理学基准任务（Keysar导演任务和Frith-Happé动画三角形任务）上的心智理论（ToM）表现，发现模型的心智理论轮廓在不同任务间呈碎片化状态：没有任何模型在两项任务中都能匹配典型发育成年人，部分模型在导演任务中表现像儿童，在三角形任务中则更接近高功能自闭症成人。
AI.motivation: 探究前沿视觉语言模型在心智理论任务中的表现是否具有跨范式的一致性，即模型是否在不同任务中都能匹配同一人类参照群体的表现，还是其心智理论轮廓会随任务范式的变化而碎片化。
AI.method: 对九个前沿视觉语言模型在两个心理学基准任务上进行评估：（1）Keysar导演任务，测试视觉观点采择能力及自我中心干扰下的表现；（2）Frith-Happé动画三角形任务，使用Castelli评分量表测试从纯运动模式中归因意图的能力。
AI.result: 在导演任务中，无思维链提示时模型面板在78%的试验中出现自我中心错误（类似儿童而非成人），模型间差异显著，推理提示可拯救部分模型。在三角形任务中，模型面板整体低估意图归因，其心智理论轮廓距离高功能自闭症成人均值比典型发育成人均值近三倍以上，而目标导向和随机运动维度的表现接近典型发育成人。
AI.conclusion: 没有任何模型在两项任务中都最接近典型发育成人；在导演任务中表现成人化的模型在三角形任务中偏向高功能自闭症侧，而在三角形任务中最接近典型发育成人的模型在导演任务中表现儿童化。研究仅报告群体层面描述，不对任何模型作诊断标签。

title: More Debate, Same Evidence: Structural Limits of Homogeneous Multi-Agent Groundedness
summary: Large language model (LLM) judges are increasingly organized as multi-agent panels under the assumption that exchanging critiques improves judgment quality. We test this assumption for \emph{groundedness verification}, where a judge must determine whether a claim is supported by the supplied evidence. We evaluate a homogeneous three-agent panel on six public fact-verification and hallucination-detection benchmarks. Relative to a fixed single-agent reference, the panel's system-level accuracy difference ranges from $+8.5$ to $-4.4$ percentage points: two datasets show reliable gains, one shows a reliable loss, and three are statistically inconclusive. Because the reference and panel use different model variants, these differences characterize the complete systems rather than isolate a causal debate effect.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多智能体LLM评审团在接地性验证任务中的效果，发现与单一智能体相比，三智能体同质评审团在六个基准上的准确率差异从+8.5到-4.4个百分点不等，其中两个数据集有可靠提升，一个可靠下降，三个统计上不显著。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM评审团被广泛采用，假设通过交换批评意见可以提高判断质量，但这一假设缺乏系统性验证。
AI.method: 使用同质三智能体评审团，在六个公开的事实验证和幻觉检测基准上进行接地性验证实验，并与固定单智能体参照系统进行对比。
AI.result: 系统级准确率差异范围为+8.5至-4.4个百分点；两个数据集显示可靠增益，一个显示可靠损失，三个统计结果不确定。由于参照与评审团使用不同模型变体，差异表征完整系统而非纯粹的辩论因果效应。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体评审团的优势并非普遍成立，其效果因数据集而异，且现有实验设计无法隔离辩论机制本身的因果贡献。

title: CoSynFlow: Conformal Symplectic Neural Flows for Cross-System Prediction of Dissipative Hamiltonian Dynamics
summary: Learning solution operators for differential equations is a central problem in scientific machine learning. However, many neural operator methods optimize prediction accuracy without explicitly enforcing the geometric structure of the dynamics. Structure-preserving models such as SympNets and Symplectic Neural Flows address this issue for conservative Hamiltonian systems by preserving the symplectic form. In dissipative Hamiltonian systems with conformal symplectic structure, however, the symplectic form evolves according to a conformal factor determined by the dissipation. We propose CoSynFlow, a conformal symplectic neural flow for learning continuous-time solution maps of dissipative Hamiltonian dynamics. CoSynFlow composes symplectic shear maps with explicit conformal scaling, preserving the conformal symplectic structure by construction. By conditioning it on a finite-dimensional Hamiltonian descriptor and the dissipation parameter, a single trained model predicts solution maps for unseen systems without retraining. CoSynFlow keeps the structure error at machine precision, attains the lowest long-horizon error, and admits physics-informed training.

AI.tldr: CoSynFlow是一种共形辛神经流方法，用于学习耗散哈密顿动力学的连续时间解算子，通过组合辛剪切映射与显式共形缩放，在构造上保持共形辛结构，可对未见系统进行泛化预测。
AI.motivation: 现有的神经算子方法在求解微分方程时大多只优化预测精度，未显式施加动力学的几何结构约束。已有的保结构模型（如SympNets、辛神经流）仅适用于保守哈密顿系统，无法处理具有共形辛结构的耗散哈密顿系统，因此需要一种能保持共形辛结构的神经算子方法。
AI.method: CoSynFlow通过组合辛剪切映射（symplectic shear maps）与显式共形缩放（conformal scaling）来构造网络，从构造上保证共形辛结构的保持。模型以有限维哈密顿描述符和耗散参数为条件输入，使单个训练好的模型可以预测未见系统的解映射而无需重新训练。
AI.result: CoSynFlow将结构误差保持在机器精度水平，在长时程预测中取得最低误差，并且支持物理信息训练（physics-informed training）。
AI.conclusion: CoSynFlow有效解决了耗散哈密顿系统中保结构神经算子学习的问题，兼顾了结构的严格保持与对新系统的泛化能力，为保几何结构的神经算子方法在耗散动力学中的应用提供了新的途径。

title: Sixteen models, fewer than two voices: measuring ensemble dispersion where no answer is uniquely correct
comment: 34 pages (25 article + 9 supplementary), 3 figures. Supplementary material (S1-S11) included. Preregistered at OSF (osf.io/c5qk7), sealed 21 July 2026. Analysis code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21718657
summary: Sixteen language models drawn from ten families produced, on average, the semantic diversity of 1.69 distinct formulations of a psychotherapeutic case, against a single-model baseline of 1.43 from one model's own runs. Ensembles place more than one reading before a decision-maker on the premise that several models supply several perspectives. Dispersion over their outputs is measured both as diversity and as uncertainty, and both traditions validate it against a correctness criterion that this task does not admit. Measuring diversity is a solved problem: the Vendi Score, the exponential of the von Neumann entropy of a similarity matrix, is an effective number of distinct elements. What a single aggregate does not say is where the diversity comes from. We define a per-model dissent contribution, the complement of a model's mean similarity to the other members of its ensemble: a magnitude from the same matrix, not a decomposition of the spectral index, whose maximum identifies the most divergent voice. Crossing model and case, we test as a preregistered hypothesis whether model identity accounts for a non-zero share of the variance in dissent, and characterise the structure that test detects. The panel formulated fifteen stratified vignettes, yielding 7,082 formulations for analysis. Model identity was a detectable structuring factor of the dissent that remained, but the usual categories recovered it only partly: scale differences pointed in opposite directions across pairs, family grouped models on only five two-member lines, and the most divergent voice changed with panel composition, so that the surfaced outlier describes the ensemble rather than the model. Dissent did not track the interpretive openness for which the case bank was stratified; it was organised by clinical content instead, leaving the dispersion an ensemble produces a property to measure rather than assume.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过十个人工智能模型家族的十六个语言模型对一个心理治疗案例进行表述，发现集成模型平均产生1.69种不同表述（单个模型基线为1.43）。研究定义了每个模型的"异议贡献"（与集成其他成员的平均相似度的补数），用以识别最分歧的声音。预注册假设检验发现模型身份确实解释了异议方差的一部分，但常见分类（规模、家族）只能部分恢复这种结构，且最分歧的声音随集成组成而变化，说明异常值描述的是集成而非模型本身。分歧与案例的诠释开放性无关，而是由临床内容组织。
AI.motivation: 集成模型的核心前提是多个模型提供多个视角，但现有文献通常用正确性标准来验证多样性或不确定性，而本任务（心理治疗案例表述）不存在唯一的正确性标准。此外，现有多样性度量（如Vendi分数）只告诉集成整体有多少不同元素，却不能解释多样性的来源。因此需要用一种不依赖正确性标准的方法来量化并解释集成分歧的来源。
AI.method: 使用Vendi分数（相似性矩阵的冯·诺依曼熵的指数）度量多样性；定义"异议贡献"为每个模型对集成其他成员平均相似度的补数；使用预注册假设检验跨模型和案例，检验模型身份是否解释异议方差的非零份额；由专家组编写十五个分层小故事，共获得7,082个表述用于分析。
AI.result: 十六个模型的集成平均产生1.69种不同表述，高于单一模型的1.43种基线。模型身份确实是一个可检测的分歧结构因素，但常规类别只能部分恢复：规模差异在成对比较中方向相反，家族仅在五个双成员线上分组模型，最分歧的声音随集成组成而改变。分歧不追踪案例的诠释开放性分层，而是由临床内容组织。
AI.conclusion: 集成分散性是一个需要测量而非假设的属性。模型身份影响异议但无法用现有类别（规模、家族）简单解释；异常值描述的是集成而非模型的固有属性；分歧的组织原则是临床内容而非诠释开放性。这提示评估集成模型时应将分散性视为实证测量的对象。

title: Geometric Self-Supervised Pre-training for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
summary:
Neural Combinatorial Optimization (NCO) techniques have emerged as a highly efficient alternative to traditional exact algorithms for solving routing problems such as the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). However, the generalization capabilities of these Reinforcement Learning-based models are severely hindered when scaling to high-dimensional instances. This issue has been mitigated in other domains, like computer vision and natural language processing, by adopting a self-supervised pre-training strategy. Nevertheless, its application to routing graphs, which lack complex topological attributes beyond 2D spatial coordinates, remains a challenge. In this paper, we propose a geometric self-supervised pre-training framework specifically designed to capture spatial invariance and global relative distance distributions. By applying isometric transformations, such as rotations and axial reflections, the model learns robust structural representations prior to the policy optimization phase. Empirical results demonstrate that this strategy consistently outperforms models trained from scratch (baselines), achieving a 7.23\% improvement in tour length for massive zero-shot extrapolation scenarios (TSP1,000). Furthermore, the proposed model exhibits remarkable computational efficiency, delivering speedups of up to two orders of magnitude over the exact solver Concorde at massive scales.
  The source code and pre-trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/davidaguadocosano/TSP-GeoPretrain.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向路由问题的几何自监督预训练框架，通过等距变换（旋转和轴向反射）捕捉空间不变性和全局相对距离分布，使强化学习模型在预训练阶段学习到鲁棒的结构表征，从而显著提升模型在高维TSP实例上的零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 神经组合优化（NCO）在解决TSP等路由问题时高效，但强化学习模型在扩展到高维实例时泛化能力严重受限。自监督预训练在CV和NLP领域已证明有效，但路由图仅具有2D空间坐标，缺乏复杂的拓扑属性，直接应用预训练策略存在挑战。
AI.method: 提出一个几何自监督预训练框架，通过施加等距变换（如旋转和轴向反射）来增强模型对空间不变性的学习，同时捕捉全局相对距离分布，使模型在策略优化阶段之前学习到鲁棒的结构表征。
AI.result: 该策略在零样本大规模外推场景（TSP1,000）中，相比从零训练的基线模型，行程长度提升了7.23%；同时计算效率显著，在超大规模实例上比精确求解器Concorde快了两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 几何自监督预训练能够有效提升NCO模型在高维路由问题上的泛化能力，且兼具高效的计算性能，为NCO领域提供了一种实用的预训练范式。

title: From field-scale to large-scale spectral libraries: Tabular foundation models in soil spectroscopy
summary: Visible and near-infrared (vis-NIR) and mid-infrared (MIR) spectroscopy enable rapid, cost-effective prediction of soil properties. Yet, translating high-dimensional, highly collinear spectra into accurate soil property predictions remains challenging, particularly when employing machine learning. We systematically investigated regression models and dimensionality reduction approaches for spectroscopic modeling across 85 regression tasks from open benchmark datasets in pedometrics spanning field-scale digital soil mapping and a global soil spectral library. We compared an in-context learning tabular foundation model (TabPFN), a convolutional neural network (CNN), rule-based regression (Cubist), Random Forest, and partial least squares regression (PLSR) using full spectra as well as features derived from principal component analysis (PCA) and partial least squares (PLS) latent variables. TabPFN consistently delivered the best overall performance across scales, including large spectral library tasks with tens of thousands of soil samples. Notably, TabPFN applied directly to full spectra already surpassed all classical baselines, showing that explicit dimensionality reduction is not strictly required for strong performance. Further improvements were achieved through PLS, which proved to be an effective dimensionality reduction strategy for all models. Combining PLS latent variables with TabPFN yielded the best predictions overall. Our findings provide evidence-based guidance for spectroscopic calibration model selection across operational scales, demonstrating that the long-standing advantages of PLSR and modern tabular foundation models complement each other in chemometrics.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统比较了多种回归模型（TabPFN、CNN、Cubist、随机森林、PLSR）和降维方法（PCA、PLS）在85个土壤光谱回归任务中的表现，发现TabPFN整体性能最佳，且与PLS降维结合后效果最优。
AI.motivation: 可见-近红外和中红外光谱技术可快速低成本预测土壤属性，但高维、强共线性的光谱数据在机器学习建模中仍具挑战，缺乏系统的模型选择和降维策略对比研究。
AI.method: 在85个来自开放基准数据集的回归任务上（涵盖田间尺度数字土壤制图和全球土壤光谱库），系统比较了TabPFN、CNN、Cubist、随机森林和PLSR五种模型，并结合PCA和PLS两种降维特征进行了全面评估。
AI.result: TabPFN在所有尺度上表现最佳，直接使用全光谱即超越了所有经典基线，表明显式降维并非必要；PLS作为降维策略对所有模型均有提升，TabPFN结合PLS潜变量取得整体最优预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究为光谱校准模型选择提供了基于证据的指导，证明PLSR的传统优势与现代表格基础模型在化学计量学中具有互补性。

title: Comparing and Modeling Argumentation in German Political Communication across Arenas
summary:
Deliberation, involving the formulation and exchange of arguments, forms an integral part of political decision making in democracies. Argumentation patterns however differ substantially across different political arenas, such as plenary speeches and committee meetings. However, despite a lot of interest in argumentation, there is comparatively little computational work on analyzing differences in patterns of political argumentation between arenas.
  Our work addresses this research gap. First, we present a 17k-sentence corpus with annotation for argumentative passages (argument and their justifications, both their boundaries and their categories) across three German political arenas (plenary speeches, committee meetings, and press conferences), keeping the topic (COVID-19) constant. Our analysis of the corpus finds that contrary to expectations, justification by domain-specific expertise is more frequent in press conferences than in committee meetings. Second, we present a pilot study on automatically identifying such argumentative passages. The results show that boundaries are hard to pin down, and models predictions additionally suffer from confirmation bias.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个涵盖德国三种政治场域（全体会议、委员会会议、新闻发布会）的17k句论证语料库，并进行了自动识别论证段落的试点研究，发现不同场域间论证模式存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 政治论证模式在不同场域（如全体会议与委员会会议）之间存在显著差异，但现有计算研究极少关注场域间政治论证模式的差异分析，存在研究空白。
AI.method: 构建了一个17k句子的语料库，在三个德国政治场域（全体会议、委员会会议、新闻发布会）中对论证段落（论证及其理由，包括边界和类别）进行标注，主题（COVID-19）保持一致；随后进行自动识别论证段落的试点研究。
AI.result: 语料分析发现，与预期相反，领域专业知识的论证在新闻发布会中比在委员会会议中更频繁。试点研究表明，论证边界难以精准界定，且模型预测存在确认偏差问题。
AI.conclusion: 研究填补了跨场域政治论证模式计算分析的空白，提供了新的标注语料资源，并揭示了自动识别论证段落的挑战与模型偏差问题。

title: RF-HOI: Recognize Human-Object Interaction with Radio Frequency Signals
summary: Recognizing Human-Object Interactions (HOI) is essential for intelligent systems, underpinning applications in virtual and augmented reality, embodied AI, and assistive robotics. However, vision-based HOI methods face challenges in privacy concerns and poor light conditions. In this work, we introduce RF-HOI, the first framework that only uses radio frequency (RF) signals for HOI recognition. A key challenge of RF-HOI is that single-modality RF sensing is insufficient to recognize both actions and the objects being interacted with. RF-HOI addresses this through a novel modality fusion that combines mmWave radar and RFID, enabling simultaneous action recognition and target identification. Another challenge is limited training data across diverse setups, which impairs the generalizability of the recognition model. To overcome this, we develop a simulator that synthesizes multimodal RF data for diverse HOIs at scale, allowing us to fine-tune with only a small amount of real-world data. Experiment results show that RF-HOI outperforms all baselines, approaching vision model performance, and that our diverse synthetic training data can significantly boost our system's performance on real-world scenarios. These results highlight the potential of multimodal RF sensing for robust and privacy-preserving HOI recognition as well as the effectiveness of our RF data synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RF-HOI，首个仅使用射频（RF）信号进行人-物交互（HOI）识别的框架。通过融合毫米波雷达和RFID实现动作识别与目标识别的多模态融合，并利用仿真器合成多样化的RF数据以解决训练数据不足的问题。实验表明RF-HOI优于所有基线方法，接近视觉模型性能，且在真实场景中表现良好。
AI.motivation: 视觉-based的HOI识别方法面临隐私泄露和光照条件差等挑战，需要一种不依赖视觉信号的替代方案。
AI.method: 1) 融合毫米波雷达和RFID两种RF模态，实现动作识别与目标识别的同步进行；2) 开发仿真器合成多样化的多模态RF训练数据，仅需少量真实数据微调即可提升泛化能力。
AI.result: RF-HOI在所有基线方法中表现最优，性能接近视觉模型；合成的多样化训练数据能显著提升系统在真实场景中的性能。
AI.conclusion: 多模态RF感知在鲁棒且保护隐私的HOI识别方面具有巨大潜力，同时验证了RF数据合成方法的有效性。

title: RHEA: Reliability-Harmonized Reconstruction and Assignment for Robust Multimodal-Attributed Graph Clustering
summary: Multimodal-attributed graphs (MAGs), whose nodes carry heterogeneous attributes such as text and images over a relational structure, have become a fundamental substrate for label-free entity grouping tasks, including community discovery and product segmentation. Existing MAG clustering methods effectively integrate complementary modalities when attributes are clean and complete, but degrade substantially under noisy or missing attributes because they implicitly assume equal modality reliability across all nodes. In practice, modality reliability is inherently node-specific: images may be corrupted or absent, while textual descriptions are incomplete or noisy. We argue that, under attribute homophily, graph neighborhoods naturally provide supervision-free evidence for estimating node-specific modality reliability. Based on this insight, we propose RHEA, a reliability-aware framework for MAG clustering that estimates node-specific modality reliability from neighborhood consensus and propagates this signal throughout the clustering pipeline. RHEA reconstructs unreliable or missing modalities from graph neighborhoods, adaptively weights modalities during reliability-aware fusion, and performs topology-aware optimal transport clustering with reliability-aware transport assignment and neighbor-consensus assignment distillation. Furthermore, the confidence of reconstructed representations is incorporated into the clustering objective, allowing uncertain reconstructions to contribute proportionally during optimization. Experiments on four MAG benchmarks under five attribute conditions show that RHEA consistently outperforms the strongest baseline, with NMI gains increasing as attribute quality deteriorates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RHEA框架，用于多模态属性图（MAG）聚类，通过从图邻域中估计节点特定的模态可靠性，并在聚类全流程中传播该信号，从而在属性噪声或缺失的情况下显著提升聚类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MAG聚类方法假设所有节点的模态可靠性相同，在属性干净完整时表现良好，但在属性有噪声或缺失时性能大幅下降。然而实际应用中，模态可靠性具有节点特异性（如图像损坏或缺失、文本不完整），需要更鲁棒的解决方案。
AI.method: RHEA框架包含四个核心组件：1）从图邻域共识估计节点特定的模态可靠性；2）从图邻域重建不可靠或缺失的模态；3）在可靠性感知融合中自适应加权不同模态；4）拓扑感知的最优传输聚类，包含可靠性感知的传输分配和邻域共识分配蒸馏。重构表示的置信度被纳入聚类目标函数中。
AI.result: 在四个MAG基准数据集上的五种属性条件下，RHEA始终优于最强基线，且NMI增益随属性质量恶化而增大，表明其在噪声和缺失属性场景下具有显著优势。
AI.conclusion: RHEA通过利用图邻域作为无监督证据来估计节点特定模态可靠性，有效解决了MAG聚类在属性不完整或噪声场景下的鲁棒性问题，且性能优势在属性越差时越明显。

title: SeDeM: Selective Decompression of Hidden-State Memories for Long-Context Question Answering
summary: Long-context inference with large language models (LLMs) is costly: self-attention during prefill scales quadratically with sequence length, and the key-value (KV) cache grows with the number of processed tokens. Larger context windows also do not ensure reliable evidence use. Context compression reduces this cost, but many soft-compression methods use LLMs as compressors and rely on compact memory tokens both to preserve information and to condition the decoder. We propose SeDeM, a selective decompression framework that decouples compact memory storage from decoder conditioning. An LLM extracts hidden states from a chosen intermediate Transformer layer, a lightweight compressor stores them as memory blocks, a query-conditioned selector selects relevant blocks, and a decompressor expands only the selected blocks into hidden states compatible with an intermediate decoder layer. Thus, the decoder avoids both full-context processing and direct generation from highly compressed memory slots. On four long-context QA benchmarks, SeDeM achieves higher QA scores than the evaluated compression baselines in both 1B and 3B same-backbone settings, and with the 3B backbone exceeds full-context fine-tuning on three datasets. The learned selector uses block-level evidence supervision during training. SeDeM also reduces online time-to-first-token and improves autoregressive decoding throughput relative to ICAE.

AI.tldr: SeDeM是一种选择性解压缩框架，将紧凑记忆存储与解码器条件分离。它通过LLM从中间Transformer层提取隐藏状态，用轻量级压缩器存储为记忆块，查询条件选择器挑选相关块，解压器仅扩展选中块供解码器使用，从而避免全上下文处理和直接从高压缩记忆槽生成，在四个长上下文QA基准上超越压缩基线，并降低首token延迟。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理成本高昂——自注意力在预填充阶段随序列长度二次增长，KV缓存随处理token数量增长，且更大的上下文窗口并不保证可靠的证据使用。现有软压缩方法依赖LLM作为压缩器并通过紧凑记忆token同时承担信息保存和解码条件化，效率有限。
AI.method: SeDeM将紧凑记忆存储与解码器条件解耦：1) LLM从选定的中间Transformer层提取隐藏状态；2) 轻量级压缩器将其存储为记忆块；3) 查询条件选择器选择相关块；4) 解压器仅将选中块扩展为与中间解码器层兼容的隐藏状态。训练时选择器使用块级证据监督。
AI.result: 在四个长上下文QA基准上，SeDeM在1B和3B同骨干设置中均获得比压缩基线更高的QA分数；3B骨干在三个数据集上超过全上下文微调；相比ICAE，SeDeM降低了在线首token时间并提高了自回归解码吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: SeDeM通过解耦记忆存储与解码器条件化，结合选择性解压缩策略，在保持高质量长上下文推理的同时显著降低了计算成本，验证了块级证据监督训练选择器的有效性。

title: WM-Cov: Test Adequacy for Interactive World-Model-Style Autonomous Driving Simulation
summary: World models and generative simulators are emerging as interactive testing infrastructure for autonomous driving because they can react to the ego planner and produce counterfactual, rare, and safety-critical rollouts. This changes a test scenario from a fixed replayed trajectory into an interactive scenario family whose realized evolution depends on the planner under test. The unresolved question is therefore not only whether dangerous rollouts can be generated, but what valid closed-loop evidence is enough to support a specified testing intent and stopping decision.
