This paper formulates interactive world-model-style testing adequacy and introduces WM-Cov, a provider-agnostic evaluation layer that converts raw provider outputs into requested, realized, and valid evidence. WM-Cov reports adequacy through coverage growth, valid-failure discovery, failure-mode diversity, realism, artifact suppression, duplicate accounting, and valid-evidence precision. Studies on executed TeraSim/SUMO events, WM-like mixed trace pools, and a real DriveArena TrafficManager--WorldDreamer matrix show that dangerous-looking events can include valid ADS failures, duplicates, partial realizations, and artifacts. The DriveArena matrix evaluates two planners, two horizons, six prompt conditions, and 360 ego-route requests; 304 attempts become fully realized evidence and 56 remain partial. A disjoint 80-request route-slice check yields 74 fully realized and 6 partial attempts. The results support evaluating world-model-style testing by convergence of valid interactive evidence under budget, rather than by raw generated failures or prompt coverage alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WM-Cov，一个与提供者无关的评价层，用于量化世界模型式自动驾驶闭环测试的充分性。通过覆盖率增长、有效失败发现、故障模式多样性、真实性等指标，从原始输出中提取有效证据，帮助判断测试是否达到预期目的。
AI.motivation: 世界模型和生成式模拟器作为自动驾驶交互式测试基础设施，将测试场景从固定回放轨迹变为交互式场景族，其演化取决于被测规划器。因此，不仅要问能否生成危险rollout，更要问什么有效的闭环证据足以支持测试意图和停止决策。目前缺乏明确的测试充分性框架。
AI.method: 提出WM-Cov评价层，将原始提供者输出转化为"请求的"、"已实现的"和"有效的"三类证据。通过覆盖增长、有效失败发现、故障模式多样性、真实性、伪影抑制、重复计账和有效证据精度等维度报告充分性。在TeraSim/SUMO事件、WM样混合轨迹池和真实DriveArena矩阵上进行验证。
AI.result: DriveArena矩阵评估了2个规划器、2个时域、6个提示条件和360个ego路径请求；304次尝试成为完全实现的证据，56次保持部分实现。额外的80-请求路线子集检查得到74次完全实现和6次部分实现。结果表明危险外观事件可能包含有效ADS故障、重复、部分实现和伪影。
AI.conclusion: 应当基于预算下有效交互证据的收敛性来评估世界模型式测试，而非仅依赖原始生成的失败数或提示覆盖率。WM-Cov为不同的提供者提供统一的评价框架，支持测试意图验证和停止决策。

title: Towards Effective Federated Multimodal Graph Learning via Navigating Multifaceted Heterogeneity
summary: Multimodal-attributed graphs (MAGs), where nodes carry heterogeneous semantic content across multiple modalities while edges encode relational dependencies, have been widely adopted across diverse domains. Federated multimodal graph learning (FMGL) extends federated graph learning (FGL) to MAGs, enabling collaborative optimization across decentralized MAGs without exposing raw data. However, naively applying existing FGL methods to FMGL is insufficient, as they fail to navigate the multifaceted heterogeneity inherent in decentralized MAGs, including task heterogeneity across diverse client objectives, modality heterogeneity from discrepant modality quality and semantic domains, and topology heterogeneity arising from divergent topological patterns with low cross-modality correlation. To address these challenges, we propose Federated multimodal graph learning with Topology-aware Cross-modal Routing (FedTCR), the first systematic algorithm designed for FMGL. To handle task heterogeneity, FedTCR employs a two-stage paradigm that comprises federated task-agnostic pre-training followed by isolated task-oriented fine-tuning. To jointly address modality and topology heterogeneity, FedTCR introduces a topology-aware cross-modal routing mechanism. Concretely, each client distills modality-specific knowledge into compact prototypes via topology-aware importance-weighted aggregation informed by graph structure; the server then evaluates cross-client cross-modal relationships among these structure-informed prototypes and routes informative ones as contrastive references, driving a tri-level cross-modal contrastive learning scheme that jointly aligns cross-client modalities while preserving discrimination. Experiments across 7 domains demonstrate that FedTCR outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on both graph-centric and modality-centric tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FedTCR，这是第一个系统性的联邦多模态图学习算法，通过两阶段训练（任务无关预训练+任务导向微调）和拓扑感知的跨模态路由机制，同时解决了任务、模态和拓扑三重异构性挑战，在7个领域上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的联邦图学习方法（FGL）直接应用于联邦多模态图学习（FMGL）是不充分的，因为它们无法处理分布式多模态图（MAGs）中固有的多面异构性：任务异构性（不同客户端目标不同）、模态异构性（模态质量和语义域不一致）以及拓扑异构性（拓扑模式发散且跨模态相关性低）。
AI.method: FedTCR采用两阶段范式（联邦任务无关预训练+隔离的任务导向微调）来处理任务异构性；引入拓扑感知的跨模态路由机制，每个客户端通过图结构感知的重要性加权聚合将模态特定知识提炼为紧凑原型，服务器评估跨客户端跨模态关系并路由有信息量的原型作为对比参考，驱动三层次跨模态对比学习以对齐跨客户端模态同时保持判别性。
AI.result: 在7个领域的实验表明，FedTCR在图形中心任务和模态中心任务上都优于最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: FedTCR作为首个系统性的FMGL算法，通过联合解决任务、模态和拓扑三重异构性，有效提升了联邦多模态图学习的性能，并在多个领域得到验证。

title: CurveShift: Is Agent Progress Scalar? Separating Level from Shape
comment: 25 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Data and code: https://github.com/harvenstar/CurveShift
summary: Progress in large language models is often summarized using a single scalar measure, such as a time horizon, a latent ability estimate, or an aggregate benchmark score. These summaries capture the overall performance, but they do not test whether progress is distributed differently across task difficulty. We find that most of the apparent shift in gains toward harder tasks does not reflect a change in the shape of the difficulty-response curve. On METR time-horizon data, a single Rasch model with rising ability reproduces this pattern, so it is largely explained by ceiling effects rather than a qualitative change in capability. This echoes how the choice of metric can make claimed emergent abilities look like a property of the models themselves. We then identify a smaller hard-task effect that survives this control. Isolating it is difficult on agentic benchmarks, because newer models are usually run with newer agentic harnesses, so a gain on hard tasks cannot be assigned to the model or its scaffold. We break the confound with LiveCodeBench, a public competitive programming benchmark that runs no agentic scaffold while pairing dated models with an exogenous difficulty ordering. After accounting for the rise in overall ability, models released after September 2024 still gain on the hardest problems beyond what their easy and medium performance predicts, by about +0.40 logits under our most conservative assumption, raising the hard-problem solve rate from roughly 18% to 25%. The effect is led by the strongest reasoning models and holds for hard tasks that need only short reasoning, not autonomy over long horizons. We present this as a result specific to competitive programming, since our clean identification rests on a single coding benchmark. We release the LiveCodeBench Difficulty Panel (66 dated models x 1,055 problems) and our analysis code.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型能力提升在不同任务难度上的分布。作者发现大部分所谓"向更难任务迁移"的表象并非能力曲线形状的真正变化，而是由于单一Rasch模型的"天花板效应"所致。通过引入LiveCodeBench基准（无agentic框架、外生难度排序），在控制整体能力提升后，发现2024年9月后发布的模型在最难问题上仍有+0.40 logits的超额增益，将难题解决率从约18%提升到25%。该效应主要由最强推理模型驱动，且仅限于需要短推理的硬任务，而非长时间自主性任务。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM进展总结通常使用单一标量指标（如时间跨度、能力估计或基准总分），但这些指标无法检验能力提升在任务难度维度上的分布是否真的发生了变化。作者希望区分"天花板效应"（模型整体能力上升导致的表面难度迁移）与真实的"硬任务专门化"效应，并消除agentic benchmark中模型与脚手架混杂的混淆因素。
AI.method: 首先在METR时间跨度数据上使用单一Rasch模型验证"天花板效应"可解释大部分难度迁移现象。然后引入LiveCodeBench——一个无agentic脚手架、使用外生难度排序的公开竞赛编程基准，涵盖66个有明确发布日期模型和1,055道题。通过控制整体能力提升后的残差分析，识别出模型在最难问题上的超额增益。
AI.result: 在METR数据上，单参数Rasch模型（仅能力上升）即可重现难度迁移模式，说明大部分现象由天花板效应解释。在LiveCodeBench上，经过保守校正后，2024年9月后发布的模型在难题上仍有+0.40 logits的超额增益，难题解决率从约18%升至25%。该效应主要由最强的推理模型驱动，且对需要短推理而非长时间自主性的硬任务成立。
AI.conclusion: LLM进步在"硬任务"上的真实增益是存在的，但其规模远小于表面指标所示；该效应主要体现为推理能力在短推理硬任务上的突破，而非长时序自主能力的质变。这一结论目前仅对竞赛编程场景有干净的识别依据，需要更多类似的无脚手架、外生难度的基准来验证其普适性。

title: CrystalMem: Elastic Memory for Self-Evolving LLM Agents via Knowledge Crystallization
summary: Memory for self-evolving large language model (LLM) agents is often provisioned as if its byte budget only grows. Cloud platforms, however, adjust quotas with load and cost, and we show that capability does not follow the budget back up: after a squeeze-and-recover cycle, the agent settles below its pre-squeeze level, a gap we call memory hysteresis. The cause is structural. Deletion and one-way compression discard the material needed for later rebuilding, and we prove that any policy that only keeps or drops entries carries a residual-deficit floor. We propose CrystalMem (Crystallized Memory), an elastic memory sidecar that demotes entries across four fidelity states under a crystallization-energy schedule, orders demotions by advantage-weighted influence with dependency coupling, and recovers capability through verified recrystallization under explicit compute and byte caps. Across seven environments, seventeen methods, and six backbones, with multi-tenant serving and a physical edge-cloud deployment, CrystalMem achieves the highest restored capability in every setting and closes the loop left open by every baseline. From a 50% byte budget, CrystalMem matches the strongest budgeted baseline at full provision on every environment; at equal budgets, it leads by +4.6 pp on average.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrystalMem，一种弹性记忆侧车系统，解决大语言模型智能体在内存预算收缩-恢复周期中出现的"记忆迟滞"问题（能力无法恢复到压缩前水平），通过四态保真度降级、结晶能量调度和验证性重结晶机制，在七种环境、十七种方法、六种骨干网络上均取得最优恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体记忆系统假设字节预算只会增长，但云平台会随负载和成本调整配额。研究发现经过"压缩-恢复"周期后，智能体能力无法回到压缩前水平（记忆迟滞）。作者证明任何仅保留或丢弃条目的策略都存在残余赤字下限，因此需要新的弹性记忆方案。
AI.method: 提出CrystalMem（结晶化记忆）系统，包含三个核心机制：(1) 在结晶能量调度下将条目降级到四种保真度状态；(2) 使用优势加权影响力结合依赖耦合来排序降级顺序；(3) 在明确的计算和字节上限下，通过验证性重结晶恢复能力。
AI.result: 在七种环境、十七种方法、六种骨干网络上，包括多租户服务和物理边缘云部署场景，CrystalMem在所有设置中均取得最高恢复能力。从50%字节预算出发，CrystalMem在每个环境中都能匹配最强预算基线在全量供给时的表现；在同等预算下平均领先4.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CrystalMem通过弹性的多状态记忆管理策略，成功解决了智能体记忆在预算波动下的迟滞问题，为云环境中LLM智能体的记忆管理提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Relative Parameter Importance in Task-Agnostic Replay-Free Continual Learning
comment: Accepted for publication at the SCL Workshop, ECML-PKDD 2026
summary: Achieving continual learning (CL) with deep neural networks requires balancing stability and plasticity while enabling knowledge transfer. In this work, we focus on offline learning algorithms under the constraints: (I) no access to training data from prior tasks (II) no access to task-id at inference time. We introduce a novel measure, the relative parameter-importance, which measures the relative importance of each parameter with respect to both the current and past tasks. Parameters with high relative importance are interpreted as more important for maintaining past-task stability and thus heavily regularised, whereas parameters with low relative-importance are allowed to be more freely updated. Unlike existing methods, our approach allows the update of parameters with high past-task importance when they have low relative-importance, thus enabling backward knowledge transfer in addition to tackling the stability-plasticity trade-off. We demonstrate improvements against state-of-the-art CL methods on both class-incremental and domain-incremental learning text classification problems and provide insights for extending our method to text generation problems. Code available at: https://github.com/itsmemala/LACL

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于相对参数重要性的持续学习（CL）方法，在无先前任务训练数据和无测试时任务ID的条件下，通过衡量参数相对于当前与过去任务的重要性来实现稳定性与可塑性的平衡，同时在文本分类和文本生成任务上实现知识反向迁移。
AI.motivation: 持续学习需要在稳定性与可塑性之间取得平衡，同时实现知识迁移。现有方法通常在无先前数据和任务ID约束下难以兼顾两者，且缺乏对参数重要性的相对视角，限制了在线学习算法的表现。
AI.method: 提出相对参数重要性（relative parameter-importance）度量，该度量同时考虑参数对当前任务和过去任务的重要性。高相对重要性的参数被施加强正则化以维持过去任务的稳定性，低相对重要性的参数允许更自由的更新。与现有方法不同，该方法允许对过去任务重要但相对重要性低的参数进行更新，从而在解决稳定性-可塑性权衡的同时实现反向知识迁移。
AI.result: 在类增量学习和领域增量学习的文本分类任务上，该方法优于现有的持续学习方法；此外还为将该方法扩展到文本生成任务提供了见解。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过相对参数重要性的新视角，在无数据访问和任务ID约束下有效平衡了稳定性与可塑性，并实现了反向知识迁移，为持续学习提供了新的思路和实用工具。

title: Deep Research Pretraining via Predictive Navigation
comment: working in progress; correspondence to {ucaswu,maxwellyu}@tencent.com or wuxing@iie.ac.cn
summary: Deep research agents are often trained on expensive, environment-grounded tool-use trajectories that require repeated retrieval, document inspection, and report evaluation. We introduce Deep Research Pretraining (DRP), an offline framework that derives predictive navigation supervision from naturally occurring evidence structures. Given a citation-bearing or hyperlinked passage, DRP constructs a proxy research objective, recovers linked evidence and graph-related alternatives, and converts them into search-open-write trajectories. This teaches models what to search for, which documents to inspect, and how to synthesize evidence, without a live retrieval environment or executed policy rollout. We instantiate DRP on scholarly citation graphs (DRP-Paper) and Wikipedia hyperlinks (DRP-Web), continually pretrain separate Qwen3-14B-Base models on 1B tokens, and fine-tune them on controlled fractions of 13K agent trajectories. Across five independently sampled subsets at each low-data budget, both variants consistently outperform matched no-DRP models on DeepResearch Bench. With one quarter of the SFT data, DRP-Web even surpasses a fixed no-DRP full-data checkpoint, with gains transferring to ResearchQA, WebWalkerQA, and SimpleQA. Starting from matched low-data SFT checkpoints, the DRP-Web advantage also persists through subsequent agentic RL. Source-matched and evidence-mismatch controls indicate that these improvements arise from evidence-conditioned navigation rather than domain exposure or agent-format imitation. DRP thus provides a promising complementary approach to trajectory-based agent training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Deep Research Pretraining (DRP)，一个离线预训练框架，从已有引文或超链接结构中提取预测性导航监督信号，将自然存在的证据结构转化为搜索-打开-写作轨迹，无需实时检索环境或策略回滚即可训练深度研究智能体，在数据效率上显著优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 深度研究智能体的训练通常依赖昂贵的、基于环境交互的工具使用轨迹，需要反复检索、文档检查和报告评估，成本高昂且难以规模化。作者希望找到一种无需实时代价高昂的检索环境即可有效训练智能体导航能力的替代方案。
AI.method: DRP从含引文或超链接的文本段落中构建代理研究目标，恢复链接证据及图相关替代选项，将其转化为搜索-打开-写作轨迹。在学术引文图（DRP-Paper）和维基百科超链接（DRP-Web）上实例化，在Qwen3-14B-Base上连续预训练1B token，并在13K条智能体轨迹的不同比例子集上进行微调。
AI.result: 在五个独立采样的低数据预算子集上，两种DRP变体在DeepResearch Bench上均一致优于无DRP的对照模型。仅用四分之一的SFT数据，DRP-Web甚至超过固定的全数据无DRP检查点，且收益可迁移至ResearchQA、WebWalkerQA和SimpleQA。DRP-Web的优势在后续agentic RL中依然保持。对照实验表明改进源于证据条件化导航而非领域暴露或格式模仿。
AI.conclusion: DRP提供了一种有前景的、与基于轨迹的智能体训练互补的预训练方法，能够显著提升数据效率并带来可迁移的性能增益，为深度研究智能体的低成本训练开辟了新路径。

title: Trust and Its Betrayal under Three Representational Strategies
summary: Trust is a propositional attitude of a distinctive kind: to trust is to rely on another under conditions where reliance could be disappointed, and the disappointment of trust---betrayal---differs qualitatively from the disappointment of a prediction. We treat trust as a \emph{subjunctive} epistemic state: $A$ trusts $B$'s competence when $A$ believes that \emph{were $P$ true, $B$ would know it}, and $B$'s integrity when $A$ believes that \emph{were $B$ to know $P$, he would disclose it to $A$}. We develop three representations of this state---as lexicographic \emph{assumption} as \emph{ordinal closeness} in a Lewis--Stalnaker sphere system , and as \emph{strong belief} in a conditional probability system and for each we ask whether the Brandenburger--Keisler impossibility on common belief survives when the assumption of rationality is replaced by an assumption of trustworthiness. The three representations agree that every \emph{finite} depth of common trust is realizable while the \emph{completed} common-trust fixed point is the locus of difficulty, but they differ sharply in \emph{how} the difficulty manifests, and---our organizing finding---in how each survives a concrete betrayal. W show that the same betrayal refutes an agent's \emph{level ordering} under the lexicographic representation, contaminates her \emph{closeness ordering} in proportion to the betrayer's deliberateness under the ordinal representation, and merely \emph{shifts her operative conditioning hypothesis} while leaving her belief structure coherent under the strong-belief representation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信任是一种虚拟（subjunctive）认知状态，分别用词典序假设、Lewis–Stalnaker球系中的序数接近性以及条件概率系统中的强信念三种表示来刻画信任，并考察在Brandenburger–Keisler共同信念不可能性框架下，用可信赖假设替换理性假设后共同信任是否可实现。三种表示一致认为有限深度的共同信任可实现，但完成态的共同信任不动点均存在困难，且三种表示在遭遇具体背叛时表现截然不同。
AI.motivation: 信任是一种独特的命题态度，其失望（背叛）与预测失败的失望在本质上不同，现有逻辑模型尚未系统刻画这种区别。作者希望用虚拟条件句的认知结构来建模信任，并检验在共同信念的博弈论框架中，信任能否替代理性作为一个可行的基础假设。
AI.method: 作者将信任分解为对能力（competence）和品性（integrity）两个虚拟条件信念，分别用三种数学表示建模：词典序假设（lexicographic assumption）、Lewis–Stalnaker球系中的序数接近性（ordinal closeness）、条件概率系统中的强信念（strong belief）。在每个表示下分析共同信任的有限深度与完成态不动点的可实现性，并通过一个具体的背叛实例检验三种模型的行为差异。
AI.result: 三种表示均得出：任意有限深度的共同信任都是可实现的，但完成态的共同信任不动点（对应Brandenburger–Keisler不可能性的类似物）是困难的来源。然而困难的表现形式各不相同：同一背叛在词典序表示下推翻代理人的层级排序，在序数表示下按背叛者的蓄意程度污染其接近性排序，在强信念表示下仅使操作条件的假设发生偏移而信念结构仍保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 三种表示虽在共同信任的可实现性结论上一致，但在背叛的动态反应上存在本质差异，说明信任的建模选择对博弈论中共同假设的稳定性有深远影响。强信念表示在背叛面前保持信念结构的一致性和自我修复能力，可能是最稳健的信任表示。

title: Learning the Pareto Frontier of Predictive Models under Distribution Shift
summary:
Modern machine learning pipelines increasingly rely on reusing pretrained and foundation models across downstream tasks. These pretrained models can differ not only in performance but also in how they can be used: some only provide black-box predictions, while others may permit white-box access to internal representations that can be probed or fine-tuned. When deployed to the target domain in the presence of distribution shift, no single strategy, including zero-shot application, fine-tuning, or directly training a target-specific model, is uniformly the best.
  In this work, we propose Frontier Learning, a framework that treats a library of candidate models spanning different training histories and access regimes as complementary sources of information rather than mutually exclusive alternatives. Frontier Learning constructs a unified target-domain feature by concatenating internal representations from white-box candidates as well as prediction outputs from black-box candidates, then fits a lightweight, regularized supervised learner on this concatenated representation using labeled target data. Because the resulting hypothesis class contains predictors obtained by zero-shot reuse, fine-tuning, and direct training as special cases, empirical risk minimization over the frontier learner is guaranteed to be no worse, on the training sample, than any individual baseline.
  We evaluate the framework in simulations spanning varying degrees of source-target compatibility and in two real-world distribution-shift settings: visual domain adaptation on DomainNet/VisDA and clinical mortality prediction across intensive care unit domains using MIMIC-IV-Notes. Across all settings, Frontier Learning matches or outperforms the strongest individual reuse strategy, with the largest gains arising precisely when no single baseline is reliable across the range of shift considered.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Frontier Learning框架，通过拼接白盒模型内部表征和黑盒模型预测输出，构建统一目标域特征并拟合轻量级监督学习器，在分布偏移场景下保证不劣于任何单一模型复用策略。
AI.motivation: 在分布偏移下，预训练模型的复用策略（零样本、微调、直接训练）没有统一最优方案，需要一种能够整合多种模型互补信息的框架。
AI.method: 将白盒候选模型的内部表征与黑盒候选模型的预测输出拼接成统一目标域特征，在其上拟合带正则化的轻量级监督学习器；该假设类包含零样本复用、微调和直接训练作为特例，因此经验风险最小化保证不劣于任何单一基线。
AI.result: 在模拟实验（不同源-目标兼容性）、DomainNet/VisDA视觉域适应和MIMIC-IV-Notes临床死亡预测中，Frontier Learning均匹配或超越最强单一复用策略，在无单一基线可靠的偏移场景中增益最大。
AI.conclusion: Frontier Learning通过将候选模型视为互补信息源而非互斥选项，在分布偏移下提供了一种理论上保证不劣于最优基线、实践中稳定超越的策略框架。

title: AdaMTP: An Adaptive Training Paradigm for Multi-Token Prediction
summary: Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) has emerged as an effective paradigm that augments a shared Large Language Model backbone with auxiliary heads, training the model to predict several future tokens in parallel to enrich its supervision signal and accelerate inference. However, existing training frameworks adopt a rigid, fixed-length prediction horizon, disregarding the highly non-uniform information density of natural language and code. Forcing the auxiliary heads to predict across high-entropy semantic boundaries injects noisy, conflicting training signals; because these heads share the backbone's latent representations, the resulting gradients backpropagate and interfere with the model's core capabilities. We propose AdaMTP, an adaptive training paradigm that dynamically aligns the prediction horizon with the intrinsic predictability of the sequence. At its core, an entropy-based segmentation algorithm leverages the base model to detect sudden surges in uncertainty as semantic boundaries, partitioning sequences into variable-length groups. Each token is assigned an adaptive prediction depth, and a dynamically masked MTP objective suppresses the loss for predictions that cross these boundaries, attenuating the noisy gradients that degrade the backbone. Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and general benchmarks on three backbones (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Gemma-3-12B), AdaMTP consistently outperforms standard MTP in both task performance and inference speedup.

AI.tldr: AdaMTP提出了一种自适应多令牌预测训练范式，通过基于熵的分割算法动态调整预测深度，避免跨语义边界产生噪声梯度，在推理速度和任务性能上均优于标准MTP。
AI.motivation: 现有MTP训练框架采用固定长度的预测视野，忽略了自然语言和代码中信息密度的非均匀性。强制辅助头跨高熵语义边界进行预测会注入噪声和冲突的训练信号，由于辅助头共享骨干网络的潜在表示，这些梯度会反向传播并干扰模型的核心能力。
AI.method: AdaMTP的核心是一种基于熵的分割算法，利用基础模型检测不确定性突然激增的位置作为语义边界，将序列划分为可变长度分组。每个token被分配一个自适应的预测深度，并通过动态掩码的MTP目标函数抑制跨边界预测的损失，从而衰减损害骨干网络的噪声梯度。
AI.result: 在数学推理、代码生成和通用基准上，以三个骨干模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Gemma-3-12B）进行实验，AdaMTP在任务性能和推理加速两方面均一致优于标准MTP。
AI.conclusion: 自适应预测视野比固定预测视野更符合序列的内在可预测性，能够有效减少噪声梯度对骨干模型的影响，同时保持甚至提升推理加速效果。

title: Learning to Coordinate Symbolic Tools: LLM Agents for Verified Sum-of-Squares Certificates
summary: Tool calling allows large language models (LLMs) to invoke external computation during problem solving, a useful capability in various fields including AI for mathematics. We study this setting through weighted sum-of-squares (SOS) decomposition, a machine-checkable route to proving polynomial nonnegativity and hence polynomial inequalities. A candidate decomposition can be checked exactly, but finding one requires choosing among non-unique regroupings and coordinating multiple symbolic transformations. We develop an agent that combines algebraic task training, symbolic tools, and verifier-grounded optimization for this task. Rather than training only on the composite SOS task, we construct 1.35 million synthetic examples covering eight supporting polynomial tasks together with weighted-SOS decomposition. We first apply supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to direct algebra problems and simulated symbolic traces, and then use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with task-specific symbolic rewards. The SFT corpus contains no native tool-calling messages; at evaluation, the agent uses native SymPy calls for expansion, collection, reordering, and factorization. Every final SOS answer is checked by exact expansion and coefficient comparison. On held-out, same-generator synthetic problems, the full SFT+GRPO+tools system is the strongest of four evaluated configurations, reaching 78.96% verified success on weighted SOS, compared with 44.73% for the base model with the same tools, and 91.75% macro accuracy across nine polynomial tasks. Within this controlled setting, our work provides a case study of combining domain-specific skill training, executable tools, and verifier feedback, and may inform the design of tool-calling agents in other domains with exactly checkable outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了将工具调用与强化学习相结合，用于加权平方和（SOS）分解这一可机器验证的数学任务。通过构建135万个合成示例覆盖八个辅助多项式任务，结合SFT和GRPO训练，并集成SymPy工具调用，系统在加权SOS任务上达到78.96%的验证成功率，相比基线模型（44.73%）有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 工具调用是LLM在数学领域求解问题的重要能力，但加权SOS分解这一任务需要候选方案可以精确验证，同时面临多项式的非唯一重新分组和多种符号变换协调的挑战。已有方法仅针对复合SOS任务进行训练，缺乏对支撑性代数技能的分解式训练。
AI.method: 构建135万个涵盖八个支撑性多项式任务的合成训练样本；采用两阶段训练：先进行SFT（包含直接代数问题和模拟符号轨迹，不包含原生工具调用消息），再使用GRPO结合任务特定的符号奖励进行强化学习；在评估阶段使用原生SymPy调用执行展开、收集、重排和因式分解等操作；最终通过精确展开和系数比较验证所有SOS答案。
AI.result: 在相同生成器合成的留出测试集上，完整的SFT+GRPO+工具系统在四个评估配置中表现最强，加权SOS验证成功率78.96%（基线模型仅44.73%），九个多项式任务的宏平均准确率达91.75%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了在可精确验证输出的领域中将领域特定技能训练、可执行工具和验证器反馈相结合的有效性，为其他具有精确可检查输出的工具调用智能体设计提供了参考案例。

title: Mitigating Backdoors via Decoy Shortcuts and Knowledge Decoupling
summary: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to deep neural networks, especially when training relies on third-party data, allowing adversaries to inject malicious behaviors through data poisoning. In this work, we reveal that backdoor behaviors tend to be absorbed by a simpler parallel branch when jointly trained with the main network. Motivated by this insight, we propose Trapping and Removing (TR), a simple yet effective training-time defense that introduces a lightweight shortcut branch as a "honeypot" to trap backdoor knowledge. After training, backdoors can be removed by discarding the shortcut, without requiring any additional data. To further enhance backdoor isolation while maintaining benign performance, we design a knowledge decoupling strategy with entropy-based weight assignment, encouraging poisoned samples to flow through the honeypot while guiding the main network to focus on benign learning. In addition, we introduce an automatic shortcut generation strategy to improve generalization across model architectures. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets and five model architectures demonstrate that our approach effectively mitigates a wide range of backdoor attacks while preserving performance on benign data. Code: https://github.com/Zixuan-Zhu/TR}{github.com/Zixuan-Zhu/TR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为TR（Trapping and Removing）的训练时后门防御方法，通过引入轻量级捷径分支作为"蜜罐"来诱捕后门知识，训练后丢弃该分支即可移除后门，无需额外数据，在多种攻击和模型架构上均有效。
AI.motivation: 后门攻击对依赖第三方数据训练的深度神经网络构成严重威胁，攻击者可通过数据投毒注入恶意行为。现有防御方法往往需要额外数据或计算开销，作者观察到后门行为倾向于被更简单的并行分支吸收，由此启发设计一种训练时防御策略。
AI.method: 提出TR防御框架：(1) 引入轻量级捷径分支作为"蜜罐"来诱捕后门知识，训练后直接丢弃该分支；(2) 设计知识解耦策略，结合基于熵的权重分配，促使中毒样本流向蜜罐分支，引导主网络专注于良性学习；(3) 提出自动捷径生成策略，提升对不同模型架构的泛化能力。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集和五种模型架构上进行了大量实验，结果表明该方法能够有效缓解多种后门攻击，同时保持良性数据上的性能。
AI.conclusion: TR作为一种简单而有效的训练时后门防御方法，通过"蜜罐"机制在不需额外数据的情况下实现后门移除，展示了良好的泛化性和实用性。

title: SERL-SQL: Selective Hindsight Distillation for Text-to-SQL Reinforcement Agentic Learning
summary: Recent Text-to-SQL systems increasingly rely on multi-turn interaction, execution feedback, and reinforcement learning. However, most existing methods use execution correctness only as a trajectory-level reward, which provides limited guidance for identifying the SQL decisions responsible for success or failure. We propose SERL-SQL, a selective execution-grounded reinforcement learning framework for multi-turn Text-to-SQL agents. SERL-SQL samples on-policy SQL interaction trajectories and uses a training-only teacher to re-score student actions with execution feedback. The resulting teacher--student likelihood gap is converted into bounded, masked weights that reweight GRPO advantages only on SQL and tool-action tokens. In this way, task rewards preserve the optimization direction, while execution hindsight provides localized credit assignment. Experiments on BIRD, Spider, and cross-domain benchmarks show that SERL-SQL achieves competitive performance, reaching 76.56% execution accuracy on BIRD-Dev and 89.92% on Spider-Test. Moreover, our reward-based selection strategy closely approaches the oracle Best-of-N upper bound and consistently outperforms consistency-based selection, showing that SERL-SQL produces high-quality candidates that can be reliably identified by lightweight execution-grounded rewards. Our code will be released at https://github.com/Ffunkytao/SERL-SQL.

AI.tldr: SERL-SQL提出了一种选择性执行反馈强化学习框架，用于多轮Text-to-SQL智能体。该方法通过训练专用教师模型对学生动作进行执行反馈重新评分，将师生似然差距转化为有界掩码权重，仅对SQL和工具动作token的GRPO优势进行重新加权，实现了细粒度的信用分配。在BIRD-Dev上达到76.56%的执行准确率，在Spider-Test上达到89.92%。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL系统大多使用执行正确性作为轨迹级别的奖励，这种粗粒度的奖励无法识别具体是哪个SQL决策导致了成功或失败，导致信用分配不精确，限制了强化学习的优化效果。
AI.method: SERL-SQL包含三个关键部分：(1) 采样on-policy的SQL交互轨迹；(2) 使用仅在训练阶段启用的教师模型，基于执行反馈对学生动作进行重新评分；(3) 将师生似然差距转换为有界掩码权重，仅对SQL和工具动作token的GRPO优势进行重新加权，实现局部信用分配。
AI.result: 在BIRD和Spider等跨域基准上表现优异，BIRD-Dev达到76.56%执行准确率，Spider-Test达到89.92%。奖励选择策略接近Oracle Best-of-N上限，且优于基于一致性的选择方法。
AI.conclusion: SERL-SQL通过执行反馈进行细粒度信用分配，有效提升了多轮Text-to-SQL智能体的优化效果。其基于奖励的候选选择策略能可靠地识别高质量SQL候选，证明了该方法的实用性和优越性。

title: RMSWeb: Reflection, Failure-Mode Mining, and Salvage-DS for Web Agent Reinforcement Learning
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures, and 6 tables. Includes appendices
summary: Compact web agents can reduce deployment cost, but training them poses challenges in both data collection and post-SFT reinforcement learning (RL). Successful trajectories are expensive to collect and often contain inefficient detours. After supervised fine-tuning (SFT), full trajectory corpora are dominated by routine states; moreover, when group-relative RL is applied to web actions, inadequately designed action-level rewards can yield weak or misleading relative updates, while groups rejected as unsuitable for such updates receive no fallback learning signal. We present RMSWeb, a three-part recipe for Qwen3-VL-Instruct at 8B and 32B. Reflection-conditioned retries increase collection yield and shorten successful trajectories; failure-mode mining concentrates offline RL on critical states exposed by the SFT policy; and Salvage-DS combines an action-semantic polarized reward, contrast-and-competence-gated dynamic sampling, and an action-only anchor for rejected groups. Policies trained with reflection-collected data use up to 19.7% fewer action steps on solved tasks. On WebVoyager, Online-Mind2Web, and WebTailBench, RMSWeb improves over SFT by 2.4-7.0 points at 8B and 1.2-7.7 points at 32B. Our 8B model also achieves the strongest reported Online-Mind2Web result among similarly sized open-weight models in our comparison and a leading reported accuracy-cost trade-off on WebVoyager and WebTailBench, with the caveat that external evaluation protocols differ.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RMSWeb，一个针对紧凑型网页代理的三部分训练方案，包括反思条件重试、失败模式挖掘和Salvage-DS奖励机制，在8B和32B的Qwen3-VL-Instruct模型上验证，减少了行动步骤并提升了多项基准测试的性能。
AI.motivation: 紧凑型网页代理虽可降低部署成本，但训练面临数据收集困难（成功轨迹昂贵且含低效绕路）以及SFT后RL的挑战：全轨迹语料被常规状态主导，动作级奖励设计不当会导致弱化或误导的相对更新，被拒绝的组群缺乏回退学习信号。
AI.method: RMSWeb包含三个部分：1) 反思条件重试（Reflection-conditioned retries）提高数据收集产出并缩短成功轨迹；2) 失败模式挖掘（Failure-mode mining）将离线RL聚焦于SFT策略暴露的关键状态；3) Salvage-DS，结合动作语义极化奖励、对比与能力门控的动态采样，以及针对被拒绝组群的动作专用锚点。
AI.result: 反思收集数据训练的策略在已解决任务上最多减少19.7%的动作步骤。在WebVoyager、Online-Mind2Web和WebTailBench上，8B模型相对SFT提升2.4-7.0点，32B模型提升1.2-7.7点。8B模型在Online-Mind2Web上取得同类开源模型中最佳成绩，并在WebVoyager和WebTailBench上实现领先的准确率-成本权衡。
AI.conclusion: RMSWeb有效解决了紧凑型网页代理在数据收集和RL训练中的核心难题，在保持较小模型规模的同时实现了显著的性能提升和更好的成本效益，但需要注意外部评估协议存在差异这一局限性。

title: An Embedded RISC-V Evaluation of Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks in Hard-Constrained Recurrent Physics-Informed Models
comment: 6 pages, submitted to SBESC 2026 as an extension to the ICLR Workshop Paper https://openreview.net/forum?id=iHpbQn99RB
summary: Hard-constrained recurrent physics-informed networks (HRPINNs) embed known dynamics inside a recurrent numerical integrator and restrict a neural branch to learning only the residual dynamics that the first-principles model does not capture. Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) have been proposed as parameter-efficient replacements for multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) in such residual branches, but their learnable B-spline activations follow a markedly different execution profile. Building on prior work that characterized when a vanilla B-spline KAN matches or underperforms an MLP as an HRPINN residual branch in discovery accuracy, this paper asks whether that parameter efficiency survives deployment. Using identical trained weights, we measured execution latency, energy per integration step, and dependability under post-training quantization in the closed recurrent loop on a RISC-V RV64GC platform without vector extensions (StarFive VisionFive~2, SiFive U74). For the two accuracy-comparable pairs, the KAN residual branch executed $13.5\times$ and $8.0\times$ slower and consumed $11.3\times$ and $5.6\times$ more energy per integration step (3.7\,$μ$J against 0.33\,$μ$J for the smallest pair); across all four parameter-matched size tiers the ranges are $4.7\times$--$14.5\times$ and $4.7\times$--$18.7\times$. Under INT8 quantization, KAN trajectories diverged up to $43\times$ earlier than matched MLPs; the damage traces to weight quantization, not to input-side knot-interval misassignment. These results indicate that the parameter efficiency reported for KANs does not transfer to deployment cost on scalar embedded cores, and that an MLP residual branch is the more dependable default for embedded HRPINN deployment unless specific quantization co-design is used.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了硬约束递归物理信息网络（HRPINNs）中，KAN残差分支相比MLP残差分支在嵌入式RISC-V平台上的实际部署成本。结果表明，KAN虽然参数效率高，但执行速度慢4.7-14.5倍，能耗高4.7-18.7倍，且在INT8量化下轨迹发散时间提前最多43倍，因此MLP仍是嵌入式HRPINN部署的更可靠默认选择。
AI.motivation: 此前研究已表明KAN在HRPINN残差分支中的参数效率（即发现精度方面）可能优于或匹配MLP，但尚不清楚这种参数效率能否转化为实际部署中的成本优势。本文旨在回答参数效率是否能存活于部署阶段这一问题。
AI.method: 在无向量扩展的RISC-V RV64GC平台（StarFive VisionFive 2, SiFive U74）上，使用完全相同的训练权重，对KAN和MLP残差分支进行闭环递归结构下的执行延迟、每积分步能耗以及训练后量化（INT8）下的可靠性测量。对两个精度匹配的模型对和四个参数匹配的规模层级进行了系统比较。
AI.result: 精度匹配的两对中，KAN残差分支执行速度慢13.5倍和8.0倍，每积分步能耗高11.3倍和5.6倍（最小对为3.7μJ对0.33μJ）；所有四个规模层级中性能差距范围为4.7-14.5倍（速度）和4.7-18.7倍（能耗）。在INT8量化下，KAN轨迹发散的提前量最多达43倍，且损害源于权重量化而非输入侧节点区间误分配。
AI.conclusion: KAN在HRPINN中报告的参数效率无法转化为标量嵌入式内核上的部署成本优势；除非采用针对性的量化协同设计，否则MLP残差分支是嵌入式HRPINN部署中更可靠的默认选择。

title: The methodology of Constructing the Large-Scale Dataset for Detecting Presuicidal and Anti-Suicidal Signals in Social Media Texts in Russian
summary: The suicide is a terrifying act of a person who is misled by his own mental state. This problem arises across many countries. Sadly, Russia also has quite high number of persons who committed suicide. Luckily, a subset of these people writes their struggles in social media, allowing a way to find them and help. However, these valuable texts disappearing in many irrelevant texts which is considerably slowing down the decision process about person's suicidal risk. To tackle this problem, in this work we have presented a detailed methodology of building the dataset for detecting texts that describe presuicidal and anti-suicidal signals. This methodology describes the process of instruction and class table creation, the process of annotation, verification and post-annotation correction. Guiding by this methodology, we collect and annotate a large-scale Russian dataset with more than 50 thousand texts from social media. We provide a count statistic of the dataset as well as common problems in annotation. We also conduct basic experiments of building the classification models to show the on go performance on different levels of annotation. Furthermore, we make the dataset, code and all materials publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套构建俄语自杀倾向文本检测数据集的详细方法论，并据此收集标注了超过5万条来自社交媒体的文本，还进行了基础分类实验并公开了数据集和代码。
AI.motivation: 俄罗斯自杀率较高，部分有自杀倾向的人在社交媒体上留下文字线索，但这些珍贵信息淹没在海量无关文本中，严重阻碍了对个体自杀风险的快速评估和干预，因此需要有效的方法从社交媒体噪音中识别出自杀前兆文本。
AI.method: 本文详细阐述了数据集构建方法论，包括指令和类别表的创建、标注流程、验证以及标注后修正。基于该方法论，收集并标注了超过5万个俄语社交媒体文本，并进行了基础分类模型的实验来评估不同标注层级下的性能。
AI.result: 成功构建了包含5万多条文本的大规模俄语自杀倾向检测数据集，提供了数据集的统计数据和标注中常见问题的分析，并在不同标注层级上进行了基础分类实验，展示了可用的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集和代码已公开发布，为俄语自杀倾向文本检测领域提供了重要资源和基准，有助于加速识别有自杀风险人群并促进干预。

title: Bayesian and Motivated Reasoning in AI Agents
summary: AI agents increasingly perform open-ended tasks in settings where their conclusions can guide consequential decisions. We provide evidence that AI agents draw different conclusions from identical numerical data when the substantive framing changes. We demonstrate this behavior in high-stakes domains in medicine, election forensics, and geopolitical forecasting by holding the evidence fixed while changing the scenario in which the evidence appears. Across twelve agent-domain comparisons, agents' conclusions are strongly influenced by their prior beliefs. They are more likely to reach an affirmative conclusion when it is framed around a proposition they already regard as likely, while the reverse holds when the framing conflicts with their prior. The framing also changes how some agents work: they search more extensively, choose different analytical specifications, and evaluate the same evidence differently. These results identify a particular risk of delegating decision-making to AI agents, as their decisions may depend on prior beliefs that are neither specified in the task nor visible in the decision record.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过12个智能体-领域对比实验发现，AI智能体在面对相同数值数据时，会因情境框架的改变而得出不同结论——当框架与智能体的先验信念一致时更容易得出肯定结论，反之则更困难。这种框架效应甚至改变了智能体的工作方式（搜索范围、分析规格、证据评估），揭示了一个重要的AI委托决策风险。
AI.motivation: AI智能体越来越多地参与开放式任务，其结论可指导高风险决策。然而，智能体是否像人类一样受到情境框架和先验信念的影响尚不清楚。作者希望通过实证研究揭示这一潜在的系统性偏差，因为如果智能体的决策依赖于未在任务中指定的先验信念，将对AI的可靠部署构成重大威胁。
AI.method: 在医学、选举取证和地缘政治预测三个高风险领域，保持数值证据完全不变，仅改变证据出现的场景框架，进行12个智能体-领域的对比实验。比较不同框架下智能体得出的结论、搜索行为、分析规格选择和证据评估方式。
AI.result: 智能体的结论强烈受到其先验信念的影响：当框架围绕其认为可能的命题时，更容易得出肯定结论；当框架与其先验冲突时则相反。框架还改变了智能体的工作方式——搜索更广泛、选择不同的分析规格、对相同证据给出不同评价。
AI.conclusion: AI智能体存在与人类类似的框架效应和先验依赖问题，这构成了将决策委托给AI智能体的特定风险——其决策可能依赖于既未在任务中明确指定、也不在决策记录中可见的先验信念，从而影响决策的可解释性和可靠性。

title: Generic Vision and Cross-Attention for Reaction Yield Prediction
summary: Traditional reaction yield prediction is constrained by 1D quantum descriptors that lack explicit spatial information. To address this gap, a dual-modal Vision Cross-Attention architecture is proposed, fusing tabular physical-organic data with 2D molecular topologies. Notably, it is demonstrated that a generic computer vision backbone processing simple 2D skeletal structures independently outperforms purely quantum-based baselines. By synergizing both modalities, superior predictive accuracy compared to traditional methodologies is achieved by the optimal cross-attention framework (Test RMSE = 5.27%). Through mechanistic probing, active, descriptor-guided spatial querying is observed, effectively offloading macroscopic steric identification to the visual pathway. Furthermore, a dynamic chemical hierarchy is learned by the network to heavily prioritize critical steric bottlenecks, such as the aryl halide. Concurrently, residual skip connections are utilized to protect non-spatial electronic parameters from destructive attenuation during fusion. Collectively, a scalable and highly interpretable blueprint is provided for augmenting physical chemistry with deep visual learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种双模态视觉交叉注意力架构，融合表格物理有机数据与二维分子拓扑结构进行反应产率预测，相比传统纯量子描述符方法实现了更优的预测精度（测试RMSE=5.27%）。
AI.motivation: 传统反应产率预测受限于1D量子描述符，缺乏显式的空间信息，导致预测能力受限。作者旨在通过引入2D分子拓扑结构弥补这一不足。
AI.method: 采用双模态视觉交叉注意力架构，融合表格型物理有机数据与2D分子骨架结构。利用通用计算机视觉骨干网络处理简单2D骨骼结构，通过交叉注意力机制实现模态间信息交互，并采用残差跳跃连接保护非空间电子参数。
AI.result: 最优交叉注意力框架在测试集上达到RMSE=5.27%的预测精度，优于传统纯量子方法。机制探针实验显示网络能够进行描述符引导的空间查询，将宏观空间位阻识别卸载到视觉通路，并动态学习化学层级以优先关注关键空间瓶颈（如芳基卤化物）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明纯视觉骨干网络处理2D分子骨架即可超越纯量子基线，且双模态融合能进一步提升精度；同时提供了一种可扩展、高度可解释的将深度视觉学习融入物理化学研究的蓝图。

title: The Learning Objective Governs Perceptual Narrowing: A Cross-Lingual, Layer-Wise, Ten-Seed Study of Self-Supervised Speech Encoders
summary: Perceptual narrowing---the developmental loss of non-native phoneme discrimination in the first year of life \citep{werker1984}---is a canonical developmental finding, yet \emph{what learning objective produces it} remains open. We train a \(\sim\)7\,M-parameter Transformer encoder on child-directed and read speech and evaluate phoneme ABX in English, French, and Mandarin over ten seeds, the seed as the unit of replication. Six results. \textbf{(1)}~The objective sets the direction of cross-lingual transfer: reconstruction (masked mel-prediction) degrades non-native discrimination, prediction (frame-contrastive) improves it---a same-encoder, same-data gap of \(+0.051\) in first-layer Mandarin ABX (\(p=3\times10^{-8}\)), unanimous in sign across twenty runs. \textbf{(2)}~That decline combines a large arm-intrinsic difficulty gradient with a smaller language-specialization effect (matched vs.\ mismatched \(+0.022\), \(p=10^{-4}\), all four layers). \textbf{(3)}~Against a language-symmetric raw-mel floor, reconstruction pushes the first layer \emph{below} the discriminability of its input; prediction pushes it \emph{above}. \textbf{(4)}~Read speech gives a \(3.6\times\) steeper non-native decline than child-directed speech. \textbf{(5)}~The customary three-seed budget cannot see this reliably: an effect unambiguous at ten seeds is called significant by as few as 70\% of three-seed subsets. \textbf{(6)}~Six objective configurations---sharpening, compression, consolidation, their composition, and word-level semantic grounding in two forms---fail to produce the full developmental signature (native improves \emph{and} non-native declines): a single objective moves both languages the same way because it acts on a shared representation. We conclude that the objective, not the architecture, is the first-order determinant of narrowing-shaped representational change.

AI.tldr: 本文通过训练约700万参数的Transformer编码器于儿童导向语音和朗读语音上，评估英语、法语和中文的语音音素辨别能力，发现学习目标（而非架构）是知觉窄化（感知窄化）表征变化的一阶决定因素。重建目标（掩码mel预测）会损害非母语音素辨别，而预测目标（帧对比）则改善之；多目标配置均无法产生完整的发育特征（母语提升且非母语下降）。
AI.motivation: 知觉窄化是发展心理学的经典发现，即婴儿在一岁内丧失对非母语音素的辨别能力，但其产生的学习目标（learning objective）是什么仍然是一个开放问题。本文旨在回答何种学习目标能够产生这一发展现象。
AI.method: 使用约7M参数的Transformer编码器，在儿童导向语音（child-directed speech）和朗读语音（read speech）上训练，评估英语、法语和中文三种语言的音素ABX辨别任务。实验在十个随机种子下重复进行，以种子为复制单位。比较重建目标（掩码mel预测）与预测目标（帧对比）的跨语言迁移差异，并测试六种目标配置（锐化、压缩、巩固、组合以及两种词级语义接地形式）能否产生完整的发育特征。
AI.result: 六个主要结果：(1) 目标设定决定跨语言迁移方向，重建目标使非母语辨别退化，预测目标使其改善（第一层中文ABX差异+0.051，p=3×10⁻⁸）；(2) 退化由大的臂内固有难度梯度和小的语言特化效应组成；(3) 重建目标将第一层推到低于输入的可辨别性，预测目标则推高；(4) 朗读语音的非母语下降斜率比儿童导向语音陡3.6倍；(5) 常规三个种子不足以可靠观测此效应（七成三种子子集能发现显著性）；(6) 六种目标配置均无法产生完整发育特征，因为单一目标作用于共享表征时会使两种语言同向移动。
AI.conclusion: 学习目标而非架构是知觉窄化形态表征变化的一阶决定因素。这一结论对发展心理学中关于知觉窄化机制的理论建模具有重要启示，也强调了在计算建模中增加复制种子数量以获得可靠结论的必要性。

title: Gene Ontology-Guided Hierarchical Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from Histopathology Images
comment: Accepted by ACM MM 2026. Code: https://github.com/NozomiMizore/MSGR
summary: Predicting spatial gene expression from histopathology images enables large-scale transcriptomic profiling without the cost of direct measurement. Existing methods decode the target gene set as a flat, unstructured vector, ignoring the inter-gene dependencies arising from shared biological pathways and regulatory programs. Without explicit structural guidance, models must infer these dependencies entirely from limited paired data, constraining prediction quality. We propose MSGR (Multi-Scale Gene Refiner), which bridges this gap by incorporating the Gene Ontology (GO), a curated functional hierarchy of genes, as an explicit structural prior. MSGR organizes target genes into a four-level GO tree. Its GO-guided decoder then progressively refines predictions from coarse functional domains to fine individual genes via residual corrections under scale-weighted supervision. Operating solely on the gene side, the GO-guided decoder serves as a seamless plug-in replacement that consistently improves existing architectures without requiring any image-side modifications. Extensive experiments on nine datasets from the HEST-1k benchmark provide empirical evidence for two central claims: GO-structured decoding consistently outperforms flat decoding, even against a state-of-the-art generative baseline, and the gain is attributable to biological ontology structure rather than hierarchical decomposition per se, as confirmed by a +0.027 margin over a structurally equivalent random hierarchy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MSGR（Multi-Scale Gene Refiner），利用基因本体论（GO）作为结构化先验，将靶基因组织成四级GO树，通过GO引导的解码器以残差校正方式从粗粒度功能域逐步细化到细粒度基因预测，在不修改图像侧的条件下作为即插即用模块提升现有架构性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的空间基因表达预测方法将靶基因集视为扁平、无结构的向量，忽略了基因间由共享生物学通路和调控程序产生的依赖关系。由于模型只能从有限的配对数据中推断这些依赖，预测质量受到限制。
AI.method: MSGR将基因本体论（GO）作为显式结构先验，把靶基因组织为四级GO树；GO引导的解码器在尺度加权监督下，通过残差校正从粗粒度功能域逐步细化到细粒度单个基因的预测。该方法仅作用于基因侧，作为即插即用的解码器替换模块，无需修改图像侧架构。
AI.result: 在HEST-1k基准的九个数据集上进行大量实验，结果表明：GO结构化解码在性能上一致优于扁平解码（包括优于最先进的生成式基线）；与结构等价的随机层级相比有+0.027的增益，证明性能提升归因于生物学本体结构而非层级分解本身。
AI.conclusion: 实验证实了GO结构化解码的有效性，且增益确实来源于生物学本体结构的先验信息，而非仅仅是层级分解带来的结构优势。

title: Paris as a 15-Minute City: An Explainable AI Perspective
comment: 17 pages, 16 figures. Extended report of a poster presented at the NetMob 2025 conference on 8 October 2025
summary:
The 15-minute city promotes access to everyday services within a short walk or bicycle ride, but its relationship with observed mobility remains difficult to quantify. We investigate this relationship in the Paris metropolitan area using mobility trajectories from the NetMob 2025 Data Challenge, enriched with INSEE sociodemographic data and OpenStreetMap points of interest (POIs), yielding approximately 70,000 trip segments after stop-based segmentation and data cleaning.
  We construct walking- and cycling-based indicators of local service availability and examine their associations with trip duration, transport mode, and short-trip car use. Higher POI availability is associated with less private motorized travel and more active mobility, although this relationship is substantially weaker in the outer agglomeration. Gradient-boosted tree models interpreted with explainable machine-learning methods consistently identify trip purpose, home--work distance, local service availability, vehicle ownership, public-transport subscription, and sociodemographic context as important predictors. For short trips, high POI density is associated with lower car use, while car ownership and driving-licence availability are associated with higher predicted car use; where services are sparse, public-transport subscription is associated with lower predicted car dependence. Finally, explainable AI (XAI) methods are used to examine how feature attributions change under alternative assumed variable orderings.
  The results are consistent with central assumptions of the 15-minute city while revealing substantial spatial and demographic heterogeneity. They also demonstrate how explainable machine-learning methods can complement accessibility indicators and identify locally relevant hypotheses for urban-mobility policy.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用巴黎大都市区约7万条出行轨迹数据，结合社会人口统计和兴趣点（POI）数据，构建步行和骑行可达性指标，分析其与出行时长、交通方式及短途驾车行为的关系，发现高POI可达性与减少私家车出行、增加主动出行相关，但这一关系在外围区域显著减弱。
AI.motivation: 15分钟城市理论主张居民可在步行或骑行短距离内获得日常服务，但该理论与实际出行行为之间的关系难以量化，缺乏基于大规模真实轨迹数据的实证验证。
AI.method: 使用NetMob 2025数据挑战赛的移动轨迹数据，结合INSEE社会人口数据和OpenStreetMap的POI数据，经停留点分割和数据清洗得到约7万条出行段；构建步行和骑行可达性指标，采用梯度提升树模型结合可解释机器学习（XAI）方法分析各因素对出行行为的影响，并通过特征归因方法检验变量排序的敏感性。
AI.result: 高POI可达性与更少的私家车出行和更多的主动出行相关，但该关系在外围集聚区明显减弱；出行目的、家-工作距离、服务可达性、车辆拥有情况、公共交通订阅和社会人口背景是重要预测因素；短途出行中高POI密度与较低驾车使用相关，而车辆拥有和驾照与较高驾车预测相关；服务稀疏区域中公共交通订阅与更低的车依赖相关。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持15分钟城市的核心假设，同时揭示了显著的空间和社会人口异质性，证明可解释机器学习方法能够补充传统可达性指标，为城市出行政策提供局部相关的研究假设。

title: Rethinking and formalising the state across languages: a unified computational learning theory account
summary: The linguistic notion of state has traditionally been restricted to the construct (annexation) state of Afroasiatic languages and treated as a language-specific morphosyntactic phenomenon. This article argues instead that the state is a systemic, context-dependent morphosyntactic mechanism that selects grammatical templates across synthetic languages. Within the Template-Based Modular Cognitive framework, taking Riffian as its primary empirical basis, the proposed theory provides a unified explanation for diverse nominal marking patterns traditionally analysed independently and is formalised as a symbolic computational model in which the state is represented by a set-valued function over grammatical templates. A learning algorithm based on finite-set operations acquires and predicts state-dependent grammatical configurations. Beyond nominal morphology, the framework has broader implications for theories of nominal structure and lexical cognition, in particular offering a unified analysis of determiner-noun structure. These results suggest that the state constitutes one instance of a broader class of syntactically conditioned dependencies that also includes agreement and grammatical case.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"语态"（state）不应仅被视为亚非语系附属结构的语言特异性现象，而应理解为合成语中一种系统性的、依赖语境的形态句法机制。作者在基于模板的模块化认知框架下，以里夫语为主要实证基础，将语态形式化为模板集合上的集值函数，并设计了基于有限集合运算的学习算法，为各种传统上独立分析的名词标记模式提供了统一解释。
AI.motivation: 传统的"语态"概念被局限于亚非语系的构造（附属）状态，被视为一种语言特定的形态句法现象。本文试图突破这一限制，论证语态实际上是跨合成语普遍存在的系统性、依赖语境的形态句法机制。作者希望通过统一的理论框架解释各种传统上被独立处理的名词标记模式，并将其与更广泛的句法依赖（如一致关系和语法格）联系起来。
AI.method: 作者在"基于模板的模块化认知框架"（Template-Based Modular Cognitive framework）下提出理论，以里夫语（Riffian）为主要实证基础。语态被形式化为一种集值函数，作用于语法模板集合之上。此外，作者设计了一个基于有限集合运算的学习算法，用于获取和预测依赖于语态的语法配置，并以符号计算模型实现该理论。
AI.result: 该框架为传统上被独立分析的各种名词标记模式提供了统一的解释，尤其是在限定词-名词结构方面提出了一致性分析。研究结果表明，语态构成了更广泛一类句法条件依赖关系中的一个实例，这类依赖关系还包括一致关系和语法格。学习算法能够通过有限集合运算有效获取和预测依赖语态的语法配置。
AI.conclusion: 语态不应被限定为亚非语言的附属状态现象，而应被视为跨语言中一种系统性的形态句法机制。该理论不仅对名词形态提供了统一解释，还对名词结构和词汇认知的理论具有更广泛的意义。语态属于包括一致关系和语法格在内的一类句法条件依赖关系的实例之一。

title: Where did the ambiguity go? Examining how multimodal models interpret polysemous words
summary: Human language is highly polysemous. Many common words (e.g., 'bank' or 'palm') carry several distinct meanings that shape what humans communicate and imagine. Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to understand this multiplicity of meaning, but much less is known about how polysemy surfaces in other modalities such as images. We study this across 17 text-to-image and 15 text-generation models by giving each a polysemous word with no context to fix its meaning and measuring which senses are produced over many samples. We find a clear multimodal gap, where within every model family, generated images settle on far fewer senses than generated sentences (normalized entropy 0.10 vs. 0.25), and both are far less varied than what people imagine for the same words (normalized entropy 0.47). However, when we instead ask a model to list how often it would generate outputs corresponding to each possible meaning of a word, it predicts distributions that are more diverse than the actual space of outputs. These results reveal a multimodal gap in how foundation models express meaning, and how their understanding may not transfer faithfully nor equally across modalities.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了多义词在文本生成和文生图模型中的表现差异，发现图像生成模型在表达多义词不同含义时的多样性远低于文本生成模型，且两者均低于人类想象的多样性。
AI.motivation: 人类语言高度多义，许多常见词汇携带多个不同含义。虽然已知大型语言模型能理解多义性，但对图像等其他模态中多义性的表现知之甚少，因此需要跨模态研究多义性如何呈现。
AI.method: 对17个文生图模型和15个文本生成模型进行测试，向每个模型提供无上下文的多义词，通过大量采样测量模型生成的词义分布。使用归一化熵来衡量词义多样性，并与人类对相同词汇的想象进行对比。
AI.result: 发现了明显的多模态差距：同一模型家族内，图像生成比句子生成使用的词义明显更少（归一化熵0.10 vs 0.25），二者都远低于人类想象的多样性（归一化熵0.47）。此外，当让模型预测自己生成不同词义的概率时，其预测分布比实际生成输出的多样性更高。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了基础模型在不同模态间表达意义时存在多模态差距，表明模型对多义词的理解在不同模态间可能无法忠实地、平等地迁移。

title: AdvPlan-Bench: Adversarial Evaluation of Structured Plan-Generation Agents
summary: Structured plan-generation agents are often evaluated as if a plan has quality in isolation, yet many realistic planning tasks require asking how a candidate behaves when another agent can search for responses. We introduce AdvPlan-Bench, an offline benchmark for adversarial evaluation of structured plan-generation agents. The contribution is a general evaluation object: a typed plan, an adversarial response set, selector diagnostics, and traceable candidate-frontier metrics. AdvPlan-Bench represents plans as typed action chains with optional branches, assigns synthetic quality scores, compares opposing plans with BLUE-vs-RED advantage and Nash-gap diagnostics, and evaluates qualitative constraint coherence with a transparent heuristic rubric. In 150 synthetic scenarios spanning five planning templates, a sampled best-response policy that draws eight response candidates reduces BLUE advantage from .518 to .486 and BLUE win rate from .900 to .820 relative to a single-sample response. An offline LLM-policy contract baseline reaches .496 BLUE advantage and .700 BLUE win rate, while a two-stage multi-agent council obtains .509 BLUE advantage and .813 BLUE win rate. A three-rater rubric-sensitivity study over 600 rating records yields .978 inter-rater agreement. AdvPlan-Bench is not an operational planner and provides no evidence about real-world decision quality; it is a reproducible benchmark artifact for studying adversarial plan evaluation, response-budget sensitivity, candidate frontiers, and multi-agent critique-and-revision traces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdvPlan-Bench，一个用于对抗性评估结构化计划生成代理的离线基准测试框架，通过类型化计划、对抗响应集、选择器诊断和可追踪候选前沿等通用评估对象，在150个合成场景中系统评估计划的对抗鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有计划生成代理的评估往往将计划质量视为孤立属性，但现实规划任务需要考虑候选计划在其他代理搜索响应时的表现，缺乏对抗性评估框架。
AI.method: 将计划表示为带可选分支的类型化动作链，分配合成质量分数，使用BLUE-vs-RED优势和Nash-gap诊断比较对立计划，并通过透明启发式规则评估定性约束连贯性。构建跨越五种规划模板的150个合成场景，引入采样最佳响应策略、离线LLM策略合约基线和两阶段多代理委员会等评估方法。
AI.result: 采样八候选响应的策略将BLUE优势从.518降至.486，BLUE胜率从.900降至.820；离线LLM策略合约基线达.496优势/.700胜率；两阶段多代理委员会达.509优势/.813胜率；三评分者评分敏感性研究在600条记录上取得.978的评分者间一致性。
AI.conclusion: AdvPlan-Bench是用于研究对抗性计划评估、响应预算敏感性、候选前沿和多代理批评-修订轨迹的可复现基准工具，但并非可操作的规划器，不提供真实世界决策质量的证据。

title: S$^4$R: Selective Sampling, Subspaces, and Sparse Reconstruction for Compressed Long-Context KV Caching
summary: The growth of context window lengths in Large Language Models (LLMs) significantly enhances their long-context capabilities but incurs prohibitive memory costs due to the Key-Value (KV) cache. Although low-rank compression of KV cache is a promising remedy, existing methods face a dilemma: offline approaches depend on external calibration data, whereas online approaches incur substantial compute for full-prompt decomposition and reconstruction. In this paper, we propose S$^4$R, which builds low-rank subspaces from selectively sampled tokens and computes attention over a sparsely reconstructed KV representation. S$^4$R uses prompt-aware initialization to build initial key/value bases from a representative prompt subset, trading off calibration-data dependence against prefilling cost. Because fully reconstructing the cache at every decoding step is prohibitively expensive and hurts throughput, we further adopt sparse reconstruction to retain only informative positions during decoding. Extensive experiments on LongBench and RULER with Llama and Qwen model families show that S$^4$R achieves up to 5$\times$ KV compression with near full-cache accuracy, combining the efficiency of fixed compression with the adaptability of prompt-dependent methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出S⁴R方法，通过从选择性采样token构建低秩子空间，并在解码阶段进行稀疏重建KV表示，实现高达5倍的KV缓存压缩，同时保持接近全缓存精度的长上下文性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）的上下文窗口扩展显著提升了长上下文能力，但KV缓存带来了高昂的内存开销。现有低秩压缩方法面临两难：离线方法依赖外部校准数据，在线方法则因全提示分解与重建而产生大量计算开销。
AI.method: S⁴R方法包含两个核心策略：（1）使用提示感知（prompt-aware）初始化，从代表性提示子集中构建初始键/值基，平衡校准数据依赖与预填充成本；（2）采用稀疏重建策略，在解码阶段仅保留信息密集的位置进行KV表示重建，避免每一步完全重建缓存带来的昂贵计算。
AI.result: 在LongBench和RULER基准上，使用Llama和Qwen模型家族的广泛实验表明，S⁴R在高达5倍KV压缩下仍能保持接近全缓存的精度，结合了固定压缩的高效性与提示相关方法的自适应性。
AI.conclusion: S⁴R有效解决了KV缓存压缩中离线校准数据依赖与在线计算开销之间的权衡问题，通过选择性token采样和稀疏重建实现了高效的KV压缩方案。

title: SymboUQ: Symbolic Uncertainty Quantification for Spatial Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Although large language models (LLMs) can produce fluent spatial reasoning traces, their intermediate relations may fail to support the final conclusion, making token-level confidence insufficient for final-answer reliability estimation. Existing formal verifiers provide stronger semantic evidence, but their applicability is partial: a parsed claim need not yield a definite semantic verdict. To address this issue, we introduce SymboUQ, a symbolic uncertainty quantification framework that estimates final-answer reliability from reasoning traces by distinguishing symbolizability, whether a claim can be represented in the verifier's formal language, from semantic determinacy, whether its execution yields an entailed or contradicted verdict rather than an unknown or not-evaluable outcome. SymboUQ comprises (i) a Layout Auditor that executes ordered spatial claims and extracts feasibility, conflict, and repair evidence; (ii) a label-free Determinacy Profile that characterizes effective executable coverage; and (iii) a Determinacy-Aware Reliability Composer that integrates constraint-based, representation-based, and decoding-based scores according to verifier applicability. Extensive experiments on five spatial reasoning benchmarks with four frozen LLM backbones show that SymboUQ achieves approximately an 8% relative improvement in AUROC and a 7% relative reduction in class-balanced Brier loss over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: SymboUQ是一个符号化不确定性量化框架，通过区分"可符号化性"（claim能否在验证器的形式语言中表示）和"语义确定性"（执行是否产生确定判定），从推理轨迹中估计最终答案的可靠性，在五个空间推理基准上相比最强基线在AUROC上提升约8%（相对），在类平衡Brier损失上降低约7%（相对）。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）虽能生成流畅的空间推理轨迹，但其中间关系可能无法支撑最终结论，仅靠token级置信度不足以可靠估计最终答案的正确性。现有的形式验证器能提供更强的语义证据，但其适用性是局部的——解析出的claim不一定能产生确定的语义判定结果，因此需要一种能够区分不同验证适用情形的方法来更好地估计答案可靠性。
AI.method: SymboUQ框架包含三个核心组件：（i）Layout Auditor——执行有序空间claim并提取可行性、冲突和修复证据；（ii）无标签的确定性剖面（Determinacy Profile）——刻画有效的可执行覆盖范围；（iii）确定性感知的可靠性合成器（Determinacy-Aware Reliability Composer）——根据验证器的适用性，整合基于约束、基于表示和基于解码的评分。该框架的核心思想是将"可符号化性"（claim能否在验证器形式语言中表示）与"语义确定性"（执行是产生蕴含/矛盾判定还是未知/不可评估结果）相区分。
AI.result: 在五个空间推理基准和四个冻结LLM骨干上的广泛实验表明，SymboUQ相比最强基线实现了约8%的相对AUROC提升和约7%的相对类平衡Brier损失降低。
AI.conclusion: 通过将可符号化性与语义确定性解耦，SymboUQ能够更精准地利用形式验证器的部分适用性来估计LLM空间推理的最终答案可靠性，为符号化不确定性量化提供了一种有效的新范式。

title: Deep Learning CNN and Recurrence Analysis for Alpha Gamma EEG Biomarkers in Fragile X Syndrome
summary: Fragile X Syndrome (FXS) is a neurodevelopmental disorder caused by reduced expression of fragile X mental retardation protein (FMRP), leading to disrupted synaptic plasticity, cortical hyperexcitability, and impaired network synchronization. Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a noninvasive window into these mechanisms and consistently reveals abnormalities in alpha (8 to 12 Hz) and gamma (30 to 100 Hz) oscillations that relate to inhibitory control, sensory processing, and cognition. This paper proposes a multi representation deep learning framework for automated characterization of FXS EEG phenotypes by integrating convolutional neural networks (CNNs), long short-term memory (LSTM) networks, and recurrence plot (RP) analysis. Band limited EEG signals are decomposed into alpha and gamma components and transformed into complementary representations, including temporal feature sequences, time frequency maps, and RP images encoding the nonlinear recurrence structure. CNN modules learn discriminative spatial-spectral and dynamical textures from image based representations, while LSTM modules model temporal modulation of oscillatory activity; a hybrid CNN LSTM architecture jointly captures spatial, temporal, and nonlinear dependencies. Subject-independent evaluation demonstrates that the hybrid model outperforms single modality baselines, with gamma features providing strong discriminative power and alpha gamma integration yielding the best overall performance. These findings support deep learning with nonlinear representations as a scalable approach for EEG biomarker development in FXS, with potential utility for diagnosis, stratification, and treatment monitoring in translational settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多表征深度学习框架，通过整合CNN、LSTM和递归图（RP）分析，对脆性X综合征（FXS）的EEG α（8-12Hz）和γ（30-100Hz）振荡进行自动化表型特征刻画。实验表明，混合CNN-LSTM模型优于单模态基线，且α-γ整合获得最佳性能，为FXS的EEG生物标志物开发提供了可扩展的深度学习方法。
AI.motivation: FXS是由FMRP蛋白表达减少引起的神经发育障碍，表现为突触可塑性受损、皮层过度兴奋和网络同步异常。EEG虽能非侵入性地揭示这些机制，但现有方法缺乏对α和γ振荡中复杂时空及非线性特征的自动化、系统性刻画能力，亟需更强大的计算框架来开发可靠的EEG生物标志物。
AI.method: 提出多表征深度学习框架：(1)将带限EEG信号分解为α和γ频段组件；(2)构建三种互补表征——时间特征序列、时频图和编码非线性递归结构的RP图像；(3)CNN模块从图像表征中学习空间-频谱及动力学纹理特征；(4)LSTM模块建模振荡活动的时间调制；(5)混合CNN-LSTM架构联合捕获空间、时间和非线性依赖关系。
AI.result: 在独立受试者评估中，混合模型优于各单模态基线；γ频段特征提供较强的判别能力，而α与γ频段信息的整合取得了最佳整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习结合非线性表征可作为FXS EEG生物标志物开发的可扩展方法，在诊断、患者分层和转化场景中的治疗监测方面具有潜在应用价值。

title: Native Multilingual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Low-Resource Southeast Asian Languages
summary: Large Language Models have achieved substantial progress in reasoning capabilities. Yet in low-resource native settings, many suffer from cross-lingual collapse, reverting to English during intermediate steps that require complex logical reasoning. This presents a cold-start bottleneck for policy optimization, whereas standard fine-tuning risks catastrophic forgetting due to cross-lingual representation drift. To address these challenges, we introduce the Onramp-Sequence Cross-Distillation (OSCD), a post-training algorithm that projects high-resource reasoning trajectories into low-resource vocabulary subspaces during generative training rollouts via an integrated translator agentic loop, ensuring the stable and efficient translation of dynamically generated reference samples for fine-tuning. This is coupled with joint-embedding semantic alignment of both reference and target-language reasoning traces, thereby bridging the pairwise cross-lingual representational gaps. Comprehensive evaluations using the AIME25 and HMMT25 benchmarks demonstrate that OSCD yields up to 3.2 times overall improvements in native Southeast Asian languages for mathematical reasoning, of which the joint-embedding semantic alignment component contributes up to 6.4% improvements in linguistic debiasing over translation-only baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OSCD（Onramp-Sequence Cross-Distillation）后训练算法，解决大语言模型在低资源语言环境下进行复杂推理时的跨语言崩塌（回退到英语）问题。该方法通过集成翻译智能体循环将高资源推理轨迹投影到低资源词汇子空间，并结合联合嵌入语义对齐弥合跨语言表征差距，在AIME25和HMMT25基准上实现了东南亚本地语言数学推理最多3.2倍的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在推理能力上虽有显著进展，但在低资源母语场景中常出现跨语言崩塌现象——即复杂逻辑推理的中间步骤会回退到英语。这给策略优化带来冷启动瓶颈，而标准微调又因跨语言表征漂移存在灾难性遗忘风险。因此需要一种既能避免遗忘又能稳定迁移推理能力到低资源语言的训练方法。
AI.method: OSCD是一种后训练算法，包含两个核心组件：(1) 通过集成翻译智能体循环（translator agentic loop），在生成训练rollout过程中将高资源语言的推理轨迹投影到低资源语言的词汇子空间，实现动态生成参考样本的稳定高效翻译用于微调；(2) 对参考语言和目标语言的推理轨迹进行联合嵌入语义对齐（joint-embedding semantic alignment），弥合跨语言表征差距。
AI.result: 在AIME25和HMMT25基准上的综合评估表明，OSCD在东南亚本地语言的数学推理任务上实现了最多3.2倍的整体性能提升，其中联合嵌入语义对齐组件相比仅翻译的基线方法在语言去偏上贡献了最多6.4%的提升。
AI.conclusion: OSCD通过将高资源推理轨迹有效迁移到低资源语言空间并辅以语义对齐，成功缓解了跨语言崩塌问题，为低资源语言环境下的大模型推理能力提升提供了可行方案。

title: Mask-Based Priors Are More Persistent than Query-Key Initializations
summary: Transformers do not merely lack data on some Boolean extrapolation tasks; they generalize in a systematically wrong way. Recent work on generalization on the unseen has shown that, despite fitting the observed domain, Transformers often extrapolate according to a simpler minimum-degree interpolator rather than the true target function. These Boolean tasks are not practical applications, but controlled stress tests for understanding Transformer inductive bias. We ask whether this failure mode can be corrected by injecting explicit structural priors into attention. Existing structured-initialization methods alter Transformer inductive bias indirectly, by choosing query and key projections whose similarity scores approximate a desired attention pattern. However, we find that when applied to Boolean extrapolation, these QK-based priors can be rapidly overwritten during training and fail to change the learned extrapolation rule. We propose a simpler alternative: initialize the additive attention mask directly. Unlike standard hard masks used for causality or locality attention, our mask is a finite, learnable attention-logit bias initialized from task-level interaction structure. This separates the structural prior from content-dependent attention scores, allowing it to persist throughout optimization. On Boolean reasoning tasks, mask-based initialization achieves near-perfect extrapolation where vanilla and QK-initialized Transformers remain trapped by the default inductive bias. The same mechanism also improves low-data arithmetic performance and remains competitive on vision and language benchmarks. These results show that attention masks can serve not only as architectural constraints, but as a simple substrate for encoding persistent inductive bias in Transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文发现Transformer在布尔外推任务上并非简单地缺乏数据，而是以系统性的错误方式进行泛化（倾向于最小度插值器而非真实目标函数）。现有基于QK投影的结构化初始化方法在布尔外推任务上会被训练过程快速覆盖，无法改变外推规则。作者提出直接初始化可学习的注意力掩码（attention mask），将结构先验与内容相关的注意力分数分离，使其能在优化过程中持续存在。实验表明掩码初始化在布尔推理任务上实现近乎完美的外推，同时提升低数据算术性能，并在视觉和语言基准上保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: Transformer在未见数据上的外推存在系统性错误——倾向于最小度插值器而非真实目标函数。现有方法仅通过QK投影间接注入结构先验，但这类先验在训练中会被快速覆盖，无法纠正错误的归纳偏置。因此需要寻找一种能够在优化过程中持久保持的结构先验注入方式。
AI.method: 提出直接初始化可学习的注意力掩码（attention-logit bias），该掩码来源于任务层面的交互结构，是有界且可学习的。与标准硬掩码（用于因果或局部注意力）不同，该方法将结构先验与内容相关的注意力分数分离，使先验在训练中不被覆盖。
AI.result: 在布尔推理任务上，掩码初始化实现近乎完美的外推，而vanilla和QK初始化Transformer仍受默认归纳偏置限制；该方法还提升了低数据算术性能，并在视觉和语言基准上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 注意力掩码不仅可作为架构约束，还可作为编码Transformer中持久归纳偏置的简单有效载体。

title: Nonlinear Laplacians Improve Signed-Directed Graph Learning
summary: While signed-directed graphs have been studied using linear Laplacians in the design of graph neural networks, relatively little research has focused on developing non-linear Laplacian operators for such networks. We introduce a non-linear Laplacian operator specific to signed and directed networks (NLSD). This non-linear operator extends the concepts of the signed Laplacian for signed graphs and the Laplacian for directed graphs. The NLSD calculates node-specific potentials based on features More precisely, if the potential discrepancy is not aligned with the edge direction, we ignore it (and vice versa) leveraging message-passing techniques only across edges where potential discrepancies align with the edge's direction. Utilizing this novel operator, we propose an efficient spectral GNN framework (NLSD-GNN). We conducted comprehensive evaluations focusing on node classification and link prediction, examining scenarios involving signed, directional, or both types of information. Our findings reveal that this spectral GNN framework not only integrates signed and directional data effectively but also achieves superior performance across diverse datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向符号有向图的非线性拉普拉斯算子（NLSD），并基于此构建了谱图神经网络框架NLSD-GNN，在节点分类和链路预测任务中取得了优于现有方法的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的图神经网络在处理带符号的图时多使用线性拉普拉斯算子，但针对兼具符号与方向信息的非线性拉普拉斯算子研究较少。
AI.method: 提出NLSD非线性算子，该算子基于节点特征计算势能差异，仅在势能差异与边方向一致时进行消息传递（不一致则忽略），并据此构建高效的谱GNN框架（NLSD-GNN）。
AI.result: 在节点分类和链路预测任务上，涵盖仅符号、仅方向及两者兼具的多种数据集，NLSD-GNN均实现了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: NLSD-GNN能够有效整合符号与方向信息，并展现出跨数据集的优越性能。

title: DE-NER : Zero-shot Named Entity Recognition via Dialogue Elicitation of Large Language Models
summary: Recent advancements of zero-shot Named Entity Recognition (NER) establish strong baselines by formulating sequence labeling into question answering where Large Language Models (LLMs) can be naturally adopted. However, existing LLM-based zero-shot NER methods suffer from the limitations of prompt and demonstration engineering. To address these issues with minimal human interventions, we introduce DE-NER, a dialogue elicitation framework which elicits the chatting ability of LLMs to fully extract the knowledge encoded in LLMs. Our experiments demonstrate that the proposed method outperform the competitive baselines in zero-shot settings across multiple benchmarks, with an average improvement of 3.75\% F1 points. Codes are released in https://github.com/kkkenshi/DE-NER.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DE-NER框架，通过对话引导方式激发大语言模型的聊天能力来完成零样本命名实体识别，无需人工设计提示词和示例，在多个基准上平均提升3.75%的F1分数。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于大语言模型的零样本命名实体识别方法通常将序列标注转化为问答任务，但这类方法依赖于繁琐的提示词（prompt）和示例（demonstration）工程，需要大量人工干预，效率低下且泛化性受限。
AI.method: 提出了DE-NER（Dialogue Elicitation framework for NER），一种对话引导框架，通过自然对话的形式激发大语言模型内在的聊天能力，让模型在对话交互中充分提取和调用其编码的知识来完成实体识别任务，从而减少对人工提示词和示例设计的依赖。
AI.result: 在多个零样本命名实体识别基准上，DE-NER方法优于现有的强基线方法，平均提升了3.75%的F1分数。
AI.conclusion: DE-NER验证了通过对话引导方式可以有效利用大语言模型的知识进行零样本NER，只需最少的人工干预即可达到更优性能，为减少提示工程负担提供了新思路。

title: TrAC: Trace-Conditioned Answer Consistency for Efficient Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent reasoning traces that nevertheless lead to incorrect answers, making response-level uncertainty estimation important for abstention, human review, and adaptive compute allocation. Existing approaches generally fall into three categories: passive single-trace methods use token-level confidence signals, sampling-based methods compare multiple complete traces at higher generation cost, and active prefix-based methods probe partial traces to study answer stabilization or preference transitions. However, none actively re-elicits an answer from a completed reasoning trace to measure its consistency with and support for the original answer. To address this gap, we introduce Trace-Conditioned Answer Consistency (TrAC), a correctness-supervised uncertainty quantification framework that combines active and passive signals anchored to one completed reasoning trace. Its active component, Prefix-Conditioned Elicitation (PCE), re-elicits a short answer conditioned on the completed trace and represents both its consistency with the original answer and its token-level probabilistic support. Its passive component, Trace Uncertainty Profile (TUP), summarizes how token-level uncertainty evolves throughout the original generation without additional decoding. A lightweight head then integrates the two representations into a response-correctness score. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks and three LLM families, TrAC improves macro AUROC by 1.8% and reduces AURC by 3.4% relative to eight-sample self-consistency, while using one complete reasoning trace and a short cached answer probe. When eight samples are already available, augmenting sample consensus with re-elicitation further improves macro AUROC by 4.3% and reduces AURC by 8.3%, without additional full-trace generation.

title: Adaptive Quantum Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Differential Equations with Applications to Fluid Dynamics
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a versatile approach for solving nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs), yet achieving high accuracy efficiently using these techniques remains challenging for high-dimensional or multiscale systems. Here, we present a hybrid quantum-classical framework that enhances Quantum PINNs (QPINNs) through adaptive collocation point sampling and loss-aware attention mechanisms. By dynamically prioritizing points in regions with large PDE residuals or steep solution gradients, our method mitigates the spectral bias inherent in conventional PINNs. Current Quantum Physics-Informed Neural Networks are commonly assumed to be limited by the expressive power of quantum circuits. In our work, we observed that, across diverse differential equations, optimization - not only expressivity - can be an important bottleneck. Furthermore, a trainable loss-weighting scheme balances contributions from physics residuals, boundary conditions, and data fidelity during training. Integrating these strategies with quantum computing techniques (including variational quantum circuits and quantum gradient estimation) can yield at least a 60% improvement in solution accuracy under specific regimes for benchmark fluid flows and reaction-diffusion systems. Finally, we argue that merely increasing model expressivity is insufficient for resolving complex PDEs via QPINNs, as they remain constrained by the structural optimization limitations of classical PINNs. This framework provides a scalable pathway for quantum-enhanced scientific machine learning, bridging physics-based modeling with emerging quantum computational capabilities.

title: Loanword or Switch? The Annotation Boundary, Not the Model, Drives Kazakh-Russian Code-Switching Identification
comment: 5 pages. Preprint. Submitted to W-NUT 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/naadgob/KazNLP
summary: Off-the-shelf LID and letter heuristics over-label Kazakh-Russian social text as mixed: Russian loanwords inside Kazakh look like code-switching under a shared Cyrillic script. We release a document-level gold LID set whose guideline keeps integrated borrowings as Kazakh and reserves mixed for clause-level switches, plus a mixed-only sentiment pool used after LID in a filter-first cascade. On a shared LID test, FastText, Lingua, raw and windowed HeLI, character-trigram NB, and XLM-R range from weak to strong performance. The gap shows the bottleneck is the loanword-vs-switch annotation boundary, not model class alone.

title: Diagnose Before You Compress: Prediction-Independent Bottleneck Witness Refinement for LLM Serving Traces
summary: Production LLM serving generates millions of diverse requests, making full-trace replay across serving configurations increasingly expensive. Existing trace reduction methods mainly preserve workload distributions or representative requests, but bottleneck-revealing workloads may be rare and non-representative. Moreover, evidence for one component cannot compensate for missing evidence in another, while using predicted bottlenecks as target truth creates circular evaluation. These limitations make it necessary to preserve evidence for every bottleneck component rather than rely on workload representativeness alone. We propose Bottleneck-Preserving Witnessing (BPW), a quality-constrained framework for compact and diagnostically reliable LLM serving replay suites. BPW first performs Workload Candidate Nomination using response-blind workload features and closed source-side measurements. This stage identifies workloads that may expose scheduler, prefill, decode, or KV-cache bottlenecks. Coverage-Priority Sequence Construction then organizes multi-component proposals as reusable hyperedges and prioritizes weak and uncovered dimensions. Finally, Bottleneck Truth Verification derives prediction-independent labels solely from direct target-system measurements. The verified results determine the earliest prefix satisfying the direct two-witness requirement for every component. Experiments on BurstGPT, ServeGen, and Mooncake show that BPW reaches the verified gate with a compact workload set and outperforms 16 policies, achieving relative improvements of 2.3% and 16.3% in Mean prefix Macro-F1 and WBRC-AUC, respectively. Stage-resolved and sensitivity analyses confirm the distinct contributions and local stability of its three stages. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/llmllmllm/BPW

title: HyperODE: Zero-Shot Surrogate for Simulation and Inference of Dynamical Systems
summary: Understanding and controlling complex dynamical systems often requires executing thousands of numerical simulations across vast parametric landscapes, which is time-consuming. Machine learning surrogates significantly accelerate simulation by predicting state trajectories across different initializations and parameter values. However, surrogate models are specialized to one simulation model. Modifying the underlying differential equations - e.g., adding a physiological state or altering an epidemiological contact network - renders trained models obsolete and forces computationally expensive retraining from scratch. We introduce HyperODE, a surrogate capable of operating across an entire class of approximately mass-conserving compartmental models without retraining. By mapping the structure of ordinary differential equations (ODEs) into directed hypergraphs, HyperODE decouples the functional form of system interactions from the neural network architecture. HyperODE takes a compartmental model in the form of an ODE with an arbitrary parameter distribution defined through quantiles and transforms it into a hypergraph. It outputs the distribution of the trajectories for all the states in the original ODE in the form of quantiles. We then use this surrogate to build an encoder that takes a noisy trajectory and outputs a distribution over the parameters of the original ODE, thus calibrating the model in a single pass. On families and system sizes never seen in training, HyperODE produces calibrated quantile bands in a single forward pass, with weighted-interval score and coverage on par with specialized surrogates for each structure. For inverse inference, HyperODE produces calibration from noisy state trajectories in a few milliseconds with a single shared encoder, competitive with existing methods. HyperODE extends zero-shot to ODEs that break mass conservation and to external forcing.

title: Writing-System-Level Tokenizer Adaptation for Byte-Level BPE
comment: 15 pages. Accepted for poster presentation at the Second Tokenization Workshop (TokShop) at COLM 2026 (non-archival)
summary: Pretrained byte-level BPE tokenizers can segment underrepresented languages inefficiently. Replacing a tokenizer changes the meaning of nearly every token ID, while vocabulary expansion enlarges the model's embedding and output matrices. We study post-hoc adaptation that keeps the model-vocabulary size fixed and preserves most existing token-to-ID assignments as a construction-time compatibility property. Directly transferring tokens from a language-specific tokenizer does not guarantee derivability through the target BPE merge graph: an inserted entry can conflict with the target's greedy merge ranks. We formalize this failure as the merge ordering problem and introduce BPE-guided insertion, which builds each transferred token through a target-reachable decomposition. Our pipeline uses script-aware row selection to limit collateral fragmentation, reconstructs target-script byte-level prerequisites, and applies guided insertion to maintain merge-graph reachability. On Ukrainian adaptations of Nemotron and GPT-OSS, it reduces token counts by 33.5% and 36.6%, keeps changes on English and the evaluated four-language European aggregate within 0.05%, and retains 78.5%/77.3% of original model-vocabulary rows at the same IDs. Constraint-matched global and frequency-based removal achieve similar Ukrainian compression but increase English/European token counts by 0.7-2.2%; fresh same-size retraining compresses Ukrainian slightly more but retains effectively no same-ID rows and increases English token counts by 7.6-8.6%. The reallocation increases token counts on the evaluated three-language Cyrillic micro-aggregate by 6.7%/10.1%. Structural audits find all 28,134/45,398 inserted BPE nodes reachable under ordinary rank-ordered merging and no retained same-ID model-vocabulary entry newly broken. We release all tokenizers and code.

title: Ekova: A Personality-Support Agent for Self-Discovery Dialogue
comment: Accepted to the COLM 2026 Lifelong Agents Workshop
summary: Emotional Support (ES) systems have long optimized a single objective: alleviating the user's emotional distress in the moment. We argue that a complementary need, helping users see themselves more clearly, defines a distinct paradigm we call Personality Support (PS). PS is not counseling or clinical intervention: it targets cognitive clarity and self-articulation, not symptom relief or diagnosis. We instantiate this paradigm in three layers. First, we present DSD, a Chinese self-discovery PS Dataset of 8,590 samples collected through real longitudinal interaction across five minimal units, Coach, Warm, Tsukkomi, Real, and Gonzo. Second, we build DeepSupport, a multi-persona PS system trained with OrthoTune, a PS-tailored framework with style-specific adapters and a style-consistency regularizer. Third, we unify the five DeepSupport personas into Ekova, a persistent personality-support agent with a unified cross-session memory layer, supporting both adaptive routing and user-customized persona selection. Experiments show that OrthoTune-trained models outperform all baselines with an average relative gain of 16.3% across all metrics over the strongest prompt-based baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/Yukyin/Ekova.

title: SparseKAN: Compressing Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks Across Basis Functions, Neurons, and Bits
summary: Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) replace scalar edge weights with learnable univariate functions parameterized by multiple basis coefficients. This introduces a source of redundancy that conventional neural-network compression does not directly expose. We present \textbf{SparseKAN}, a unified approach that compresses KANs along three complementary axes: basis functions, neurons/channels, and numerical precision. SparseKAN equips the base branch, nonlinear basis branch, and individual basis terms with hierarchical learnable gates trained under a differentiable active-cost objective. The learned importance structure is subsequently hardened under explicit basis and width budgets, recovered in full or low precision, and physically compacted into smaller dense tensors rather than retained as sparse masks. Experiments on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 across spline, polynomial, RBF, wavelet, and convolutional KAN variants show that the structural axes compose predictably in cost. We also find strong basis-dependent differences in term importance: coefficient-based selection outperforms matched low-order truncation by up to 15.25 accuracy points in the evaluated Gram-polynomial settings.
